class RiverbendReconciliationScenarioTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        fd, self.path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
        os.close(fd)
        os.remove(self.path)
        self.store = Storage(self.path)
        self.addCleanup(self._cleanup)

        accounts_data = fixtures.load_riverbend_accounts(str(ACCOUNTS_YAML))
        self.org_id = accounts_data["organization_id"]
        for entry in accounts_data["accounts"]:
            self.store.create_account(
                organization_id=self.org_id,
                account_id=entry["account_id"],
                email=entry["current_email"],
                display_name=entry["display_name"],
                mfa_enabled=entry["mfa_enabled"],
                email_status=entry["email_status"],
                now="t0",
            )
            self.store.create_recovery_request(
                request_id=f"req-{entry['account_id']}",
                organization_id=self.org_id,
                account_id=entry["account_id"],
                token_hash="unused",
                created_at="t0",
                expires_at="2099-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
            )
            self.store.create_notification(
                notification_id=f"notif-{entry['account_id']}",
                request_id=f"req-{entry['account_id']}",
                account_id=entry["account_id"],
                recipient=entry["current_email"],
                delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED,
                provider_receipt=f"riverbend-attempt-seed-{entry['account_id']}",
                reconciliation_id=f"riverbend-attempt-seed-{entry['account_id']}",
                retry_locator=None,
                now="t0",
            )

        windows = fixtures.load_delivery_windows(str(WINDOWS_CSV))
        self.policy = WindowPolicy.from_rows(windows)
        self.engine = ReconciliationEngine(self.store, self.policy)
        self.feed = fixtures.load_reconciliation_feed(str(FEED_JSONL))

    def _cleanup(self):
        self.store.close()
        for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
            candidate = self.path + suffix
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                os.remove(candidate)

    def test_delayed_observation_within_bound_is_retained_unresolved_and_fresh(self):
        # acct-delay-a observed 2026-08-30T01:07:00Z, max_age_minutes=30 for accepted_delayed.
        self.engine.ingest_feed(self.feed, now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z")

        observations = self.store.reconciliation_observations(account_id="acct-delay-a")
        self.assertEqual(len(observations), 1)
        self.assertEqual(observations[0].reconciliation_class, models.ReconciliationClass.RETAIN_UNRESOLVED)
        self.assertFalse(observations[0].is_stale)

        notification = self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-a")
        self.assertEqual(notification.delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED)

    def test_delayed_observation_past_bound_is_flagged_stale(self):
        self.engine.ingest_feed(self.feed, now="2026-08-30T02:00:00Z")

        observations = self.store.reconciliation_observations(account_id="acct-delay-a")
        self.assertTrue(observations[0].is_stale)

    def test_delivered_observation_closes_out_the_notification(self):
        self.engine.ingest_feed(self.feed, now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z")

        observations = self.store.reconciliation_observations(account_id="acct-delay-b")
        self.assertEqual(observations[0].reconciliation_class, models.ReconciliationClass.CLOSE_CONFIRMED)

        notification = self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-b")
        self.assertEqual(notification.delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED)

    def test_unmatched_observation_is_recorded_for_review_without_an_account(self):
        self.engine.ingest_feed(self.feed, now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z")

        all_observations = self.store.reconciliation_observations()
        unmatched = [o for o in all_observations if o.account_id is None]
        self.assertEqual(len(unmatched), 1)
        self.assertEqual(unmatched[0].reconciliation_class, models.ReconciliationClass.REVIEW_UNMATCHED)
        self.assertEqual(unmatched[0].organization_id, "org-riverbend")

class ReconciliationFeedValidationTests(RiverbendReconciliationScenarioTests):
    """Import/validation rules: attempt-id matching, ordering, and duplicates."""

    def test_duplicate_feed_page_replay_is_idempotent(self):
        first_pass = self.engine.ingest_feed(self.feed, now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z")
        second_pass = self.engine.ingest_feed(self.feed, now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z")

        # No duplicate rows: still exactly one observation per feed line.
        self.assertEqual(len(self.store.reconciliation_observations()), len(self.feed))

        for result in second_pass:
            self.assertFalse(result.applied)
            self.assertEqual(result.reject_reason, models.ObservationRejectReason.DUPLICATE)

        # State changes from the first pass were not re-applied or reverted.
        self.assertEqual(
            self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-a").delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-b").delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED
        )
        self.assertTrue(any(r.applied for r in first_pass))

    def test_out_of_order_sequence_for_same_attempt_is_rejected(self):
        first = self.engine.ingest_observation(
            attempt_id="riverbend-attempt-2201",
            organization_id="org-riverbend",
            account_id="acct-delay-a",
            provider_state="accepted_delayed",
            observed_at="2026-08-30T01:07:00Z",
            sequence=100,
            now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z",
        )
        self.assertTrue(first.applied)
        self.assertIsNone(first.reject_reason)

        second = self.engine.ingest_observation(
            attempt_id="riverbend-attempt-2201",
            organization_id="org-riverbend",
            account_id="acct-delay-a",
            provider_state="accepted_delayed",
            observed_at="2026-08-30T01:07:00Z",
            sequence=50,
            now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z",
        )
        self.assertFalse(second.applied)
        self.assertEqual(second.reject_reason, models.ObservationRejectReason.OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-a").delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED
        )

    def test_observation_with_wrong_organization_is_rejected_without_state_change(self):
        result = self.engine.ingest_observation(
            attempt_id="riverbend-attempt-2202",
            organization_id="org-other",
            account_id="acct-delay-b",
            provider_state="delivered",
            observed_at="2026-08-30T01:12:00Z",
            sequence=1,
            now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z",
        )
        self.assertFalse(result.applied)
        self.assertEqual(result.reject_reason, models.ObservationRejectReason.ORGANIZATION_MISMATCH)
        self.assertEqual(result.matched_notification_id, "notif-acct-delay-b")
        self.assertEqual(
            self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-b").delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED
        )

    def test_malformed_transition_from_terminal_state_is_rejected(self):
        closed = self.engine.ingest_observation(
            attempt_id="riverbend-attempt-2202",
            organization_id="org-riverbend",
            account_id="acct-delay-b",
            provider_state="delivered",
            observed_at="2026-08-30T01:12:00Z",
            sequence=1,
            now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z",
        )
        self.assertTrue(closed.applied)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-b").delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED
        )

        reopen_attempt = self.engine.ingest_observation(
            attempt_id="riverbend-attempt-2202",
            organization_id="org-riverbend",
            account_id="acct-delay-b",
            provider_state="accepted_delayed",
            observed_at="2026-08-30T01:13:00Z",
            sequence=2,
            now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z",
        )
        self.assertFalse(reopen_attempt.applied)
        self.assertEqual(reopen_attempt.reject_reason, models.ObservationRejectReason.MALFORMED_TRANSITION)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-b").delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Reconciliation tests driven by the riverbend delayed-delivery fixtures."""
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from accountsvc import fixtures, models
from accountsvc.reconciliation import ReconciliationEngine, WindowPolicy
from accountsvc.storage import Storage

FIXTURE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "fixtures" / "provider-s02"
ACCOUNTS_YAML = FIXTURE_DIR / "accounts-riverbend.yaml"
WINDOWS_CSV = FIXTURE_DIR / "delayed-delivery-window.csv"
FEED_JSONL = FIXTURE_DIR / "reconciliation-feed.jsonl"


class RiverbendFixtureLoadingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_accounts_yaml_parses_expected_shape(self):
        data = fixtures.load_riverbend_accounts(str(ACCOUNTS_YAML))
        self.assertEqual(data["organization_id"], "org-riverbend")
        self.assertEqual(len(data["accounts"]), 2)
        first = data["accounts"][0]
        self.assertEqual(first["account_id"], "acct-delay-a")
        self.assertIs(first["mfa_enabled"], True)
        self.assertEqual(first["delivery_state"], "accepted_delayed")

    def test_window_csv_parses_three_rows(self):
        rows = fixtures.load_delivery_windows(str(WINDOWS_CSV))
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 3)
        self.assertEqual(rows[0]["reconciliation_class"], "retain_unresolved")

    def test_feed_jsonl_parses_including_unmatched_null_account(self):
        records = fixtures.load_reconciliation_feed(str(FEED_JSONL))
        self.assertEqual(len(records), 3)
        unmatched = [r for r in records if r["account_id"] is None]
        self.assertEqual(len(unmatched), 1)
        self.assertEqual(unmatched[0]["provider_state"], "unknown")
        self.assertIsInstance(records[0]["sequence"], int)


class RiverbendReconciliationScenarioTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        fd, self.path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
        os.close(fd)
        os.remove(self.path)
        self.store = Storage(self.path)
        self.addCleanup(self._cleanup)

        # Maps each seeded account to the provider attempt id its notification
        # was sent under, matching reconciliation-feed.jsonl's attempt_id
        # values exactly -- this is what lets the feed's observations match
        # back to these notifications by attempt id rather than by account.
        attempt_id_by_account = {
            "acct-delay-a": "riverbend-attempt-2201",
            "acct-delay-b": "riverbend-attempt-2202",
        }

        accounts_data = fixtures.load_riverbend_accounts(str(ACCOUNTS_YAML))
        self.org_id = accounts_data["organization_id"]
        for entry in accounts_data["accounts"]:
            self.store.create_account(
                organization_id=self.org_id,
                account_id=entry["account_id"],
                email=entry["current_email"],
                display_name=entry["display_name"],
                mfa_enabled=entry["mfa_enabled"],
                email_status=entry["email_status"],
                now="t0",
            )
            self.store.create_recovery_request(
                request_id=f"req-{entry['account_id']}",
                organization_id=self.org_id,
                account_id=entry["account_id"],
                token_hash="unused",
                created_at="t0",
                expires_at="2099-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
            )
            self.store.create_notification(
                notification_id=f"notif-{entry['account_id']}",
                request_id=f"req-{entry['account_id']}",
                account_id=entry["account_id"],
                recipient=entry["current_email"],
                delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED,
                provider_receipt=f"riverbend-attempt-seed-{entry['account_id']}",
                reconciliation_id=attempt_id_by_account[entry["account_id"]],
                retry_locator=None,
                now="t0",
            )

        windows = fixtures.load_delivery_windows(str(WINDOWS_CSV))
        self.policy = WindowPolicy.from_rows(windows)
        self.engine = ReconciliationEngine(self.store, self.policy)
        self.feed = fixtures.load_reconciliation_feed(str(FEED_JSONL))

    def _cleanup(self):
        self.store.close()
        for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
            candidate = self.path + suffix
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                os.remove(candidate)

    def test_delayed_observation_within_bound_is_retained_unresolved_and_fresh(self):
        # acct-delay-a observed 2026-08-30T01:07:00Z, max_age_minutes=30 for accepted_delayed.
        self.engine.ingest_feed(self.feed, now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z")

        observations = self.store.reconciliation_observations(account_id="acct-delay-a")
        self.assertEqual(len(observations), 1)
        self.assertEqual(observations[0].reconciliation_class, models.ReconciliationClass.RETAIN_UNRESOLVED)
        self.assertFalse(observations[0].is_stale)

        notification = self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-a")
        self.assertEqual(notification.delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED)

    def test_delayed_observation_past_bound_is_flagged_stale(self):
        self.engine.ingest_feed(self.feed, now="2026-08-30T02:00:00Z")

        observations = self.store.reconciliation_observations(account_id="acct-delay-a")
        self.assertTrue(observations[0].is_stale)

    def test_delivered_observation_closes_out_the_notification(self):
        self.engine.ingest_feed(self.feed, now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z")

        observations = self.store.reconciliation_observations(account_id="acct-delay-b")
        self.assertEqual(observations[0].reconciliation_class, models.ReconciliationClass.CLOSE_CONFIRMED)

        notification = self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-b")
        self.assertEqual(notification.delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED)

    def test_unmatched_observation_is_recorded_for_review_without_an_account(self):
        self.engine.ingest_feed(self.feed, now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z")

        all_observations = self.store.reconciliation_observations()
        unmatched = [o for o in all_observations if o.account_id is None]
        self.assertEqual(len(unmatched), 1)
        self.assertEqual(unmatched[0].reconciliation_class, models.ReconciliationClass.REVIEW_UNMATCHED)
        self.assertEqual(unmatched[0].organization_id, "org-riverbend")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Two-process test: reconciliation import state survives a service restart.

Out-of-order rejection depends on the highest sequence already seen for a
given provider attempt id. That history must live in SQLite, not in the
memory of whichever `serve` process happened to see it first. This spins
up a real `serve` subprocess wired with a window policy, imports an
observation for a known attempt through the authenticated
`/reconciliation/import` route, kills that process, starts a brand new one
against the same database file, and confirms a stale (lower-sequence)
replay for the same attempt is still correctly rejected as out of order.
"""
import json
import os
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

from accountsvc.storage import Storage

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
WINDOW_POLICY_CSV = PROJECT_ROOT / "fixtures" / "provider-s02" / "delayed-delivery-window.csv"
BEARER_TOKEN = "reconciliation-restart-admin-token"  # noqa: S105 - fixture credential, not a real secret
READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10.0


def _free_port() -> int:
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


def _wait_until_ready(host: str, port: int, timeout: float = READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) -> None:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    last_error = None
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        try:
            with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=0.2):
                return
        except OSError as exc:
            last_error = exc
            time.sleep(0.1)
    raise TimeoutError(f"server on {host}:{port} did not become ready: {last_error}")


def _post(base_url: str, path: str, payload: dict, *, token: str):
    body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        base_url + path, data=body, method="POST", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
            return response.status, json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        with exc:
            return exc.code, json.loads(exc.read().decode("utf-8"))


class ReconciliationRestartTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        fd, self.db_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
        os.close(fd)
        os.remove(self.db_path)

        # Seed an account, recovery request, and a notification with a known
        # reconciliation id directly -- reconciliation import does not
        # depend on ever having sent mail, only on a notification existing
        # under that attempt id.
        store = Storage(self.db_path)
        store.create_account(
            organization_id="org-riverbend", account_id="acct-delay-a", email="priya@riverbend.example", now="t0"
        )
        store.create_recovery_request(
            request_id="req-restart-1",
            organization_id="org-riverbend",
            account_id="acct-delay-a",
            token_hash="unused",
            created_at="t0",
            expires_at="2099-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
        )
        store.create_notification(
            notification_id="notif-restart-1",
            request_id="req-restart-1",
            account_id="acct-delay-a",
            recipient="priya@riverbend.example",
            delivery_state="accepted_delayed",
            provider_receipt="seed-receipt",
            reconciliation_id="restart-attempt-1",
            retry_locator=None,
            now="t0",
        )
        store.close()

        self.processes = []
        self.addCleanup(self._cleanup)

    def _cleanup(self):
        for process in self.processes:
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.terminate()

import os

def _free_port() -> int:
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


def _wait_until_ready(host: str, port: int, timeout: float = READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) -> None:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    last_error = None
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        try:
            with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=0.2):
                return
        except OSError as exc:
            last_error = exc
            time.sleep(0.1)
    raise TimeoutError(f"server on {host}:{port} did not become ready: {last_error}")


def _post(base_url: str, path: str, payload: dict, *, token: str):
    body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        base_url + path, data=body, method="POST", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
            return response.status, json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))

        with exc:

content.text:
All 67 tests pass. Summary of what was added:

**Matching by provider attempt id** (`accountsvc/storage.py`, `reconciliation.py`): observations now match a notification strictly via `find_notification_by_reconciliation_id` — the opaque id we minted and sent to the provider, surfaced back as the feed row's `attempt_id`. The feed's own claimed `account_id`/`organization_id` are never trusted for lookup, only checked against the matched notification's true owner. This replaced the old "most recent open notification for this account" heuristic, which didn't actually verify which attempt an observation was about.

**Rejected malformed transitions**: a `RETAIN_UNRESOLVED` observation arriving for a notification already `DELIVERED` (terminal) is refused as `malformed_transition` rather than reopening it. `CLOSE_CONFIRMED` remains legal from any state.

**Unknown rows kept for review**: an observation whose `attempt_id` matches no notification is persisted with `reject_reason=unmatched_attempt_id` and no state change — same for organization mismatches (`organization_mismatch`) and stale, out-of-order sequence numbers (`out_of_order_sequence`), all newly tracked via `matched_notification_id`/`applied`/`reject_reason` columns on `reconciliation_observations`.

**Duplicate feed pages**: re-importing the exact same `(attempt_id, sequence)` row is detected up front and short-circuited to a `duplicate` result, never re-applying a transition.

**Authenticated reconciliation command**: a new bearer-gated `POST /reconciliation/import` route (`accountsvc/httpapi.py`), wired up via a new optional `serve --window-policy PATH` CLI flag (`accountsvc/cli.py`) that builds a `ReconciliationEngine` sharing the server's `Storage`; returns 503 if reconciliation isn't configured, 401 if unauthenticated.

**Tests**: engine-level tests for duplicate pages, out-of-order sequences, wrong organizations, and malformed transitions (`tests/test_reconciliation.py`); HTTP-level auth/wiring tests (`tests/test_httpapi.py`); and a two-process subprocess test (`tests/test_reconciliation_restart.py`) proving the persisted max-sequence-per-attempt survives a `serve` restart and correctly rejects a stale replay that the new process never saw in memory. The existing riverbend scenario tests were updated to seed notifications with `reconciliation_id`s matching the fixture feed's `attempt_id`s, since that's now the authoritative match key.

Read each discovered file completely. Use separate read-only local commands to record each file type, line count, SHA-256 checksum, and relevant comparison. Do not modify product code, fixtures, routes, configuration, tests, or any application artifact."

Read each discovered file completely. Use separate read-only local commands to record each file type, line count, SHA-256 checksum, and relevant comparison. Do not infer facts that the sources do not state. Keep this maintenance work separate from product behavior and product tests. Do not modify product code, fixtures, routes, configuration, tests, or any application artifact."

   **Request C (product feature, completed):** "Add import and validation for provider reconciliation feeds. Match observations by provider attempt id, reject malformed transitions, and keep unknown rows for operator review without changing recovery state. Expose an authenticated reconciliation command. Test duplicate feed pages, out-of-order observations, wrong organizations, and restarts."

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Maintenance-review discipline (established in prior turns, reapplied here): discover all files via `find`, read each completely, record file type (`file` command), line count (`wc -l`), SHA-256 (`sha256sum`), normalize each source into `case,system,status` lines via `sed`/`awk` (stripping CRLF for `.md`/`.yaml` sources), then `diff` over shared case-ID ranges — every claim tied to a source filename, no inference beyond what sources state, and reports written only under `maintenance/reports/provider-s02/`, never touching product code/fixtures/tests.
   - **Provider attempt id matching (core of Request C):** Notifications carry a locally-minted `reconciliation_id` sent to the mail provider; when a provider reconciliation feed later reports on a delivery attempt via its own `attempt_id` field, that `attempt_id` is defined to equal the `reconciliation_id` we originally minted. Matching must be done by looking up `notifications.reconciliation_id == attempt_id`, **never** by "most recent open notification for an account" (the prior/incorrect design) and never by trusting the feed's own claimed `account_id`/`organization_id` fields for authorization — this mirrors the established "trusted account binding" pattern from `notice.py` (never trust caller-supplied identifiers as authoritative; always re-derive from the trusted stored row).
   - **Organization-mismatch defense:** even when `attempt_id` correctly matches a notification, the feed row's claimed `organization_id` must be cross-checked against the *true* organization (fetched via `store.get_account(notification.account_id).organization_id`) — a mismatch is rejected without any state change, guarding against a feed for one org claiming an attempt that actually belongs to another org.
   - **Out-of-order sequence enforcement:** per `attempt_id`, a new observation is rejected (not applied) if its `sequence` is less than or equal to the highest `sequence` already recorded for that `attempt_id` (computed via `MAX(sequence)` in SQLite, so it's durable across restarts, not in-memory).
   - **Malformed transition rejection:** a `RETAIN_UNRESOLVED`-class observation (meaning "still delayed") arriving for a notification whose `delivery_state` is already in `models.DeliveryState.TERMINAL` (i.e., already `DELIVERED`) is rejected as a backward/malformed transition rather than reopening a confirmed-closed notification. `CLOSE_CONFIRMED` transitions are always considered legal (idempotent no-op if already `DELIVERED`).
   - **Duplicate feed-page idempotency:** exact `(attempt_id, sequence)` pairs are checked via `find_observation` *before* any matching/transition logic runs; if the pair was already recorded, the call is a no-op that echoes back the originally recorded result (with `reject_reason=DUPLICATE`), guaranteeing that replaying an entire feed page twice cannot double-apply a state transition.
   - **Keeping unknown rows for operator review without changing state:** if `attempt_id` matches no notification at all, the observation is still durably recorded (with `matched_notification_id=None`, `applied=False`, `reject_reason=UNMATCHED_ATTEMPT_ID`) but no notification is touched.
   - **Authenticated reconciliation command:** exposed as a bearer-token-gated HTTP route `POST /reconciliation/import` (following the same administrative-action convention as the pre-existing `/recovery/notifications/retry`), rather than changing the existing unauthenticated local-file-based CLI `reconcile` subcommand's security model.
   - Two-process subprocess restart testing pattern (reused from the earlier TTL-restart test): spin up a real `serve` subprocess, exercise behavior, kill it, start a fresh subprocess against the same SQLite file, and confirm behavior that depends on durable state (here: the out-of-order sequence rejection) still holds — proving the relevant history is persisted in SQLite and not held in any process's memory.
   - Argparse-based CLI extension pattern: new optional flags appended at the end of existing subparsers to preserve "stable CLI shapes" (per the docstring comment in `cli.py`), e.g. `--window-policy` added after `--recovery-ttl-seconds` on the `serve` subparser, defaulting to `None` so existing invocations (e.g., in `test_ttl_restart.py`) remain valid without it.
   - `dataclasses.asdict()` used to serialize `IngestResult` objects to JSON in both the CLI `reconcile` command and the new HTTP `/reconciliation/import` response — adding new dataclass fields is backward-compatible with this serialization.

"""Two-process test: reconciliation import state survives a service restart.

Out-of-order rejection depends on the highest sequence already seen for a
given provider attempt id. That history must live in SQLite, not in the
memory of whichever `serve` process happened to see it first. This spins
up a real `serve` subprocess wired with a window policy, imports an
observation for a known attempt through the authenticated
`/reconciliation/import` route, kills that process, starts a brand new one
against the same database file, and confirms a stale (lower-sequence)
replay for the same attempt is still correctly rejected as out of order.
"""
import json
import os
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

from accountsvc.storage import Storage

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
WINDOW_POLICY_CSV = PROJECT_ROOT / "fixtures" / "provider-s02" / "delayed-delivery-window.csv"
BEARER_TOKEN = "reconciliation-restart-admin-token"  # noqa: S105 - fixture credential, not a real secret
READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10.0


def _free_port() -> int:
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


def _wait_until_ready(host: str, port: int, timeout: float = READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) -> None:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    last_error = None
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        try:
            with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=0.2):
                return
        except OSError as exc:
            last_error = exc
            time.sleep(0.1)
    raise TimeoutError(f"server on {host}:{port} did not become ready: {last_error}")


def _post(base_url: str, path: str, payload: dict, *, token: str):
    body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        base_url + path, data=body, method="POST", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
            return response.status, json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        with exc:
            return exc.code, json.loads(exc.read().decode("utf-8"))


class ReconciliationRestartTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        fd, self.db_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
        os.close(fd)
        os.remove(self.db_path)

        # Seed an account, recovery request, and a notification with a known
        # reconciliation id directly -- reconciliation import does not
        # depend on ever having sent mail, only on a notification existing
        # under that attempt id.
        store = Storage(self.db_path)
        store.create_account(
            organization_id="org-riverbend", account_id="acct-delay-a", email="priya@riverbend.example", now="t0"
        )
        store.create_recovery_request(
            request_id="req-restart-1",
            organization_id="org-riverbend",
            account_id="acct-delay-a",
            token_hash="unused",
            created_at="t0",
            expires_at="2099-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
        )
        store.create_notification(
            notification_id="notif-restart-1",
            request_id="req-restart-1",
            account_id="acct-delay-a",
            recipient="priya@riverbend.example",
            delivery_state="accepted_delayed",
            provider_receipt="seed-receipt",
            reconciliation_id="restart-attempt-1",
            retry_locator=None,
            now="t0",
        )
        store.close()

        self.processes = []
        self.addCleanup(self._cleanup)

    def _cleanup(self):
        for process in self.processes:
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.terminate()
                try:
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    process.kill()
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
        for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
            candidate = self.db_path + suffix
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                os.remove(candidate)

    def _start_serve_process(self, *, port: int) -> str:
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            [
                sys.executable,
                "-m",
                "accountsvc.cli",
                "serve",
                "--database",
                self.db_path,
                "--bearer-token",
                BEARER_TOKEN,
                "--mail-endpoint",
                "http://127.0.0.1:1/unused",
                "--host",
                "127.0.0.1",
                "--port",
                str(port),
                "--window-policy",
                str(WINDOW_POLICY_CSV),
            ],
            cwd=str(PROJECT_ROOT),
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        )
        self.processes.append(process)
        _wait_until_ready("127.0.0.1", port)
        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"

    def test_out_of_order_rejection_survives_a_process_restart(self):
        first_port = _free_port()
        base_url = self._start_serve_process(port=first_port)

        status, payload = _post(
            base_url,
            "/reconciliation/import",
            {
                "observations": [
                    {
                        "attempt_id": "restart-attempt-1",
                        "organization_id": "org-riverbend",
                        "account_id": "acct-delay-a",
                        "provider_state": "accepted_delayed",
                        "observed_at": "2026-08-30T01:07:00Z",
                        "sequence": 100,
                    }
                ],
                "now": "2026-08-30T01:17:00Z",
            },
            token=BEARER_TOKEN,
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertTrue(payload["results"][0]["applied"])
        self.assertIsNone(payload["results"][0]["reject_reason"])

        first_process = self.processes[0]
        first_process.terminate()
        first_process.wait(timeout=5)

        second_port = _free_port()
        restarted_base_url = self._start_serve_process(port=second_port)

        # A stale replay carrying a lower sequence than what process 1
        # already recorded must still be rejected as out of order -- this
        # only holds if the max-sequence-per-attempt history was durably
        # persisted, since process 2 never saw sequence 100 in memory.
        status, payload = _post(
            restarted_base_url,
            "/reconciliation/import",
            {
                "observations": [
                    {
                        "attempt_id": "restart-attempt-1",
                        "organization_id": "org-riverbend",
                        "account_id": "acct-delay-a",
                        "provider_state": "accepted_delayed",
                        "observed_at": "2026-08-30T01:06:00Z",
                        "sequence": 50,
                    }
                ],
                "now": "2026-08-30T01:17:00Z",
            },
            token=BEARER_TOKEN,
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertFalse(payload["results"][0]["applied"])
        self.assertEqual(payload["results"][0]["reject_reason"], "out_of_order_sequence")

        # Unauthenticated access to the administrative route is still
        # refused after the restart.
        body = json.dumps({"observations": []}).encode("utf-8")
        request = urllib.request.Request(restarted_base_url + "/reconciliation/import", data=body, method="POST")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
                status = response.status
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            with exc:
                status = exc.code
        self.assertEqual(status, 401)

class BoundedInputTests(HttpApiTestCase):
    def test_missing_content_length_is_rejected(self):
        # urllib always supplies Content-Length for POST bodies, so drive a
        # raw socket to exercise a request that genuinely omits the header.
        host, port = self.server.server_address
        with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=5) as sock:
            sock.sendall(
                b"POST /recovery/start HTTP/1.1\r\n"
                b"Host: 127.0.0.1\r\n"
                b"Content-Type: application/json\r\n"
                b"Connection: close\r\n"
                b"\r\n"
            )
            response = b""
            while True:
                chunk = sock.recv(4096)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                response += chunk
        status_line = response.split(b"\r\n", 1)[0].decode("utf-8")
        self.assertIn("411", status_line)

    def test_oversized_body_is_rejected(self):
        status, payload = self._post(
            "/recovery/start", raw_body=b"x" * (16_384 + 1), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 413)

    def test_malformed_json_is_rejected(self):
        status, payload = self._post(
            "/recovery/start", raw_body=b"{not-json", headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)

    def test_missing_fields_are_rejected(self):
        status, payload = self._post("/recovery/start", {"organization": "org-riverbend"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)

class ReconciliationFeedValidationTests(RiverbendReconciliationScenarioTests):
    """Import/validation rules: attempt-id matching, ordering, and duplicates."""

    def test_duplicate_feed_page_replay_is_idempotent(self):
        first_pass = self.engine.ingest_feed(self.feed, now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z")
        second_pass = self.engine.ingest_feed(self.feed, now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z")

        # No duplicate rows: still exactly one observation per feed line.
        self.assertEqual(len(self.store.reconciliation_observations()), len(self.feed))

        for result in second_pass:
            self.assertFalse(result.applied)
            self.assertEqual(result.reject_reason, models.ObservationRejectReason.DUPLICATE)

        # State changes from the first pass were not re-applied or reverted.
        self.assertEqual(
            self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-a").delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-b").delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED
        )
        self.assertTrue(any(r.applied for r in first_pass))

    def test_out_of_order_sequence_for_same_attempt_is_rejected(self):
        first = self.engine.ingest_observation(
            attempt_id="riverbend-attempt-2201",

        )

    def test_observation_with_wrong_organization_is_rejected_without_state_change(self):

            self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-b").delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED

    def test_malformed_transition_from_terminal_state_is_rejected(self):
        closed = self.engine.ingest_observation(
            attempt_id="riverbend-attempt-2202",
            organization_id="org-riverbend",
            account_id="acct-delay-b",
            provider_state="delivered",
            observed_at="2026-08-30T01:12:00Z",
            sequence=1,
            now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z",
        )
        self.assertTrue(closed.applied)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-b").delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED
        )

        reopen_attempt = self.engine.ingest_observation(
            attempt_id="riverbend-attempt-2202",
            organization_id="org-riverbend",
            account_id="acct-delay-b",
            provider_state="accepted_delayed",
            observed_at="2026-08-30T01:13:00Z",
            sequence=2,
            now="2026-08-30T01:17:00Z",
        )
        self.assertFalse(reopen_attempt.applied)
        self.assertEqual(reopen_attempt.reject_reason, models.ObservationRejectReason.MALFORMED_TRANSITION)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.store.get_notification("notif-acct-delay-b").delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED
        )

"""Command-line entry point for accountsvc.

Stable CLI shapes (do not change these argument orders/flags):

    python -m accountsvc.cli create-account ORG_ID ACCOUNT_ID EMAIL --database STATE.db
    python -m accountsvc.cli change-email ACCOUNT_ID NEW_EMAIL --database STATE.db
    python -m accountsvc.cli show-account ACCOUNT_ID --database STATE.db
    python -m accountsvc.cli serve --database STATE.db --bearer-token TOKEN --mail-endpoint URL
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import dataclasses
import json
import sys
from typing import Optional, Sequence

from . import fixtures, reconciliation
from .mailer import Mailer
from .recovery import DEFAULT_RECOVERY_TTL_SECONDS, RecoveryService, now_iso
from .storage import ConflictError, NotFoundError, Storage, ValidationError


def _positive_int(value: str) -> int:
    try:
        parsed = int(value)
    except ValueError:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{value!r} is not an integer")
    if parsed <= 0:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{value!r} must be a positive integer")
    return parsed


def _account_to_dict(account) -> dict:
    return {
        "account_id": account.account_id,
        "organization_id": account.organization_id,
        "display_name": account.display_name,
        "current_email": account.current_email,
        "email_status": account.email_status,
        "mfa_enabled": account.mfa_enabled,
        "created_at": account.created_at,
        "updated_at": account.updated_at,
    }


def _cmd_create_account(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    store = Storage(args.database)
    try:
        store.create_account(
            organization_id=args.organization_id,
            account_id=args.account_id,
            email=args.email,
            display_name=args.display_name or args.account_id,
            mfa_enabled=args.mfa_enabled,
            now=now_iso(),
        )
    except (ValidationError, ConflictError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        store.close()
    print(json.dumps({"status": "created", "account_id": args.account_id}))
    return 0


def _cmd_change_email(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    store = Storage(args.database)
    try:
        account = store.change_email(account_id=args.account_id, new_email=args.new_email, now=now_iso())
    except (ValidationError, ConflictError, NotFoundError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        store.close()
    print(json.dumps(_account_to_dict(account)))
    return 0


def _cmd_show_account(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    store = Storage(args.database)
    try:
        account = store.get_account(args.account_id)
    except (ValidationError, NotFoundError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        store.close()
    print(json.dumps(_account_to_dict(account)))
    return 0


def _cmd_serve(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    from .httpapi import make_server

    store = Storage(args.database)
    mailer = Mailer(args.mail_endpoint)
    service = RecoveryService(store, mailer, recovery_ttl_seconds=args.recovery_ttl_seconds)

    reconciliation_engine = None
    if args.window_policy is not None:
        windows = fixtures.load_delivery_windows(args.window_policy)
        policy = reconciliation.WindowPolicy.from_rows(windows)
        reconciliation_engine = reconciliation.ReconciliationEngine(store, policy)

    server = make_server(
        host=args.host,
        port=args.port,
        recovery_service=service,
        bearer_token=args.bearer_token,
        reconciliation_engine=reconciliation_engine,
    )
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
        store.close()
    return 0


def _cmd_reconcile(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    store = Storage(args.database)
    try:
        windows = fixtures.load_delivery_windows(args.window_policy)
        feed = fixtures.load_reconciliation_feed(args.feed)
        policy = reconciliation.WindowPolicy.from_rows(windows)
        engine = reconciliation.ReconciliationEngine(store, policy)
        results = engine.ingest_feed(feed, now=args.now)
    except (ValidationError, ValueError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        store.close()
    print(json.dumps([dataclasses.asdict(r) for r in results]))
    return 0


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m accountsvc.cli")
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    create = subparsers.add_parser("create-account")
    create.add_argument("organization_id")
    create.add_argument("account_id")
    create.add_argument("email")
    create.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    create.add_argument("--display-name", default=None)
    create.add_argument("--mfa-enabled", action="store_true")
    create.set_defaults(func=_cmd_create_account)

    change = subparsers.add_parser("change-email")
    change.add_argument("account_id")
    change.add_argument("new_email")
    change.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    change.set_defaults(func=_cmd_change_email)

    show = subparsers.add_parser("show-account")
    show.add_argument("account_id")
    show.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    show.set_defaults(func=_cmd_show_account)

    serve = subparsers.add_parser("serve")
    serve.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--bearer-token", required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--mail-endpoint", required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    serve.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8765)
    serve.add_argument("--recovery-ttl-seconds", type=_positive_int, default=DEFAULT_RECOVERY_TTL_SECONDS)
    serve.add_argument("--window-policy", default=None)
    serve.set_defaults(func=_cmd_serve)

    reconcile = subparsers.add_parser("reconcile")
    reconcile.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    reconcile.add_argument("--window-policy", required=True)
    reconcile.add_argument("--feed", required=True)
    reconcile.add_argument("--now", default=None)
    reconcile.set_defaults(func=_cmd_reconcile)

    return parser


def main(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    return args.func(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Reconciliation of delayed-delivery provider observations.

A provider observation reports what the provider now believes happened
to a previously accepted delivery. The delayed-delivery window policy
maps each provider_state to a reconciliation_class and a staleness
threshold; ingesting an observation records it durably and, when it can
be tied to a known account, folds the outcome back into that account's
most recent notification.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Dict, Optional, Sequence

from . import models, storage
from .storage import Storage

MAX_ATTEMPT_ID_LENGTH = 256


def _parse_timestamp(value: str) -> datetime:
    normalized = value[:-1] + "+00:00" if value.endswith("Z") else value
    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(normalized)
    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
        parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return parsed


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Window:
    window_id: str
    window_start: datetime
    window_end: datetime
    provider_state: str
    reconciliation_class: str
    max_age_minutes: int


class WindowPolicy:
    """Maps a provider_state to its reconciliation class and staleness bound."""

    def __init__(self, windows: Sequence[Window]) -> None:
        self._by_provider_state: Dict[str, Window] = {w.provider_state: w for w in windows}

    @classmethod
    def from_rows(cls, rows: Sequence[dict]) -> "WindowPolicy":
        windows = [
            Window(
                window_id=row["window_id"],
                window_start=_parse_timestamp(row["window_start"]),
                window_end=_parse_timestamp(row["window_end"]),
                provider_state=row["provider_state"],
                reconciliation_class=row["reconciliation_class"],
                max_age_minutes=int(row["max_age_minutes"]),
            )
            for row in rows
        ]
        return cls(windows)

    def window_for(self, provider_state: str) -> Optional[Window]:
        return self._by_provider_state.get(provider_state)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class IngestResult:
    attempt_id: str
    sequence: int
    reconciliation_class: Optional[str]
    is_stale: Optional[bool]
    matched_notification_id: Optional[str]
    applied: bool
    reject_reason: Optional[str]


class ReconciliationEngine:
    """Applies provider reconciliation feeds against durably stored notifications.

    Observations are matched to a notification strictly by the opaque
    `reconciliation_id` this service minted and sent to the provider
    (surfaced back to us as the feed row's `attempt_id`) -- never by the
    feed's own claimed account/organization, which is treated as untrusted
    input to be validated against the matched notification's true owner.
    """

    def __init__(self, store: Storage, policy: WindowPolicy) -> None:
        self._store = store
        self._policy = policy

    def ingest_observation(
        self,
        *,
        attempt_id: str,
        organization_id: str,
        account_id: Optional[str],
        provider_state: str,
        observed_at: str,
        sequence: int,
        now: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> IngestResult:
        attempt_id = storage.require_bounded_text(attempt_id, name="attempt_id", max_length=MAX_ATTEMPT_ID_LENGTH)
        organization_id = storage.require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization_id")
        provider_state = storage.require_bounded_text(provider_state, name="provider_state", max_length=64)
        if account_id is not None:
            account_id = storage.require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
        if not isinstance(sequence, int) or isinstance(sequence, bool):
            raise storage.ValidationError("sequence must be an integer")

        observed_dt = _parse_timestamp(observed_at)
        reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        recorded_at = now or reference_dt.isoformat()

        window = self._policy.window_for(provider_state)
        reconciliation_class = window.reconciliation_class if window is not None else None
        is_stale: Optional[bool] = None
        if window is not None:
            age_minutes = (reference_dt - observed_dt).total_seconds() / 60.0
            is_stale = age_minutes > window.max_age_minutes

        existing = self._store.find_observation(attempt_id=attempt_id, sequence=sequence)
        if existing is not None:
            # A duplicate feed-page replay: the exact (attempt_id, sequence)
            # pair was already recorded, so re-applying it would risk a
            # double transition. Echo back what was recorded the first time.
            return IngestResult(
                attempt_id=attempt_id,
                sequence=sequence,
                reconciliation_class=existing.reconciliation_class,
                is_stale=existing.is_stale,
                matched_notification_id=existing.matched_notification_id,
                applied=False,
                reject_reason=models.ObservationRejectReason.DUPLICATE,
            )

        matched_notification_id: Optional[str] = None
        applied = False
        reject_reason: Optional[str] = None

        notification = self._store.find_notification_by_reconciliation_id(attempt_id)
        if notification is None:
            reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.UNMATCHED_ATTEMPT_ID
        else:
            matched_notification_id = notification.notification_id
            account = self._store.get_account(notification.account_id)
            if account.organization_id != organization_id:
                reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.ORGANIZATION_MISMATCH
            else:
                max_seen = self._store.max_sequence_for_attempt(attempt_id)
                if max_seen is not None and sequence <= max_seen:
                    reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE
                elif reconciliation_class == models.ReconciliationClass.CLOSE_CONFIRMED:
                    self._store.set_notification_delivery_state(
                        notification_id=notification.notification_id,
                        delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED,
                        now=recorded_at,
                    )
                    applied = True
                elif reconciliation_class == models.ReconciliationClass.RETAIN_UNRESOLVED:
                    if notification.delivery_state in models.DeliveryState.TERMINAL:
                        # Provider is trying to reopen a delivery we already
                        # confirmed closed out -- a backward, malformed
                        # transition. Leave the notification untouched.
                        reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.MALFORMED_TRANSITION
                    else:
                        self._store.set_notification_delivery_state(
                            notification_id=notification.notification_id,
                            delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED,
                            now=recorded_at,
                        )
                        applied = True
                # Any other class (REVIEW_UNMATCHED, or no window at all)
                # carries no notification-state action by design.

        self._store.record_reconciliation_observation(
            attempt_id=attempt_id,
            organization_id=organization_id,
            account_id=account_id,
            provider_state=provider_state,
            observed_at=observed_at,
            sequence=sequence,
            reconciliation_class=reconciliation_class,
            is_stale=is_stale,
            matched_notification_id=matched_notification_id,
            applied=applied,
            reject_reason=reject_reason,
            now=recorded_at,
        )

        return IngestResult(
            attempt_id=attempt_id,
            sequence=sequence,
            reconciliation_class=reconciliation_class,
            is_stale=is_stale,
            matched_notification_id=matched_notification_id,
            applied=applied,
            reject_reason=reject_reason,
        )

    def ingest_feed(self, observations: Sequence[dict], *, now: Optional[str] = None) -> list:
        return [
            self.ingest_observation(
                attempt_id=obs["attempt_id"],
                organization_id=obs["organization_id"],
                account_id=obs.get("account_id"),
                provider_state=obs["provider_state"],
                observed_at=obs["observed_at"],
                sequence=obs["sequence"],
                now=now,
            )
            for obs in observations
        ]

"""Domain model constants and lightweight records for accountsvc.

Kept as plain dataclasses/string enums (stdlib only) so storage.py and the
service layers share one vocabulary for delivery and reconciliation states.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional


class EmailStatus:
    VERIFIED = "verified"
    UNVERIFIED = "unverified"

    ALL = frozenset({VERIFIED, UNVERIFIED})


class DeliveryState:
    """Lifecycle of a single notification attempt.

    accepted_delayed and delivered come from the mail provider's own
    response; failed is a local classification requiring retry; retrying
    marks a delivery currently being replayed through notice locators.
    """

    PENDING = "pending"
    DELIVERED = "delivered"
    ACCEPTED_DELAYED = "accepted_delayed"
    FAILED = "failed"
    RETRYING = "retrying"

    ALL = frozenset({PENDING, DELIVERED, ACCEPTED_DELAYED, FAILED, RETRYING})
    RETRYABLE = frozenset({FAILED, RETRYING})
    TERMINAL = frozenset({DELIVERED})


class RecoveryRequestStatus:
    PENDING = "pending"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    EXPIRED = "expired"

    ALL = frozenset({PENDING, COMPLETED, EXPIRED})


class ReconciliationClass:
    RETAIN_UNRESOLVED = "retain_unresolved"
    CLOSE_CONFIRMED = "close_confirmed"
    REVIEW_UNMATCHED = "review_unmatched"

    ALL = frozenset({RETAIN_UNRESOLVED, CLOSE_CONFIRMED, REVIEW_UNMATCHED})


class ObservationRejectReason:
    """Why a provider observation was recorded but not applied to a notification."""

    UNMATCHED_ATTEMPT_ID = "unmatched_attempt_id"
    ORGANIZATION_MISMATCH = "organization_mismatch"
    OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE = "out_of_order_sequence"
    MALFORMED_TRANSITION = "malformed_transition"
    DUPLICATE = "duplicate"

    ALL = frozenset(
        {UNMATCHED_ATTEMPT_ID, ORGANIZATION_MISMATCH, OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE, MALFORMED_TRANSITION, DUPLICATE}
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Organization:
    organization_id: str
    created_at: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Account:
    account_id: str
    organization_id: str
    display_name: str
    current_email: str
    email_status: str
    mfa_enabled: bool
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EmailHistoryEntry:
    account_id: str
    organization_id: str
    email: str
    effective_from: str
    effective_to: Optional[str]
    is_current: bool


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RecoveryRequest:
    request_id: str
    organization_id: str
    account_id: str
    token_hash: str
    created_at: str
    expires_at: str
    used_at: Optional[str]
    status: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Notification:
    notification_id: str
    request_id: str

1	"""SQLite-backed durable storage for accountsvc.
2	
3	Every write commits before returning (WAL journal + FULL sync) and all
4	access goes through a single lock so concurrent HTTP handlers never
5	interleave statements on the shared connection. There is no in-memory
6	cache anywhere in this module: every read re-queries SQLite, so a read
7	always observes the latest committed write (durable reads).
8	"""
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import sqlite3
12	import threading
13	from typing import Optional, Sequence

106	class ValidationError(ValueError):
107	    """Raised when caller-supplied data fails bounded-input checks."""
108	
109	
110	class NotFoundError(LookupError):
111	    """Raised when a lookup does not resolve to a stored row."""
112	
113	
114	class ConflictError(RuntimeError):
115	    """Raised when a write would violate a uniqueness/ownership rule."""
116	
117	
118	def require_bounded_text(value: object, *, name: str, max_length: int, allow_empty: bool = False) -> str:
119	    if not isinstance(value, str):
120	        raise ValidationError(f"{name} must be a string")
121	    if not allow_empty and not value:
122	        raise ValidationError(f"{name} must not be empty")
123	    if len(value) > max_length:
124	        raise ValidationError(f"{name} exceeds maximum length of {max_length}")
125	    if any(ch in ("\x00",) for ch in value):
126	        raise ValidationError(f"{name} contains an invalid character")
127	    return value
128	
129	
130	def require_identifier(value: object, *, name: str) -> str:
131	    return require_bounded_text(value, name=name, max_length=MAX_IDENTIFIER_LENGTH)
132	
133	
134	def require_email(value: object, *, name: str = "email") -> str:
135	    text = require_bounded_text(value, name=name, max_length=MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH)
136	    if "@" not in text or text.startswith("@") or text.endswith("@"):
137	        raise ValidationError(f"{name} must be a valid email address")
138	    return text

141	class Storage:
142	    """Owns the sqlite3 connection and enforces the schema-level invariants."""
143	
144	    def __init__(self, database_path: str) -> None:
145	        self._lock = threading.RLock()
146	        self._conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, check_same_thread=False)
147	        self._conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
148	        with self._lock:
149	            self._conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
150	            self._conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
151	            self._conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
152	            self._conn.executescript(_SCHEMA)
153	            self._conn.commit()
154	
155	    def close(self) -> None:
156	        with self._lock:
157	            self._conn.close()

167	            )
