95	class ReconciliationEngine:
96	    """Applies provider reconciliation feeds against durably stored notifications.
97	
98	    Observations are matched to a notification strictly by the opaque
99	    `reconciliation_id` this service minted and sent to the provider
100	    (surfaced back to us as the feed row's `attempt_id`) -- never by the
101	    feed's own claimed account/organization, which is treated as untrusted
102	    input to be validated against the matched notification's true owner.
103	    """
104	
105	    def __init__(self, store: Storage, policy: WindowPolicy) -> None:
106	        self._store = store
107	        self._policy = policy
108	
109	    def ingest_observation(
110	        self,
111	        *,
112	        attempt_id: str,
113	        organization_id: str,
114	        account_id: Optional[str],
115	        provider_state: str,
116	        observed_at: str,
117	        sequence: int,
118	        now: Optional[str] = None,
119	    ) -> IngestResult:
120	        attempt_id = storage.require_bounded_text(attempt_id, name="attempt_id", max_length=MAX_ATTEMPT_ID_LENGTH)
121	        organization_id = storage.require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization_id")
122	        provider_state = storage.require_bounded_text(provider_state, name="provider_state", max_length=64)
123	        if account_id is not None:
124	            account_id = storage.require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
125	        if not isinstance(sequence, int) or isinstance(sequence, bool):
126	            raise storage.ValidationError("sequence must be an integer")
127	
128	        observed_dt = _parse_timestamp(observed_at)
129	        reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
130	        recorded_at = now or reference_dt.isoformat()
131	
132	        window = self._policy.window_for(provider_state)
133	        reconciliation_class = window.reconciliation_class if window is not None else None
134	        is_stale: Optional[bool] = None
135	        if window is not None:
136	            age_minutes = (reference_dt - observed_dt).total_seconds() / 60.0
137	            is_stale = age_minutes > window.max_age_minutes
138	
139	        existing = self._store.find_observation(attempt_id=attempt_id, sequence=sequence)
140	        if existing is not None:
141	            # A duplicate feed-page replay: the exact (attempt_id, sequence)
142	            # pair was already recorded, so re-applying it would risk a
143	            # double transition. Echo back what was recorded the first time.
144	            return IngestResult(
145	                attempt_id=attempt_id,
146	                sequence=sequence,
147	                reconciliation_class=existing.reconciliation_class,
148	                is_stale=existing.is_stale,
149	                matched_notification_id=existing.matched_notification_id,
150	                applied=False,
151	                reject_reason=models.ObservationRejectReason.DUPLICATE,
152	            )
153	
154	        matched_notification_id: Optional[str] = None
155	        applied = False
156	        reject_reason: Optional[str] = None
157	
158	        notification = self._store.find_notification_by_reconciliation_id(attempt_id)
159	        if notification is None:
160	            reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.UNMATCHED_ATTEMPT_ID
161	        else:
162	            matched_notification_id = notification.notification_id
163	            account = self._store.get_account(notification.account_id)
164	            if account.organization_id != organization_id:
165	                reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.ORGANIZATION_MISMATCH
166	            else:
167	                max_seen = self._store.max_sequence_for_attempt(attempt_id)
168	                if max_seen is not None and sequence <= max_seen:
169	                    reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE
170	                elif reconciliation_class == models.ReconciliationClass.CLOSE_CONFIRMED:
171	                    self._store.set_notification_delivery_state(
172	                        notification_id=notification.notification_id,
173	                        delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED,
174	                        now=recorded_at,
175	                    )
176	                    applied = True
177	                elif reconciliation_class == models.ReconciliationClass.RETAIN_UNRESOLVED:
178	                    if notification.delivery_state in models.DeliveryState.TERMINAL:
179	                        # Provider is trying to reopen a delivery we already
180	                        # confirmed closed out -- a backward, malformed
181	                        # transition. Leave the notification untouched.
182	                        reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.MALFORMED_TRANSITION
183	                    else:
184	                        self._store.set_notification_delivery_state(
185	                            notification_id=notification.notification_id,
186	                            delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED,
187	                            now=recorded_at,
188	                        )
189	                        applied = True
190	                # Any other class (REVIEW_UNMATCHED, or no window at all)
191	                # carries no notification-state action by design.
192	
193	        self._store.record_reconciliation_observation(
194	            attempt_id=attempt_id,
195	            organization_id=organization_id,
196	            account_id=account_id,
197	            provider_state=provider_state,
198	            observed_at=observed_at,
199	            sequence=sequence,
200	            reconciliation_class=reconciliation_class,
201	            is_stale=is_stale,
202	            matched_notification_id=matched_notification_id,
203	            applied=applied,
204	            reject_reason=reject_reason,
205	            now=recorded_at,
206	        )
207	
208	        return IngestResult(
209	            attempt_id=attempt_id,
210	            sequence=sequence,
211	            reconciliation_class=reconciliation_class,
212	            is_stale=is_stale,
213	            matched_notification_id=matched_notification_id,
214	            applied=applied,
215	            reject_reason=reject_reason,
216	        )
217	
218	    def ingest_feed(self, observations: Sequence[dict], *, now: Optional[str] = None) -> list:
219	        return [
220	            self.ingest_observation(
221	                attempt_id=obs["attempt_id"],
222	                organization_id=obs["organization_id"],
223	                account_id=obs.get("account_id"),
224	                provider_state=obs["provider_state"],
225	                observed_at=obs["observed_at"],
226	                sequence=obs["sequence"],
227	                now=now,
228	            )
229	            for obs in observations
230	        ]
231	
232	    def ingest_page(
233	        self,
234	        *,
235	        feed_id: str,
236	        page_number: int,
237	        observations: Sequence[dict],
238	        now: Optional[str] = None,
239	    ) -> PageIngestResult:
240	        """Ingest one page of a durable, resumable feed import.
241	
242	        The durable cursor commits at page granularity: once page N is
243	        committed for this feed_id, replaying page N (or any earlier page)
244	        is a pure no-op -- the observations are not even re-read -- so a
245	        caller can always resend from its own last-known page without risk.
246	        If a page is interrupted before it commits (process killed mid-way),
247	        the next attempt reruns the whole page; any observation within it
248	        that was already recorded replays as a harmless duplicate (see
249	        ingest_observation's own (attempt_id, sequence) idempotency), so
250	        nothing already applied is ever applied twice.
251	        """
252	        feed_id = storage.require_identifier(feed_id, name="feed_id")
253	        if not isinstance(page_number, int) or isinstance(page_number, bool) or page_number < 0:
254	            raise storage.ValidationError("page_number must be a non-negative integer")
255	
256	        committed = self._store.get_reconciliation_cursor(feed_id)
257	        if committed is not None and page_number <= committed:
258	            return PageIngestResult(
259	                feed_id=feed_id, page_number=page_number, committed_page=committed, skipped=True, results=[]
260	            )
261	
262	        results = self.ingest_feed(observations, now=now)
263	
264	        reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
265	        recorded_at = now or reference_dt.isoformat()
266	        self._store.commit_reconciliation_cursor(feed_id, page=page_number, now=recorded_at)
267	
268	        return PageIngestResult(
269	            feed_id=feed_id, page_number=page_number, committed_page=page_number, skipped=False, results=results
270	        )
271	
272	    def classify_delayed_attempts(self, *, now: Optional[str] = None) -> list:
273	        """Classify every reconciliation-tracked attempt for operator review.
274	
275	        Read-only: this issues no writes, retries nothing, and sends no
276	        mail. An attempt already confirmed DELIVERED is reported as
277	        delivered directly from its stored state; an attempt still
278	        ACCEPTED_DELAYED is still_pending while within its configured
279	        window (measured from the notification's last state change) and
280	        unresolved once that window has elapsed with no confirming
281	        observation.
282	        """
283	        reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
284	        window = self._policy.window_for(models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED)
285	
286	        classifications = []
287	        notifications = self._store.notifications_in_states(
288	            [models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED]
289	        )
290	        for notification in notifications:
291	            if notification.delivery_state == models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED:
292	                classifications.append(
293	                    DelayedAttemptClassification(
294	                        notification_id=notification.notification_id,
295	                        account_id=notification.account_id,
296	                        reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
297	                        delivery_state=notification.delivery_state,
298	                        status=models.DelayedAttemptStatus.DELIVERED,
299	                        age_minutes=None,
300	                    )
301	                )
302	                continue
303	
304	            age_minutes: Optional[float] = None
305	            status = models.DelayedAttemptStatus.STILL_PENDING
306	            if window is not None:
307	                last_attempted_dt = _parse_timestamp(notification.last_attempted_at)
308	                age_minutes = (reference_dt - last_attempted_dt).total_seconds() / 60.0
309	                if age_minutes > window.max_age_minutes:
310	                    status = models.DelayedAttemptStatus.UNRESOLVED
311	
312	            classifications.append(
313	                DelayedAttemptClassification(
314	                    notification_id=notification.notification_id,
315	                    account_id=notification.account_id,
316	                    reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
317	                    delivery_state=notification.delivery_state,
318	                    status=status,
319	                    age_minutes=age_minutes,
320	                )
321	            )
322	        return classifications

    """Applies provider reconciliation feeds against durably stored notifications.

    Observations are matched to a notification strictly by the opaque
    `reconciliation_id` this service minted and sent to the provider
    (surfaced back to us as the feed row's `attempt_id`) -- never by the
    feed's own claimed account/organization, which is treated as untrusted
    input to be validated against the matched notification's true owner.
    """

    def __init__(self, store: Storage, policy: WindowPolicy) -> None:
        self._store = store
        self._policy = policy

    def ingest_observation(
        self,
        *,
        attempt_id: str,
        organization_id: str,
        account_id: Optional[str],
        provider_state: str,
        observed_at: str,
        sequence: int,
        now: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> IngestResult:
        attempt_id = storage.require_bounded_text(attempt_id, name="attempt_id", max_length=MAX_ATTEMPT_ID_LENGTH)
        organization_id = storage.require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization_id")
        provider_state = storage.require_bounded_text(provider_state, name="provider_state", max_length=64)
        if account_id is not None:
            account_id = storage.require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
        if not isinstance(sequence, int) or isinstance(sequence, bool):
            raise storage.ValidationError("sequence must be an integer")

        observed_dt = _parse_timestamp(observed_at)
        reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        recorded_at = now or reference_dt.isoformat()

        window = self._policy.window_for(provider_state)
        reconciliation_class = window.reconciliation_class if window is not None else None
        is_stale: Optional[bool] = None
        if window is not None:
            age_minutes = (reference_dt - observed_dt).total_seconds() / 60.0
            is_stale = age_minutes > window.max_age_minutes

        existing = self._store.find_observation(attempt_id=attempt_id, sequence=sequence)
        if existing is not None:
            # A duplicate feed-page replay: the exact (attempt_id, sequence)
            # pair was already recorded, so re-applying it would risk a
            # double transition. Echo back what was recorded the first time.
            return IngestResult(
                attempt_id=attempt_id,
                sequence=sequence,
                reconciliation_class=existing.reconciliation_class,
                is_stale=existing.is_stale,
                matched_notification_id=existing.matched_notification_id,
                applied=False,
                reject_reason=models.ObservationRejectReason.DUPLICATE,
            )

        matched_notification_id: Optional[str] = None
        applied = False
        reject_reason: Optional[str] = None

        notification = self._store.find_notification_by_reconciliation_id(attempt_id)
        if notification is None:
            reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.UNMATCHED_ATTEMPT_ID
        else:
            matched_notification_id = notification.notification_id
            account = self._store.get_account(notification.account_id)
            if account.organization_id != organization_id:
                reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.ORGANIZATION_MISMATCH
            else:
                max_seen = self._store.max_sequence_for_attempt(attempt_id)
                if max_seen is not None and sequence <= max_seen:
                    reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE
                elif reconciliation_class == models.ReconciliationClass.CLOSE_CONFIRMED:
                    self._store.set_notification_delivery_state(
                        notification_id=notification.notification_id,
                        delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED,
                        now=recorded_at,
                    )
                    applied = True
                elif reconciliation_class == models.ReconciliationClass.RETAIN_UNRESOLVED:
                    if notification.delivery_state in models.DeliveryState.TERMINAL:
                        # Provider is trying to reopen a delivery we already
                        # confirmed closed out -- a backward, malformed
                        # transition. Leave the notification untouched.
                        reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.MALFORMED_TRANSITION
                    else:
                        self._store.set_notification_delivery_state(
                            notification_id=notification.notification_id,
                            delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED,
                            now=recorded_at,
                        )
                        applied = True
                # Any other class (REVIEW_UNMATCHED, or no window at all)
                # carries no notification-state action by design.

        self._store.record_reconciliation_observation(
            attempt_id=attempt_id,
            organization_id=organization_id,
            account_id=account_id,
            provider_state=provider_state,
            observed_at=observed_at,
            sequence=sequence,
            reconciliation_class=reconciliation_class,
            is_stale=is_stale,
            matched_notification_id=matched_notification_id,
            applied=applied,
            reject_reason=reject_reason,
            now=recorded_at,
        )

        return IngestResult(
            attempt_id=attempt_id,
            sequence=sequence,
            reconciliation_class=reconciliation_class,
            is_stale=is_stale,
            matched_notification_id=matched_notification_id,
            applied=applied,
            reject_reason=reject_reason,
        )

    def ingest_feed(self, observations: Sequence[dict], *, now: Optional[str] = None) -> list:
        return [
            self.ingest_observation(
                attempt_id=obs["attempt_id"],
                organization_id=obs["organization_id"],
                account_id=obs.get("account_id"),
                provider_state=obs["provider_state"],
                observed_at=obs["observed_at"],
                sequence=obs["sequence"],
                now=now,
            )
            for obs in observations
        ]

    def ingest_page(
        self,
        *,
        feed_id: str,
        page_number: int,
        observations: Sequence[dict],
        now: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> PageIngestResult:
        """Ingest one page of a durable, resumable feed import.

        The durable cursor commits at page granularity: once page N is
        committed for this feed_id, replaying page N (or any earlier page)
        is a pure no-op -- the observations are not even re-read -- so a
        caller can always resend from its own last-known page without risk.
        If a page is interrupted before it commits (process killed mid-way),
        the next attempt reruns the whole page; any observation within it
        that was already recorded replays as a harmless duplicate (see
        ingest_observation's own (attempt_id, sequence) idempotency), so
        nothing already applied is ever applied twice.
        """
        feed_id = storage.require_identifier(feed_id, name="feed_id")
        if not isinstance(page_number, int) or isinstance(page_number, bool) or page_number < 0:
            raise storage.ValidationError("page_number must be a non-negative integer")

        committed = self._store.get_reconciliation_cursor(feed_id)
        if committed is not None and page_number <= committed:
            return PageIngestResult(
                feed_id=feed_id, page_number=page_number, committed_page=committed, skipped=True, results=[]
            )

        results = self.ingest_feed(observations, now=now)

        reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        recorded_at = now or reference_dt.isoformat()
        self._store.commit_reconciliation_cursor(feed_id, page=page_number, now=recorded_at)

        return PageIngestResult(
            feed_id=feed_id, page_number=page_number, committed_page=page_number, skipped=False, results=results
        )

    def classify_delayed_attempts(self, *, now: Optional[str] = None) -> list:
        """Classify every reconciliation-tracked attempt for operator review.

        Read-only: this issues no writes, retries nothing, and sends no
        mail. An attempt already confirmed DELIVERED is reported as
        delivered directly from its stored state; an attempt still
        ACCEPTED_DELAYED is still_pending while within its configured
        window (measured from the notification's last state change) and
        unresolved once that window has elapsed with no confirming
        observation.
        """
        reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        window = self._policy.window_for(models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED)

        classifications = []
        notifications = self._store.notifications_in_states(
            [models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED]
        )
        for notification in notifications:
            if notification.delivery_state == models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED:
                classifications.append(
                    DelayedAttemptClassification(
                        notification_id=notification.notification_id,
                        account_id=notification.account_id,
                        reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
                        delivery_state=notification.delivery_state,
                        status=models.DelayedAttemptStatus.DELIVERED,
                        age_minutes=None,
                    )
                )
                continue

            age_minutes: Optional[float] = None
            status = models.DelayedAttemptStatus.STILL_PENDING
            if window is not None:
                last_attempted_dt = _parse_timestamp(notification.last_attempted_at)
                age_minutes = (reference_dt - last_attempted_dt).total_seconds() / 60.0
                if age_minutes > window.max_age_minutes:
                    status = models.DelayedAttemptStatus.UNRESOLVED

            classifications.append(
                DelayedAttemptClassification(
                    notification_id=notification.notification_id,
                    account_id=notification.account_id,
                    reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
                    delivery_state=notification.delivery_state,
                    status=status,
                    age_minutes=age_minutes,
                )
            )
        return classifications

"""SQLite-backed durable storage for accountsvc.

Every write commits before returning (WAL journal + FULL sync) and all
access goes through a single lock so concurrent HTTP handlers never
interleave statements on the shared connection. There is no in-memory
cache anywhere in this module: every read re-queries SQLite, so a read
always observes the latest committed write (durable reads).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import threading
from typing import Optional, Sequence

from . import models

MAX_IDENTIFIER_LENGTH = 128
MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH = 320
MAX_TEXT_LENGTH = 4096

_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS organizations (
    organization_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (
    account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    organization_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(organization_id),
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    current_email TEXT NOT NULL,
    email_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    mfa_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (organization_id, current_email)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS email_history (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_id),
    organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    effective_from TEXT NOT NULL,
    effective_to TEXT,
    is_current INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_email_history_account
    ON email_history(account_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recovery_requests (
    request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_id),
    token_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    used_at TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notifications (
    notification_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recovery_requests(request_id),
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    recipient TEXT NOT NULL,
    delivery_state TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_receipt TEXT,
    reconciliation_id TEXT,
    retry_locator TEXT,
    attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    last_attempted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notifications_request
    ON notifications(request_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notifications_state
    ON notifications(delivery_state);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notifications_reconciliation_id
    ON notifications(reconciliation_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reconciliation_observations (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_id TEXT,
    provider_state TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reconciliation_class TEXT,
    is_stale INTEGER,
    matched_notification_id TEXT,
    applied INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reject_reason TEXT,
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (attempt_id, sequence)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_reconciliation_observations_attempt
    ON reconciliation_observations(attempt_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reconciliation_cursors (
    feed_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    committed_page INTEGER NOT NULL,
    committed_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
"""


class ValidationError(ValueError):
    """Raised when caller-supplied data fails bounded-input checks."""


class NotFoundError(LookupError):
    """Raised when a lookup does not resolve to a stored row."""


class ConflictError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when a write would violate a uniqueness/ownership rule."""


def require_bounded_text(value: object, *, name: str, max_length: int, allow_empty: bool = False) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValidationError(f"{name} must be a string")
    if not allow_empty and not value:
        raise ValidationError(f"{name} must not be empty")
    if len(value) > max_length:
        raise ValidationError(f"{name} exceeds maximum length of {max_length}")
    if any(ch in ("\x00",) for ch in value):
        raise ValidationError(f"{name} contains an invalid character")
    return value


def require_identifier(value: object, *, name: str) -> str:
    return require_bounded_text(value, name=name, max_length=MAX_IDENTIFIER_LENGTH)


def require_email(value: object, *, name: str = "email") -> str:
    text = require_bounded_text(value, name=name, max_length=MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH)
    if "@" not in text or text.startswith("@") or text.endswith("@"):
        raise ValidationError(f"{name} must be a valid email address")
    return text


class Storage:
    """Owns the sqlite3 connection and enforces the schema-level invariants."""

    def __init__(self, database_path: str) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, check_same_thread=False)
        self._conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        with self._lock:
            self._conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
            self._conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
            self._conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
            self._conn.executescript(_SCHEMA)
            self._conn.commit()

    def close(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._conn.close()

    # -- organizations --------------------------------------------------

    def ensure_organization(self, organization_id: str, *, now: str) -> None:
        organization_id = require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization_id")
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO organizations (organization_id, created_at) VALUES (?, ?)",
                (organization_id, now),
            )

    # -- accounts ---------------------------------------------------------

    def create_account(
        self,
        *,
        organization_id: str,
        account_id: str,
        email: str,
        display_name: str = "",
        mfa_enabled: bool = False,
        email_status: str = models.EmailStatus.UNVERIFIED,
        now: str,
    ) -> None:
        organization_id = require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization_id")
        account_id = require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
        email = require_email(email)
        display_name = require_bounded_text(
            display_name or account_id, name="display_name", max_length=MAX_TEXT_LENGTH, allow_empty=True
        )
        if email_status not in models.EmailStatus.ALL:
            raise ValidationError("email_status is not a recognized status")

        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO organizations (organization_id, created_at) VALUES (?, ?)",
                (organization_id, now),
            )
            existing = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE account_id = ?", (account_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if existing is not None:
                raise ConflictError(f"account {account_id!r} already exists")

            conflict = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE organization_id = ? AND current_email = ?",
                (organization_id, email),
            ).fetchone()
            if conflict is not None:
                raise ConflictError(
                    f"email {email!r} is already owned by another account in organization {organization_id!r}"
                )

            self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO accounts (
                    account_id, organization_id, display_name, current_email,
                    email_status, mfa_enabled, created_at, updated_at
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                """,
                (
                    account_id,
                    organization_id,
                    display_name,
                    email,
                    email_status,
                    1 if mfa_enabled else 0,
                    now,
                    now,
                ),
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO email_history (
                    account_id, organization_id, email, effective_from, effective_to, is_current
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, 1)
                """,
                (account_id, organization_id, email, now),
            )

    def get_account(self, account_id: str) -> models.Account:
        account_id = require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE account_id = ?", (account_id,)
            ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"no account {account_id!r}")
        return _row_to_account(row)

    def find_account_by_email(self, organization_id: str, email: str) -> Optional[models.Account]:
        organization_id = require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization_id")
        email = require_email(email)
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE organization_id = ? AND current_email = ?",
                (organization_id, email),
            ).fetchone()
        return _row_to_account(row) if row is not None else None

    def change_email(self, *, account_id: str, new_email: str, now: str) -> models.Account:
        account_id = require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
        new_email = require_email(new_email)
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE account_id = ?", (account_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                raise NotFoundError(f"no account {account_id!r}")
            account = _row_to_account(row)

            if new_email == account.current_email:
                return account

            conflict = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE organization_id = ? AND current_email = ? AND account_id != ?",
                (account.organization_id, new_email, account_id),
            ).fetchone()
            if conflict is not None:
                raise ConflictError(
                    f"email {new_email!r} is already owned by another account in organization "
                    f"{account.organization_id!r}"
                )

            self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE email_history SET effective_to = ?, is_current = 0 "
                "WHERE account_id = ? AND is_current = 1",
                (now, account_id),
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO email_history (
                    account_id, organization_id, email, effective_from, effective_to, is_current
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, 1)
                """,
                (account_id, account.organization_id, new_email, now),
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE accounts SET current_email = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE account_id = ?",
                (new_email, now, account_id),
            )
        return self.get_account(account_id)

    def email_history(self, account_id: str) -> Sequence[models.EmailHistoryEntry]:
        account_id = require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
        with self._lock:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM email_history WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY id ASC",
                (account_id,),
            ).fetchall()
        return [
            models.EmailHistoryEntry(
                account_id=r["account_id"],
                organization_id=r["organization_id"],
                email=r["email"],
                effective_from=r["effective_from"],
                effective_to=r["effective_to"],
                is_current=bool(r["is_current"]),
            )
            for r in rows
        ]

    # -- recovery requests ------------------------------------------------

    def create_recovery_request(
        self,
        *,
        request_id: str,
        organization_id: str,
        account_id: str,
        token_hash: str,
        created_at: str,
        expires_at: str,
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO recovery_requests (
                    request_id, organization_id, account_id, token_hash,
                    created_at, expires_at, used_at, status
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?)
                """,
                (
                    request_id,
                    organization_id,
                    account_id,
                    token_hash,
                    created_at,
                    expires_at,
                    models.RecoveryRequestStatus.PENDING,
                ),
            )

    def get_recovery_request(self, request_id: str) -> models.RecoveryRequest:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM recovery_requests WHERE request_id = ?", (request_id,)
            ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"no recovery request {request_id!r}")
        return _row_to_request(row)

    def find_recovery_request_by_token_hash(self, token_hash: str) -> Optional[models.RecoveryRequest]:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM recovery_requests WHERE token_hash = ?", (token_hash,)
            ).fetchone()
        return _row_to_request(row) if row is not None else None

    def mark_recovery_request_completed(self, request_id: str, *, now: str) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            cur = self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE recovery_requests SET status = ?, used_at = ? "
                "WHERE request_id = ? AND status = ?",
                (models.RecoveryRequestStatus.COMPLETED, now, request_id, models.RecoveryRequestStatus.PENDING),
            )
            if cur.rowcount == 0:
                raise ConflictError(f"recovery request {request_id!r} is not pending")

    def update_recovery_request_token_hash(self, request_id: str, *, token_hash: str) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            cur = self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE recovery_requests SET token_hash = ? WHERE request_id = ? AND status = ?",
                (token_hash, request_id, models.RecoveryRequestStatus.PENDING),
            )
            if cur.rowcount == 0:
                raise ConflictError(f"recovery request {request_id!r} is not pending")

    def mark_recovery_request_expired(self, request_id: str) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE recovery_requests SET status = ? WHERE request_id = ? AND status = ?",
                (models.RecoveryRequestStatus.EXPIRED, request_id, models.RecoveryRequestStatus.PENDING),
            )

    # -- notifications ------------------------------------------------------

    def create_notification(
        self,
        *,
        notification_id: str,
        request_id: str,
        account_id: str,
        recipient: str,
        delivery_state: str,
        provider_receipt: Optional[str],
        reconciliation_id: Optional[str],
        retry_locator: Optional[str],
        now: str,
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO notifications (
                    notification_id, request_id, account_id, recipient, delivery_state,
                    provider_receipt, reconciliation_id, retry_locator, attempt_count,
                    last_attempted_at, created_at
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?)
                """,
                (
                    notification_id,
                    request_id,
                    account_id,
                    recipient,
                    delivery_state,
                    provider_receipt,
                    reconciliation_id,
                    retry_locator,
                    now,
                    now,
                ),
            )

    def get_notification(self, notification_id: str) -> models.Notification:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE notification_id = ?", (notification_id,)
            ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"no notification {notification_id!r}")
        return _row_to_notification(row)

    def retryable_notifications(self, *, limit: int) -> Sequence[models.Notification]:
        with self._lock:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE delivery_state IN (?, ?) "
                "ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT ?",
                (models.DeliveryState.FAILED, models.DeliveryState.RETRYING, limit),
            ).fetchall()
        return [_row_to_notification(r) for r in rows]

    def update_notification_after_attempt(
        self,
        *,
        notification_id: str,
        delivery_state: str,
        provider_receipt: Optional[str],
        reconciliation_id: Optional[str],
        retry_locator: Optional[str],
        now: str,
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                UPDATE notifications
                SET delivery_state = ?, provider_receipt = ?, reconciliation_id = ?, retry_locator = ?,
                    attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_attempted_at = ?
                WHERE notification_id = ?
                """,
                (delivery_state, provider_receipt, reconciliation_id, retry_locator, now, notification_id),
            )

    def set_notification_delivery_state(self, *, notification_id: str, delivery_state: str, now: str) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE notifications SET delivery_state = ?, last_attempted_at = ? WHERE notification_id = ?",
                (delivery_state, now, notification_id),
            )

    def notifications_by_account(self, account_id: str) -> Sequence[models.Notification]:
        account_id = require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
        with self._lock:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY created_at ASC",
                (account_id,),
            ).fetchall()
        return [_row_to_notification(r) for r in rows]

    def notifications_for_request(self, request_id: str) -> Sequence[models.Notification]:
        with self._lock:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE request_id = ? ORDER BY created_at ASC",
                (request_id,),
            ).fetchall()
        return [_row_to_notification(r) for r in rows]

    def notifications_in_states(self, states: Sequence[str]) -> Sequence[models.Notification]:
        states = list(states)
        if not states:
            return []
        placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in states)
        with self._lock:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                f"SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE delivery_state IN ({placeholders}) ORDER BY created_at ASC",
                tuple(states),
            ).fetchall()
        return [_row_to_notification(r) for r in rows]

    def find_notification_by_reconciliation_id(self, reconciliation_id: str) -> Optional[models.Notification]:
        """Find the notification the provider is reporting on.

        Matching happens on the id we minted and sent to the provider
        (`reconciliation_id`), never on caller-supplied account/organization
        fields, so a feed row cannot point itself at an arbitrary notification
        just by naming an account id.
        """
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE reconciliation_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1",
                (reconciliation_id,),
            ).fetchone()
        return _row_to_notification(row) if row is not None else None

    # -- reconciliation -----------------------------------------------------

    def find_observation(self, *, attempt_id: str, sequence: int) -> Optional[models.ReconciliationObservation]:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM reconciliation_observations WHERE attempt_id = ? AND sequence = ?",
                (attempt_id, sequence),
            ).fetchone()
        return _row_to_observation(row) if row is not None else None

    def max_sequence_for_attempt(self, attempt_id: str) -> Optional[int]:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT MAX(sequence) AS max_sequence FROM reconciliation_observations WHERE attempt_id = ?",
                (attempt_id,),
            ).fetchone()
        value = row["max_sequence"] if row is not None else None
        return int(value) if value is not None else None

    def record_reconciliation_observation(
        self,
        *,
        attempt_id: str,
        organization_id: str,
        account_id: Optional[str],
        provider_state: str,
        observed_at: str,
        sequence: int,
        reconciliation_class: Optional[str],
        is_stale: Optional[bool],
        matched_notification_id: Optional[str],
        applied: bool,
        reject_reason: Optional[str],
        now: str,
    ) -> bool:
        """Persist an observation row. Returns False if it was a duplicate."""
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            cur = self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reconciliation_observations (
                    attempt_id, organization_id, account_id, provider_state,
                    observed_at, sequence, reconciliation_class, is_stale,
                    matched_notification_id, applied, reject_reason, recorded_at
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                """,
                (
                    attempt_id,
                    organization_id,
                    account_id,
                    provider_state,
                    observed_at,
                    sequence,
                    reconciliation_class,
                    None if is_stale is None else (1 if is_stale else 0),
                    matched_notification_id,
                    1 if applied else 0,
                    reject_reason,
                    now,
                ),
            )
        return cur.rowcount > 0

    def reconciliation_observations(
        self, *, account_id: Optional[str] = None
    ) -> Sequence[models.ReconciliationObservation]:
        with self._lock:
            if account_id is None:
                rows = self._conn.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM reconciliation_observations ORDER BY sequence ASC"
                ).fetchall()
            else:
                rows = self._conn.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM reconciliation_observations WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY sequence ASC",
                    (account_id,),
                ).fetchall()
        return [_row_to_observation(r) for r in rows]

    # -- reconciliation cursor ----------------------------------------------

    def get_reconciliation_cursor(self, feed_id: str) -> Optional[int]:
        """Return the last page number durably committed for this feed, if any."""
        feed_id = require_identifier(feed_id, name="feed_id")
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT committed_page FROM reconciliation_cursors WHERE feed_id = ?", (feed_id,)
            ).fetchone()
        return int(row["committed_page"]) if row is not None else None

    def commit_reconciliation_cursor(self, feed_id: str, *, page: int, now: str) -> None:
        """Advance the durable cursor for this feed to `page`.

        Never moves the cursor backward: a commit for a page at or behind
        the currently committed page is a silent no-op, so replaying an
        already-committed (or stale/out-of-order) page number cannot undo
        progress a prior run already recorded.
        """
        feed_id = require_identifier(feed_id, name="feed_id")
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT committed_page FROM reconciliation_cursors WHERE feed_id = ?", (feed_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                self._conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO reconciliation_cursors (feed_id, committed_page, committed_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                    (feed_id, page, now),
                )
            elif page > row["committed_page"]:
                self._conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE reconciliation_cursors SET committed_page = ?, committed_at = ? WHERE feed_id = ?",
                    (page, now, feed_id),
                )


def _row_to_account(row: sqlite3.Row) -> models.Account:
    return models.Account(
        account_id=row["account_id"],
        organization_id=row["organization_id"],
        display_name=row["display_name"],
        current_email=row["current_email"],
        email_status=row["email_status"],
        mfa_enabled=bool(row["mfa_enabled"]),
        created_at=row["created_at"],
        updated_at=row["updated_at"],
    )


def _row_to_request(row: sqlite3.Row) -> models.RecoveryRequest:
    return models.RecoveryRequest(
        request_id=row["request_id"],
        organization_id=row["organization_id"],
        account_id=row["account_id"],
        token_hash=row["token_hash"],
        created_at=row["created_at"],
        expires_at=row["expires_at"],
        used_at=row["used_at"],
        status=row["status"],
    )


def _row_to_notification(row: sqlite3.Row) -> models.Notification:
    return models.Notification(
        notification_id=row["notification_id"],
        request_id=row["request_id"],
        account_id=row["account_id"],
        recipient=row["recipient"],
        delivery_state=row["delivery_state"],
        provider_receipt=row["provider_receipt"],
        reconciliation_id=row["reconciliation_id"],
        retry_locator=row["retry_locator"],
        attempt_count=row["attempt_count"],
        last_attempted_at=row["last_attempted_at"],
        created_at=row["created_at"],
    )


def _row_to_observation(row: sqlite3.Row) -> models.ReconciliationObservation:
    is_stale = row["is_stale"]
    return models.ReconciliationObservation(
        id=row["id"],
        attempt_id=row["attempt_id"],
        organization_id=row["organization_id"],
        account_id=row["account_id"],
        provider_state=row["provider_state"],
        observed_at=row["observed_at"],
        sequence=row["sequence"],
        reconciliation_class=row["reconciliation_class"],
        is_stale=None if is_stale is None else bool(is_stale),
        matched_notification_id=row["matched_notification_id"],
        applied=bool(row["applied"]),
        reject_reason=row["reject_reason"],
        recorded_at=row["recorded_at"],
    )

import json
import os
import socket
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from accountsvc.httpapi import make_server
from accountsvc.mailer import Mailer
from accountsvc.reconciliation import ReconciliationEngine, WindowPolicy
from accountsvc.recovery import RecoveryService
from accountsvc.storage import Storage

from .helpers import FakeMailProviderServer

BEARER_TOKEN = "test-admin-token"  # noqa: S105 - fixture credential, not a real secret

_WINDOW_ROWS = [
    {
        "window_id": "w1",
        "window_start": "2026-08-30T01:00:00Z",
        "window_end": "2026-08-30T01:15:00Z",
        "provider_state": "accepted_delayed",
        "reconciliation_class": "retain_unresolved",
        "max_age_minutes": "30",
    },
    {
        "window_id": "w2",
        "window_start": "2026-08-30T01:15:00Z",
        "window_end": "2026-08-30T01:30:00Z",
        "provider_state": "delivered",
        "reconciliation_class": "close_confirmed",
        "max_age_minutes": "30",
    },
]


class HttpApiTestCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        fd, self.db_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
        os.close(fd)
        os.remove(self.db_path)
        self.store = Storage(self.db_path)
        self.store.create_account(
            organization_id="org-riverbend", account_id="acct-delay-a", email="priya@riverbend.example", now="t0"
        )

        self.mail_provider = FakeMailProviderServer()
        self.mail_provider.set_success()

        self.service = RecoveryService(self.store, Mailer(self.mail_provider.url))
        self.reconciliation_engine = ReconciliationEngine(self.store, WindowPolicy.from_rows(_WINDOW_ROWS))
        self.server = make_server(
            host="127.0.0.1",
            port=0,
            recovery_service=self.service,
            bearer_token=BEARER_TOKEN,
            reconciliation_engine=self.reconciliation_engine,
        )
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()
        self.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_address[1]}"

        self.addCleanup(self._cleanup)

    def _cleanup(self):
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()
        self.thread.join(timeout=5)
        self.mail_provider.shutdown()
        self.store.close()
        for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
            candidate = self.db_path + suffix
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                os.remove(candidate)

    def _post(self, path, payload=None, *, headers=None, raw_body=None, content_length=None):
        body = raw_body if raw_body is not None else json.dumps(payload or {}).encode("utf-8")
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            self.base_url + path, data=body, method="POST", headers=headers or {}
        )
        if content_length is not None:
            request.add_header("Content-Length", str(content_length))
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
                return response.status, json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            with exc:
                return exc.code, json.loads(exc.read().decode("utf-8"))


class RecoveryStartCompleteTests(HttpApiTestCase):
    def test_start_recovery_returns_request_id_and_delivery_status(self):
        status, payload = self._post(
            "/recovery/start", {"organization": "org-riverbend", "email": "priya@riverbend.example"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 202)
        self.assertIn("request_id", payload)
        self.assertEqual(payload["delivery_status"], "delivered")

    def test_start_recovery_does_not_return_the_secret_token(self):
        status, payload = self._post(
            "/recovery/start", {"organization": "org-riverbend", "email": "priya@riverbend.example"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 202)
        self.assertNotIn("token", payload)
        self.assertNotIn("recovery_token", payload)

    def test_complete_recovery_with_token_captured_from_mail_endpoint(self):
        self._post("/recovery/start", {"organization": "org-riverbend", "email": "priya@riverbend.example"})
        captured = self.mail_provider.last_captured()
        token = captured["recovery_token"]

        status, payload = self._post("/recovery/complete", {"token": token})
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(payload["account_id"], "acct-delay-a")

    def test_complete_recovery_rejects_bad_token(self):
        status, payload = self._post("/recovery/complete", {"token": "garbage"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)


class BoundedInputTests(HttpApiTestCase):
    def test_missing_content_length_is_rejected(self):
        # urllib always supplies Content-Length for POST bodies, so drive a
        # raw socket to exercise a request that genuinely omits the header.
        host, port = self.server.server_address
        with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=5) as sock:
            sock.sendall(
                b"POST /recovery/start HTTP/1.1\r\n"
                b"Host: 127.0.0.1\r\n"
                b"Content-Type: application/json\r\n"
                b"Connection: close\r\n"
                b"\r\n"
            )
            response = b""
            while True:
                chunk = sock.recv(4096)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                response += chunk
        status_line = response.split(b"\r\n", 1)[0].decode("utf-8")
        self.assertIn("411", status_line)

    def test_oversized_body_is_rejected(self):
        status, payload = self._post(
            "/recovery/start", raw_body=b"x" * (16_384 + 1), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 413)

    def test_malformed_json_is_rejected(self):
        status, payload = self._post(
            "/recovery/start", raw_body=b"{not-json", headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)

    def test_missing_fields_are_rejected(self):
        status, payload = self._post("/recovery/start", {"organization": "org-riverbend"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)

        self.assertEqual(payload["notifications"][0]["delivery_state"], "delivered")


class ReconciliationImportTests(HttpApiTestCase):
    def test_import_without_bearer_token_is_unauthorized(self):
        status, _ = self._post("/reconciliation/import", {"observations": []})
        self.assertEqual(status, 401)

    def test_import_returns_503_when_reconciliation_not_configured(self):
        unconfigured = make_server(
            host="127.0.0.1", port=0, recovery_service=self.service, bearer_token=BEARER_TOKEN
        )
        thread = threading.Thread(target=unconfigured.serve_forever, daemon=True)

                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {BEARER_TOKEN}"},
            )
            try:
                with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
                    status = response.status

                with exc:
                    status = exc.code

        finally:
            unconfigured.shutdown()

    def test_import_matches_by_attempt_id_and_closes_out_the_notification(self):
        self.mail_provider.set_success(state="accepted_delayed")
        self._post("/recovery/start", {"organization": "org-riverbend", "email": "priya@riverbend.example"})
        attempt_id = self.mail_provider.last_captured()["reconciliation_id"]

        status, payload = self._post(

            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {BEARER_TOKEN}"},

    def test_import_rejects_wrong_organization_without_changing_state(self):
        self.mail_provider.set_success(state="accepted_delayed")
        self._post("/recovery/start", {"organization": "org-riverbend", "email": "priya@riverbend.example"})
        attempt_id = self.mail_provider.last_captured()["reconciliation_id"]

                        "provider_state": "delivered",
                        "observed_at": "2026-08-30T01:20:00Z",

                "now": "2026-08-30T01:22:00Z",
            },
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {BEARER_TOKEN}"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        result = payload["results"][0]
        self.assertFalse(result["applied"])
        self.assertEqual(result["reject_reason"], "organization_mismatch")
        notification = self.store.get_notification(result["matched_notification_id"])
        self.assertEqual(notification.delivery_state, "accepted_delayed")

    def test_import_with_feed_id_and_page_number_commits_a_durable_cursor(self):

3	Posts a recovery link to the configured mail endpoint and classifies the
4	response into a delivery state plus an opaque provider receipt. The
5	receipt's internal shape is never interpreted here or anywhere else in
6	the service -- it is stored verbatim so a later retry or reconciliation
7	pass can present it back to whatever provider issued it.
8	"""
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import json
12	import urllib.error
13	import urllib.request
14	from dataclasses import dataclass
15	from typing import Optional
16	
17	from . import models
18	
19	MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES = 8192
20	DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5.0
21	
22	
23	@dataclass(frozen=True)
24	class DeliveryOutcome:
25	    delivery_state: str
26	    provider_receipt: Optional[str]
27	
28	
29	class Mailer:
30	    def __init__(self, endpoint: str, *, timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) -> None:
31	        self._endpoint = endpoint
32	        self._timeout = timeout
33	
34	    def send(self, *, recipient: str, recovery_token: str, reconciliation_id: str) -> DeliveryOutcome:
35	        payload = json.dumps(
36	            {"recipient": recipient, "recovery_token": recovery_token, "reconciliation_id": reconciliation_id}
37	        ).encode("utf-8")
38	        request = urllib.request.Request(
39	            self._endpoint,
40	            data=payload,
41	            method="POST",
42	            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
43	        )
44	        try:
45	            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=self._timeout) as response:
46	                body = response.read(MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES)
47	                return _classify_success(body)
48	        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
49	            with exc:
50	                body = exc.read(MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) if exc.fp is not None else b""
51	            return _classify_failure(body or str(exc).encode("utf-8", "replace"))
52	        except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError, TimeoutError) as exc:
53	            return _classify_failure(str(exc).encode("utf-8", "replace"))
54	
55	
56	def _classify_success(body: bytes) -> DeliveryOutcome:
57	    text = body.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES]
58	    state = models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED
59	    receipt: Optional[str] = text or None
60	    try:
61	        parsed = json.loads(text) if text else {}
62	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
63	        parsed = {}
64	    if isinstance(parsed, dict):
65	        provider_state = parsed.get("state")
66	        if provider_state == models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED:
67	            state = models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED
68	        if isinstance(parsed.get("receipt"), str):
69	            receipt = parsed["receipt"]
70	    return DeliveryOutcome(delivery_state=state, provider_receipt=receipt)
71	
72	
73	def _classify_failure(body: bytes) -> DeliveryOutcome:
74	    text = body.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES]
75	    return DeliveryOutcome(delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.FAILED, provider_receipt=text or None)
76

"""Recovery request lifecycle: start, complete, and notification retry.

A recovery token is minted once, hashed for storage, and handed to the
mailer as plaintext exactly once. If delivery fails outright (the
provider never accepted it), nothing was ever exposed to the recipient,
so a retry safely mints a fresh token for the same request rather than
retaining the original secret anywhere durable.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import List

from . import models, notice, storage, tokens
from .mailer import Mailer
from .storage import ConflictError, Storage

DEFAULT_RECOVERY_TTL_SECONDS = 900
MAX_RETRY_BATCH = 50

# States for which a durable retry locator (and reconciliation id) must be
# retained: the delivery has not been confirmed, so a later turn may need
# to rebuild it. DELIVERED is terminal and needs neither.
_LOCATOR_REQUIRED_STATES = frozenset({models.DeliveryState.FAILED, models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED})


def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _parse_iso(value: str) -> datetime:
    return datetime.fromisoformat(value)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StartResult:
    request_id: str
    delivery_status: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CompleteResult:
    account_id: str
    organization_id: str


class RecoveryError(Exception):
    """Base for recovery-flow failures distinct from storage-level errors."""


class TokenInvalidError(RecoveryError):
    pass


class TokenExpiredError(RecoveryError):
    pass


class TokenAlreadyUsedError(RecoveryError):
    pass


class RecoveryService:
    def __init__(
        self, store: Storage, mailer: Mailer, *, recovery_ttl_seconds: int = DEFAULT_RECOVERY_TTL_SECONDS
    ) -> None:
        if recovery_ttl_seconds <= 0:
            raise ValueError("recovery_ttl_seconds must be a positive integer")
        self._store = store
        self._mailer = mailer
        self._ttl = timedelta(seconds=recovery_ttl_seconds)

    def start_recovery(self, *, organization_id: str, email: str) -> StartResult:
        organization_id = storage.require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization")
        email = storage.require_email(email)

        account = self._store.find_account_by_email(organization_id, email)
        if account is None:
            # Do not reveal whether the address exists in this organization.
            return StartResult(request_id=tokens.new_request_id(), delivery_status=models.DeliveryState.PENDING)

        now = now_iso()
        request_id = tokens.new_request_id()
        raw_token = tokens.generate_token()
        expires_at = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) + self._ttl).isoformat()

        # The token is bound to this account and organization at creation
        # time and never re-derived from the email later.
        self._store.create_recovery_request(
            request_id=request_id,
            organization_id=account.organization_id,
            account_id=account.account_id,
            token_hash=tokens.hash_token(raw_token),
            created_at=now,
            expires_at=expires_at,
        )

        reconciliation_id = tokens.new_reconciliation_id()
        outcome = self._mailer.send(
            recipient=account.current_email, recovery_token=raw_token, reconciliation_id=reconciliation_id
        )
        retry_locator = None
        if outcome.delivery_state in _LOCATOR_REQUIRED_STATES:
            retry_locator = notice.encode_retry_locator(outcome.provider_receipt or "", account.account_id)

        self._store.create_notification(
            notification_id=tokens.new_notification_id(),
            request_id=request_id,
            account_id=account.account_id,
            recipient=account.current_email,
            delivery_state=outcome.delivery_state,
            provider_receipt=outcome.provider_receipt,
            reconciliation_id=reconciliation_id,
            retry_locator=retry_locator,
            now=now,
        )

        return StartResult(request_id=request_id, delivery_status=outcome.delivery_state)

    def complete_recovery(self, *, token: str) -> CompleteResult:
        token = storage.require_bounded_text(token, name="token", max_length=512)
        token_hash = tokens.hash_token(token)
        request = self._store.find_recovery_request_by_token_hash(token_hash)
        if request is None:
            raise TokenInvalidError("token does not match a pending recovery request")
        if request.status == models.RecoveryRequestStatus.COMPLETED:
            raise TokenAlreadyUsedError("token has already been used")
        if request.status == models.RecoveryRequestStatus.EXPIRED or _parse_iso(request.expires_at) <= datetime.now(
            timezone.utc
        ):
            self._store.mark_recovery_request_expired(request.request_id)
            raise TokenExpiredError("token has expired")

        self._store.mark_recovery_request_completed(request.request_id, now=now_iso())
        return CompleteResult(account_id=request.account_id, organization_id=request.organization_id)

    def retry_notification(self, notification_id: str) -> models.Notification:
        notification = self._store.get_notification(notification_id)
        if notification.delivery_state not in models.DeliveryState.RETRYABLE:
            raise ConflictError(
                f"notification {notification_id!r} is not retryable in state {notification.delivery_state!r}"
            )

        resolved_account_id = notice.account_id_from_retry_locator(
            notification.retry_locator or "", notification.account_id
        )
        account = self._store.get_account(resolved_account_id)
        recipient = notice.recipient_from_retry_locator(
            notification.retry_locator or "", notification.recipient, account.current_email
        )

        request = self._store.get_recovery_request(notification.request_id)
        now = now_iso()
        if request.status != models.RecoveryRequestStatus.PENDING or _parse_iso(request.expires_at) <= datetime.now(
            timezone.utc
        ):
            self._store.mark_recovery_request_expired(request.request_id)
            self._store.update_notification_after_attempt(
                notification_id=notification_id,
                delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.FAILED,
                provider_receipt=notification.provider_receipt,
                reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
                retry_locator=notification.retry_locator,
                now=now,
            )
            return self._store.get_notification(notification_id)

        # The original secret was never delivered (delivery failed outright),
        # so it is safe to mint a replacement rather than retaining the
        # original plaintext token anywhere durable.
        raw_token = tokens.generate_token()
        self._store.update_recovery_request_token_hash(request.request_id, token_hash=tokens.hash_token(raw_token))

        outcome = self._mailer.send(
            recipient=recipient, recovery_token=raw_token, reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id or ""
        )
        retry_locator = None
        if outcome.delivery_state in _LOCATOR_REQUIRED_STATES:
            retry_locator = notice.encode_retry_locator(outcome.provider_receipt or "", account.account_id)

        self._store.update_notification_after_attempt(
            notification_id=notification_id,
            delivery_state=outcome.delivery_state,
            provider_receipt=outcome.provider_receipt,
            reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
            retry_locator=retry_locator,
            now=now,
        )
        return self._store.get_notification(notification_id)

    def retry_pending_notifications(self, *, limit: int = MAX_RETRY_BATCH) -> List[models.Notification]:
        limit = min(max(int(limit), 1), MAX_RETRY_BATCH)
        pending = self._store.retryable_notifications(limit=limit)
        results = []
        for notification in pending:
            results.append(self.retry_notification(notification.notification_id))
        return results

content.description: Create accountsvc/models.py (dataclasses/enums) and accountsvc/storage.py (SQLite schema, org scope, uniqueness, durable transactions) covering organizations, accounts, email history, MFA, recovery requests, notifications (opaque receipts, delivery states), reconciliation observations.

content.subject: Implement token & mailer modules
content.description: accountsvc/tokens.py for secure single-use time-limited token generation/hashing; accountsvc/mailer.py loopback HTTP client that posts recipient/recovery_token JSON and classifies response into delivery state + opaque receipt.

content.subject: Implement recovery service using notice.py
content.description: accountsvc/recovery.py: start_recovery, complete_recovery, retry_notification(s) that use storage+mailer+notice.encode_retry_locator/account_id_from_retry_locator/recipient_from_retry_locator without changing their signatures.

content.subject: Implement reconciliation ingestion
content.description: accountsvc/reconciliation.py: ingest reconciliation observations, classify via delayed-delivery window policy, update notification delivery states, handle unmatched observations.

content.subject: Implement fixtures loader for riverbend fixtures
content.description: accountsvc/fixtures.py: stdlib-only loaders for fixtures/provider-s02/accounts-riverbend.yaml (hand-rolled minimal YAML), delayed-delivery-window.csv, reconciliation-feed.jsonl.

content.subject: Implement CLI (cli.py)
content.description: create-account, change-email, show-account, serve subcommands matching README shapes exactly; add reconcile/seed subcommands as needed.

content.subject: Implement loopback HTTP service (httpapi.py)
content.description: ThreadingHTTPServer with POST /recovery/start, /recovery/complete, authenticated /recovery/notifications/retry; bearer token auth, bounded request bodies, JSON validation.

content.subject: Write focused tests + riverbend scenario test
content.description: tests/ using unittest (stdlib): storage, recovery flow incl retry locator preservation, reconciliation with riverbend fixtures, CLI, HTTP API auth/bounded input.

content.subject: Run full test suite and fix issues
content.description: Execute python -m unittest discover, iterate until green.

content.subject: Add reconciliation_id persistence + retry_locator for accepted_delayed
content.description: Add reconciliation_id column to notifications schema/model, mint it in RecoveryService.start_recovery, pass through mailer payload, and persist retry_locator for both FAILED and ACCEPTED_DELAYED (not just FAILED).

content.subject: Add configurable --recovery-ttl-seconds CLI flag
content.description: Add positive-integer argparse option (default 900) to serve subcommand, validated before binding via a custom argparse type; wire into RecoveryService so /recovery/start uses it for new token expiry; expiry persisted as absolute timestamp already.

content.subject: Add delayed-persistence test + two-process TTL restart test
content.description: Test that accepted_delayed/failed notifications persist trusted account_id, original recipient, opaque receipt, reconciliation_id, retry_locator. Add subprocess-based test: serve with --recovery-ttl-seconds 2, create 2 tokens, complete one immediately, sleep past expiry, restart serve on same DB, confirm second token now rejected as expired.

content.subject: Match reconciliation observations by provider attempt id (not by account)

content.subject: Expose authenticated /reconciliation/import HTTP command

content.subject: Update riverbend reconciliation test fixture seeding for attempt-id matching
content.description: tests/test_reconciliation.py seeds notifications with reconciliation_id not matching the feed's attempt_id values; update seeding so existing scenario tests keep passing under the new attempt-id matching rule.

content.subject: Add tests: duplicate pages, out-of-order, wrong org, restarts

content.description: Run the full unittest suite (including ResourceWarning-as-error) after all reconciliation changes and fix any regressions.

content.subject: Design durable reconciliation cursor (schema + storage methods)

content.description: After ingesting a feed page, classify each delayed attempt (accepted_delayed notification) as delivered, still_pending, or unresolved based on the configured window policy and elapsed time, without changing account/token binding logic.

    def select_unresolved(
        self,
        *,
        feed_id: str,
        limit: Optional[int] = None,
        now: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> UnresolvedBatch:
        """Return the next capped batch of unresolved attempts for operator review.

        Wraps classify_delayed_attempts (the existing selector) rather than
        reclassifying anything itself: only attempts it already buckets
        UNRESOLVED are candidates here, so delivered and still_pending
        notifications are never eligible. A notification whose owning
        recovery request has since expired is a terminal no-op even though
        its delivery state still looks unresolved -- there is no live
        recovery flow left to act on, so it is excluded rather than
        surfaced for follow-up.

        Paging reuses the same durable reconciliation_cursors table and
        helpers as ingest_page, keyed by feed_id: the cursor stores how
        many eligible rows (in a stable notification_id order) have
        already been handed out, so repeated calls resume rather than
        re-emit the same batch. The cursor only advances when the batch is
        non-empty -- a call that finds nothing eligible leaves it
        untouched.
        """
        feed_id = storage.require_identifier(feed_id, name="feed_id")
        if limit is None:
            limit = DEFAULT_UNRESOLVED_BATCH
        if not isinstance(limit, int) or isinstance(limit, bool) or limit < 1:
            raise storage.ValidationError("limit must be a positive integer")
        limit = min(limit, MAX_UNRESOLVED_BATCH)

        offset = self._store.get_reconciliation_cursor(feed_id) or 0

        eligible = []
        for classification in self.classify_delayed_attempts(now=now):
            if classification.status != models.DelayedAttemptStatus.UNRESOLVED:
                continue
            notification = self._store.get_notification(classification.notification_id)
            request = self._store.get_recovery_request(notification.request_id)
            if request.status == models.RecoveryRequestStatus.EXPIRED:
                continue
            eligible.append(classification)
        eligible.sort(key=lambda c: c.notification_id)

        batch = eligible[offset : offset + limit]
        next_offset = offset + len(batch)

        if batch:
            reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            recorded_at = now or reference_dt.isoformat()
            self._store.commit_reconciliation_cursor(feed_id, page=next_offset, now=recorded_at)

        return UnresolvedBatch(feed_id=feed_id, offset=offset, next_offset=next_offset, attempts=batch)
