1	"""Loopback HTTP surface for the account recovery service.
2	
3	POST /recovery/start and POST /recovery/complete are reachable by a user
4	who has already lost access (no bearer token required). POST
5	/recovery/notifications/retry, POST /reconciliation/import, POST
6	/reconciliation/status, and POST /reconciliation/unresolved are
7	administrative actions and always require the configured bearer token.
8	"""
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import dataclasses
12	import hmac
13	import json
14	from http import HTTPStatus
15	from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
16	from typing import Optional
17	
18	from . import recovery
19	from .reconciliation import ReconciliationEngine
20	from .recovery import RecoveryService
21	from .storage import ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError
22	
23	MAX_BODY_BYTES = 16_384
24	
25	
26	class AccountRecoveryServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
27	    daemon_threads = True
28	
29	    def __init__(
30	        self,
31	        address,
32	        handler_cls,
33	        *,
34	        recovery_service: RecoveryService,
35	        bearer_token: str,
36	        reconciliation_engine: Optional[ReconciliationEngine] = None,
37	    ) -> None:
38	        super().__init__(address, handler_cls)
39	        self.recovery_service = recovery_service
40	        self.bearer_token = bearer_token
41	        self.reconciliation_engine = reconciliation_engine
42	
43	
44	class RecoveryRequestHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
45	    server: AccountRecoveryServer
46	
47	    def log_message(self, format, *args):  # noqa: A002 - stdlib signature
48	        pass  # Keep loopback test/service runs quiet; errors still raise.
49	
50	    def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - stdlib method name
51	        if self.path == "/recovery/start":
52	            self._handle_start()
53	        elif self.path == "/recovery/complete":
54	            self._handle_complete()
55	        elif self.path == "/recovery/notifications/retry":
56	            self._handle_retry()
57	        elif self.path == "/reconciliation/import":
58	            self._handle_reconciliation_import()
59	        elif self.path == "/reconciliation/status":
60	            self._handle_reconciliation_status()
61	        elif self.path == "/reconciliation/unresolved":
62	            self._handle_reconciliation_unresolved()
63	        else:
64	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.NOT_FOUND, {"error": "not_found"})
65	
66	    def _read_body(self) -> Optional[dict]:
67	        length_header = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
68	        if length_header is None:
69	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.LENGTH_REQUIRED, {"error": "content_length_required"})
70	            return None
71	        try:
72	            length = int(length_header)
73	        except ValueError:
74	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"error": "invalid_content_length"})
75	            return None
76	        if length < 0 or length > MAX_BODY_BYTES:
77	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE, {"error": "body_too_large"})
78	            return None
79	        raw = self.rfile.read(length)
80	        try:
81	            parsed = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
82	        except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
83	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"error": "invalid_json"})
84	            return None
85	        if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
86	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"error": "invalid_body"})
87	            return None
88	        return parsed
89	
90	    def _is_authenticated(self) -> bool:
91	        header = self.headers.get("Authorization", "")
92	        prefix = "Bearer "
93	        if not header.startswith(prefix):
94	            return False
95	        supplied = header[len(prefix):]
96	        return hmac.compare_digest(supplied, self.server.bearer_token)
97	
98	    def _handle_start(self) -> None:
99	        body = self._read_body()
100	        if body is None:
101	            return
102	        try:
103	            organization = body["organization"]
104	            email = body["email"]
105	        except KeyError:
106	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"error": "organization_and_email_required"})
107	            return
108	        try:
109	            result = self.server.recovery_service.start_recovery(organization_id=organization, email=email)
110	        except ValidationError as exc:
111	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"error": str(exc)})
112	            return
113	        self._send_json(
114	            HTTPStatus.ACCEPTED,
115	            {"request_id": result.request_id, "delivery_status": result.delivery_status},
116	        )
117	
118	    def _handle_complete(self) -> None:
119	        body = self._read_body()
120	        if body is None:
121	            return
122	        try:
123	            token = body["token"]
124	        except KeyError:
125	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"error": "token_required"})
126	            return
127	        try:
128	            result = self.server.recovery_service.complete_recovery(token=token)
129	        except (recovery.TokenInvalidError, recovery.TokenExpiredError, recovery.TokenAlreadyUsedError) as exc:
130	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"error": str(exc)})
131	            return
132	        except ValidationError as exc:
133	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.BAD_REQUEST, {"error": str(exc)})
134	            return
135	        self._send_json(
136	            HTTPStatus.OK,
137	            {"status": "completed", "account_id": result.account_id, "organization_id": result.organization_id},
138	        )
139	
140	    def _handle_retry(self) -> None:
141	        if not self._is_authenticated():
142	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, {"error": "unauthorized"})
143	            return
144	        body = self._read_body()
145	        if body is None:
146	            return
147	        notification_id = body.get("notification_id")
148	        try:
149	            if notification_id is not None:
150	                updated = [self.server.recovery_service.retry_notification(notification_id)]
151	            else:
152	                updated = self.server.recovery_service.retry_pending_notifications()
153	        except NotFoundError as exc:
154	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.NOT_FOUND, {"error": str(exc)})
155	            return
156	        except ConflictError as exc:
157	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.CONFLICT, {"error": str(exc)})
158	            return
159	        self._send_json(
160	            HTTPStatus.OK,
161	            {
162	                "notifications": [
163	                    {"notification_id": n.notification_id, "delivery_state": n.delivery_state}
164	                    for n in updated
165	                ]
166	            },
167	        )
168	
169	    def _handle_reconciliation_import(self) -> None:
170	        if not self._is_authenticated():
171	            self._send_json(HTTPStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, {"error": "unauthorized"})
172	            return
173	        if self.server.reconciliation_engine is None:

187	            return
188	        try:
189	            if feed_id is None:

191	                payload = {"results": [dataclasses.asdict(r) for r in results]}
192	            else:
193	                page_result = self.server.reconciliation_engine.ingest_page(
194	                    feed_id=feed_id, page_number=page_number, observations=observations, now=body.get("now")
195	                )
196	                payload = {
197	                    "feed_id": page_result.feed_id,

class ReconciliationUnresolvedTests(HttpApiTestCase):
    def test_unresolved_batch_table(self):
        # Shared feed_id: the "terminal no-op" row proves the cursor left
        # by the "unresolved row" case is not re-emitted, and that a
        # notification excluded as ineligible does not advance it either.
        state = {}

        def setup_auth_refusal():
            return {"feed_id": "ops-feed"}, {}

        def setup_unresolved_row():
            self.mail_provider.set_success(state="accepted_delayed")
            self._post("/recovery/start", {"organization": "org-riverbend", "email": "priya@riverbend.example"})
            notification = self.store.notifications_by_account("acct-delay-a")[-1]
            last_attempted = datetime.fromisoformat(notification.last_attempted_at)
            # The configured window in _WINDOW_ROWS is 30 minutes -- well past it.
            state["now"] = (last_attempted + timedelta(minutes=45)).isoformat()
            state["unresolved_notification_id"] = notification.notification_id
            return {"feed_id": "ops-feed", "now": state["now"]}, {"Authorization": f"Bearer {BEARER_TOKEN}"}

        def setup_terminal_no_op():
            # A second accepted_delayed notification whose owning recovery
            # request has since expired: it would classify as unresolved
            # by delivery state alone, but must remain ineligible.
            self._post("/recovery/start", {"organization": "org-riverbend", "email": "priya@riverbend.example"})
            notification = self.store.notifications_by_account("acct-delay-a")[-1]
            self.store.mark_recovery_request_expired(notification.request_id)
            return {"feed_id": "ops-feed", "now": state["now"]}, {"Authorization": f"Bearer {BEARER_TOKEN}"}

        cases = [
            {
                "name": "auth_refusal",
                "setup": setup_auth_refusal,
                "expected_status": 401,
            },
            {
                "name": "one_unresolved_row",
                "setup": setup_unresolved_row,
                "expected_status": 200,
                "expected_attempt_count": 1,
                "expected_first_status": "unresolved",
                "expected_offset": 0,
                "expected_next_offset": 1,
            },
            {
                "name": "terminal_no_op",
                "setup": setup_terminal_no_op,
                "expected_status": 200,
                "expected_attempt_count": 0,
                "expected_offset": 1,
                "expected_next_offset": 1,
            },
        ]

        captured_before = len(self.mail_provider.behavior.captured)
        for case in cases:
            with self.subTest(case["name"]):
                body, headers = case["setup"]()
                status, payload = self._post("/reconciliation/unresolved", body, headers=headers)
                self.assertEqual(status, case["expected_status"])
                if status != 200:
                    continue
                attempts = payload["attempts"]
                self.assertEqual(len(attempts), case["expected_attempt_count"])
                if case["expected_attempt_count"]:
                    self.assertEqual(attempts[0]["status"], case["expected_first_status"])
                self.assertEqual(payload["offset"], case["expected_offset"])
                self.assertEqual(payload["next_offset"], case["expected_next_offset"])

        # Selecting unresolved attempts for review never sends mail, and the
        # notification left in the expired-request row is untouched.
        self.assertEqual(len(self.mail_provider.behavior.captured), captured_before + 2)
        expired_notification = self.store.notifications_by_account("acct-delay-a")[-1]
        self.assertEqual(expired_notification.delivery_state, "accepted_delayed")

    def test_unresolved_without_bearer_token_is_unauthorized(self):
        status, _ = self._post("/reconciliation/unresolved", {"feed_id": "ops-feed"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 401)

    def test_unresolved_returns_503_when_reconciliation_not_configured(self):
        unconfigured = make_server(
            host="127.0.0.1", port=0, recovery_service=self.service, bearer_token=BEARER_TOKEN
        )
        thread = threading.Thread(target=unconfigured.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
        try:
            base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{unconfigured.server_address[1]}"
            body = json.dumps({"feed_id": "ops-feed"}).encode("utf-8")
            request = urllib.request.Request(
                base_url + "/reconciliation/unresolved",
                data=body,
                method="POST",
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {BEARER_TOKEN}"},
            )
            try:
                with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
                    status = response.status
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
                with exc:
                    status = exc.code
            self.assertEqual(status, 503)
        finally:
            unconfigured.shutdown()
            unconfigured.server_close()
            thread.join(timeout=5)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

**What was added** — a new bearer-gated `POST /reconciliation/unresolved` operation that wraps the existing unresolved selector:

No new table, parser, or worker.

- **`accountsvc/httpapi.py`**: `_handle_reconciliation_unresolved` checks the bearer token first — before the engine, cursor, or body are ever touched — then validates `feed_id`, calls `select_unresolved`, and emits the response with `sort_keys=True` for stable, deterministic JSON. The response only ever carries the existing `DelayedAttemptClassification` fields (`notification_id`, `account_id`, `reconciliation_id`, `delivery_state`, `status`, `age_minutes`) — never the notification's `recipient` email — so it's redacted by construction, reusing the same dataclass the `/reconciliation/status` route already serializes.

- **`tests/test_httpapi.py`**: one table-driven test (`ReconciliationUnresolvedTests.test_unresolved_batch_table`) iterating three cases via `subTest` against a shared `feed_id`: missing bearer token → 401; an `accepted_delayed` notification past its window → batch of one, `status="unresolved"`, cursor advances 0→1; a second `accepted_delayed` notification whose recovery request is then marked expired → empty batch (terminal no-op), cursor stays at 1, and no extra mail was sent for the selection calls themselves.

"""Recovery request lifecycle: start, complete, and notification retry.

A recovery token is minted once, hashed for storage, and handed to the
mailer as plaintext exactly once. If delivery fails outright (the
provider never accepted it), nothing was ever exposed to the recipient,
so a retry safely mints a fresh token for the same request rather than
retaining the original secret anywhere durable.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import List

from . import models, notice, storage, tokens
from .mailer import Mailer
from .storage import ConflictError, Storage

DEFAULT_RECOVERY_TTL_SECONDS = 900
MAX_RETRY_BATCH = 50

# States for which a durable retry locator (and reconciliation id) must be
# retained: the delivery has not been confirmed, so a later turn may need
# to rebuild it. DELIVERED is terminal and needs neither.
_LOCATOR_REQUIRED_STATES = frozenset({models.DeliveryState.FAILED, models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED})


def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _parse_iso(value: str) -> datetime:
    return datetime.fromisoformat(value)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StartResult:
    request_id: str
    delivery_status: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CompleteResult:
    account_id: str
    organization_id: str


class RecoveryError(Exception):
    """Base for recovery-flow failures distinct from storage-level errors."""


class TokenInvalidError(RecoveryError):
    pass


class TokenExpiredError(RecoveryError):
    pass


class TokenAlreadyUsedError(RecoveryError):
    pass


class RecoveryService:
    def __init__(
        self, store: Storage, mailer: Mailer, *, recovery_ttl_seconds: int = DEFAULT_RECOVERY_TTL_SECONDS
    ) -> None:
        if recovery_ttl_seconds <= 0:
            raise ValueError("recovery_ttl_seconds must be a positive integer")
        self._store = store
        self._mailer = mailer
        self._ttl = timedelta(seconds=recovery_ttl_seconds)

    def start_recovery(self, *, organization_id: str, email: str) -> StartResult:
        organization_id = storage.require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization")
        email = storage.require_email(email)

        account = self._store.find_account_by_email(organization_id, email)
        if account is None:
            # Do not reveal whether the address exists in this organization.
            return StartResult(request_id=tokens.new_request_id(), delivery_status=models.DeliveryState.PENDING)

        now = now_iso()
        request_id = tokens.new_request_id()
        raw_token = tokens.generate_token()
        expires_at = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) + self._ttl).isoformat()

        # The token is bound to this account and organization at creation
        # time and never re-derived from the email later.
        self._store.create_recovery_request(
            request_id=request_id,
            organization_id=account.organization_id,
            account_id=account.account_id,
            token_hash=tokens.hash_token(raw_token),
            created_at=now,
            expires_at=expires_at,
        )

        reconciliation_id = tokens.new_reconciliation_id()
        outcome = self._mailer.send(
            recipient=account.current_email, recovery_token=raw_token, reconciliation_id=reconciliation_id
        )
        retry_locator = None
        if outcome.delivery_state in _LOCATOR_REQUIRED_STATES:
            retry_locator = notice.encode_retry_locator(outcome.provider_receipt or "", account.account_id)

        self._store.create_notification(
            notification_id=tokens.new_notification_id(),
            request_id=request_id,
            account_id=account.account_id,
            recipient=account.current_email,
            delivery_state=outcome.delivery_state,
            provider_receipt=outcome.provider_receipt,
            reconciliation_id=reconciliation_id,
            retry_locator=retry_locator,
            now=now,
        )

        return StartResult(request_id=request_id, delivery_status=outcome.delivery_state)

    def complete_recovery(self, *, token: str) -> CompleteResult:
        token = storage.require_bounded_text(token, name="token", max_length=512)
        token_hash = tokens.hash_token(token)
        request = self._store.find_recovery_request_by_token_hash(token_hash)
        if request is None:
            raise TokenInvalidError("token does not match a pending recovery request")
        if request.status == models.RecoveryRequestStatus.COMPLETED:
            raise TokenAlreadyUsedError("token has already been used")
        if request.status == models.RecoveryRequestStatus.EXPIRED or _parse_iso(request.expires_at) <= datetime.now(
            timezone.utc
        ):
            self._store.mark_recovery_request_expired(request.request_id)
            raise TokenExpiredError("token has expired")

        self._store.mark_recovery_request_completed(request.request_id, now=now_iso())
        return CompleteResult(account_id=request.account_id, organization_id=request.organization_id)

    def retry_notification(self, notification_id: str) -> models.Notification:
        notification = self._store.get_notification(notification_id)
        if notification.delivery_state not in models.DeliveryState.RETRYABLE:
            raise ConflictError(
                f"notification {notification_id!r} is not retryable in state {notification.delivery_state!r}"
            )

        resolved_account_id = notice.account_id_from_retry_locator(
            notification.retry_locator or "", notification.account_id
        )
        account = self._store.get_account(resolved_account_id)
        recipient = notice.recipient_from_retry_locator(
            notification.retry_locator or "", notification.recipient, account.current_email
        )

        request = self._store.get_recovery_request(notification.request_id)
        now = now_iso()
        if request.status != models.RecoveryRequestStatus.PENDING or _parse_iso(request.expires_at) <= datetime.now(
            timezone.utc
        ):
            self._store.mark_recovery_request_expired(request.request_id)
            self._store.update_notification_after_attempt(
                notification_id=notification_id,
                delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.FAILED,
                provider_receipt=notification.provider_receipt,
                reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
                retry_locator=notification.retry_locator,
                now=now,
            )
            return self._store.get_notification(notification_id)

        # The original secret was never delivered (delivery failed outright),
        # so it is safe to mint a replacement rather than retaining the
        # original plaintext token anywhere durable.
        raw_token = tokens.generate_token()
        self._store.update_recovery_request_token_hash(request.request_id, token_hash=tokens.hash_token(raw_token))

        outcome = self._mailer.send(
            recipient=recipient, recovery_token=raw_token, reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id or ""
        )
        retry_locator = None
        if outcome.delivery_state in _LOCATOR_REQUIRED_STATES:
            retry_locator = notice.encode_retry_locator(outcome.provider_receipt or "", account.account_id)

        self._store.update_notification_after_attempt(
            notification_id=notification_id,
            delivery_state=outcome.delivery_state,
            provider_receipt=outcome.provider_receipt,
            reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
            retry_locator=retry_locator,
            now=now,
        )
        return self._store.get_notification(notification_id)

    def retry_pending_notifications(self, *, limit: int = MAX_RETRY_BATCH) -> List[models.Notification]:
        limit = min(max(int(limit), 1), MAX_RETRY_BATCH)
        pending = self._store.retryable_notifications(limit=limit)
        results = []
        for notification in pending:
            results.append(self.retry_notification(notification.notification_id))
        return results

"""Recovery locator used when a mail provider reports a non-success.

Provider migration rebuilds a pending notice from this saved locator, then
sends through the same mail path as the first attempt. Keep the original
recovery token bound to the request that created it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations


def encode_retry_locator(receipt: str, account_id: str) -> str:
    """Return the durable locator for a failed provider delivery."""

    # The pending request already owns the authoritative account binding.
    return account_id


def account_id_from_retry_locator(saved: str, fallback_account_id: str) -> str:
    """Return the account used to rebuild a failed delivery."""

    # The locator cannot replace the request's authoritative account binding.
    return fallback_account_id


def recipient_from_retry_locator(saved: str, stored_recipient: str, current_email: str) -> str:
    """Return the current account address for a persisted retry."""

    return current_email

content.content:
1	"""Recovery request lifecycle: start, complete, and notification retry.
2	
3	A recovery token is minted once, hashed for storage, and handed to the
4	mailer as plaintext exactly once. If delivery fails outright (the
5	provider never accepted it), nothing was ever exposed to the recipient,
6	so a retry safely mints a fresh token for the same request rather than
7	retaining the original secret anywhere durable.
8	"""
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	from dataclasses import dataclass
12	from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
13	from typing import List
14	
15	from . import models, notice, storage, tokens
16	from .mailer import Mailer
17	from .storage import ConflictError, Storage
18	
19	DEFAULT_RECOVERY_TTL_SECONDS = 900
20	MAX_RETRY_BATCH = 50
21	
22	# States for which a durable retry locator (and reconciliation id) must be
23	# retained: the delivery has not been confirmed, so a later turn may need
24	# to rebuild it. DELIVERED is terminal and needs neither.
25	_LOCATOR_REQUIRED_STATES = frozenset({models.DeliveryState.FAILED, models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED})
26	
27	
28	def now_iso() -> str:
29	    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
30	
31	
32	def _parse_iso(value: str) -> datetime:
33	    return datetime.fromisoformat(value)
34	
35	
36	@dataclass(frozen=True)
37	class StartResult:
38	    request_id: str
39	    delivery_status: str
40	
41	
42	@dataclass(frozen=True)
43	class CompleteResult:
44	    account_id: str
45	    organization_id: str
46	
47	
48	class RecoveryError(Exception):
49	    """Base for recovery-flow failures distinct from storage-level errors."""
50	
51	
52	class TokenInvalidError(RecoveryError):
53	    pass
54	
55	
56	class TokenExpiredError(RecoveryError):
57	    pass
58	
59	
60	class TokenAlreadyUsedError(RecoveryError):
61	    pass
62	
63	
64	class RecoveryService:
65	    def __init__(
66	        self, store: Storage, mailer: Mailer, *, recovery_ttl_seconds: int = DEFAULT_RECOVERY_TTL_SECONDS
67	    ) -> None:
68	        if recovery_ttl_seconds <= 0:
69	            raise ValueError("recovery_ttl_seconds must be a positive integer")
70	        self._store = store
71	        self._mailer = mailer
72	        self._ttl = timedelta(seconds=recovery_ttl_seconds)
73	
74	    def start_recovery(self, *, organization_id: str, email: str) -> StartResult:
75	        organization_id = storage.require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization")
76	        email = storage.require_email(email)
77	
78	        account = self._store.find_account_by_email(organization_id, email)
79	        if account is None:
80	            # Do not reveal whether the address exists in this organization.
81	            return StartResult(request_id=tokens.new_request_id(), delivery_status=models.DeliveryState.PENDING)
82	
83	        now = now_iso()
84	        request_id = tokens.new_request_id()
85	        raw_token = tokens.generate_token()
86	        expires_at = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) + self._ttl).isoformat()
87	
88	        # The token is bound to this account and organization at creation
89	        # time and never re-derived from the email later.
90	        self._store.create_recovery_request(
91	            request_id=request_id,
92	            organization_id=account.organization_id,
93	            account_id=account.account_id,
94	            token_hash=tokens.hash_token(raw_token),
95	            created_at=now,
96	            expires_at=expires_at,
97	        )
98	
99	        reconciliation_id = tokens.new_reconciliation_id()
100	        outcome = self._mailer.send(
101	            recipient=account.current_email, recovery_token=raw_token, reconciliation_id=reconciliation_id
102	        )
103	        retry_locator = None
104	        if outcome.delivery_state in _LOCATOR_REQUIRED_STATES:
105	            retry_locator = notice.encode_retry_locator(outcome.provider_receipt or "", account.account_id)
106	
107	        self._store.create_notification(
108	            notification_id=tokens.new_notification_id(),
109	            request_id=request_id,
110	            account_id=account.account_id,
111	            recipient=account.current_email,
112	            delivery_state=outcome.delivery_state,
113	            provider_receipt=outcome.provider_receipt,
114	            reconciliation_id=reconciliation_id,

"""Recovery request lifecycle: start, complete, and notification retry.

A recovery token is minted once, hashed for storage, and handed to the
mailer as plaintext exactly once. If delivery fails outright (the
provider never accepted it), nothing was ever exposed to the recipient,
so a retry safely mints a fresh token for the same request rather than
retaining the original secret anywhere durable.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import List

from . import models, notice, storage, tokens
from .mailer import Mailer
from .storage import ConflictError, Storage

DEFAULT_RECOVERY_TTL_SECONDS = 900
MAX_RETRY_BATCH = 50

# States for which a durable retry locator (and reconciliation id) must be
# retained: the delivery has not been confirmed, so a later turn may need
# to rebuild it. DELIVERED is terminal and needs neither.
_LOCATOR_REQUIRED_STATES = frozenset({models.DeliveryState.FAILED, models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED})


def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _parse_iso(value: str) -> datetime:
    return datetime.fromisoformat(value)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StartResult:
    request_id: str
    delivery_status: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CompleteResult:
    account_id: str
    organization_id: str


class RecoveryError(Exception):
    """Base for recovery-flow failures distinct from storage-level errors."""


class TokenInvalidError(RecoveryError):
    pass


class TokenExpiredError(RecoveryError):
    pass


class TokenAlreadyUsedError(RecoveryError):
    pass


class RecoveryService:
    def __init__(
        self, store: Storage, mailer: Mailer, *, recovery_ttl_seconds: int = DEFAULT_RECOVERY_TTL_SECONDS
    ) -> None:
        if recovery_ttl_seconds <= 0:
            raise ValueError("recovery_ttl_seconds must be a positive integer")
        self._store = store
        self._mailer = mailer
        self._ttl = timedelta(seconds=recovery_ttl_seconds)

    def start_recovery(self, *, organization_id: str, email: str) -> StartResult:
        organization_id = storage.require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization")
        email = storage.require_email(email)

        account = self._store.find_account_by_email(organization_id, email)
        if account is None:
            # Do not reveal whether the address exists in this organization.
            return StartResult(request_id=tokens.new_request_id(), delivery_status=models.DeliveryState.PENDING)

        now = now_iso()
        request_id = tokens.new_request_id()
        raw_token = tokens.generate_token()
        expires_at = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) + self._ttl).isoformat()

        # The token is bound to this account and organization at creation
        # time and never re-derived from the email later.
        self._store.create_recovery_request(
            request_id=request_id,
            organization_id=account.organization_id,
            account_id=account.account_id,
            token_hash=tokens.hash_token(raw_token),
            created_at=now,
            expires_at=expires_at,
        )

        reconciliation_id = tokens.new_reconciliation_id()
        outcome = self._mailer.send(
            recipient=account.current_email, recovery_token=raw_token, reconciliation_id=reconciliation_id
        )
        retry_locator = None
        if outcome.delivery_state in _LOCATOR_REQUIRED_STATES:
            retry_locator = notice.encode_retry_locator(outcome.provider_receipt or "", account.account_id)

        self._store.create_notification(
            notification_id=tokens.new_notification_id(),
            request_id=request_id,
            account_id=account.account_id,
            recipient=account.current_email,
            delivery_state=outcome.delivery_state,
            provider_receipt=outcome.provider_receipt,
            reconciliation_id=reconciliation_id,
            retry_locator=retry_locator,
            now=now,
        )

        return StartResult(request_id=request_id, delivery_status=outcome.delivery_state)

    def complete_recovery(self, *, token: str) -> CompleteResult:
        token = storage.require_bounded_text(token, name="token", max_length=512)
        token_hash = tokens.hash_token(token)
        request = self._store.find_recovery_request_by_token_hash(token_hash)
        if request is None:
            raise TokenInvalidError("token does not match a pending recovery request")
        if request.status == models.RecoveryRequestStatus.COMPLETED:
            raise TokenAlreadyUsedError("token has already been used")
        if request.status == models.RecoveryRequestStatus.EXPIRED or _parse_iso(request.expires_at) <= datetime.now(
            timezone.utc
        ):
            self._store.mark_recovery_request_expired(request.request_id)
            raise TokenExpiredError("token has expired")

        self._store.mark_recovery_request_completed(request.request_id, now=now_iso())
        return CompleteResult(account_id=request.account_id, organization_id=request.organization_id)

    def retry_notification(self, notification_id: str) -> models.Notification:
        notification = self._store.get_notification(notification_id)
        if notification.delivery_state not in models.DeliveryState.RETRYABLE:
            raise ConflictError(
                f"notification {notification_id!r} is not retryable in state {notification.delivery_state!r}"
            )

        resolved_account_id = notice.account_id_from_retry_locator(
            notification.retry_locator or "", notification.account_id
        )
        account = self._store.get_account(resolved_account_id)
        recipient = notice.recipient_from_retry_locator(
            notification.retry_locator or "", notification.recipient, account.current_email
        )

        request = self._store.get_recovery_request(notification.request_id)
        now = now_iso()
        if request.status != models.RecoveryRequestStatus.PENDING or _parse_iso(request.expires_at) <= datetime.now(
            timezone.utc
        ):
            self._store.mark_recovery_request_expired(request.request_id)
            self._store.update_notification_after_attempt(
                notification_id=notification_id,
                delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.FAILED,
                provider_receipt=notification.provider_receipt,
                reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
                retry_locator=notification.retry_locator,
                now=now,
            )
            return self._store.get_notification(notification_id)

        # The original secret was never delivered (delivery failed outright),
        # so it is safe to mint a replacement rather than retaining the
        # original plaintext token anywhere durable.
        raw_token = tokens.generate_token()
        self._store.update_recovery_request_token_hash(request.request_id, token_hash=tokens.hash_token(raw_token))

        outcome = self._mailer.send(
            recipient=recipient, recovery_token=raw_token, reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id or ""
        )
        retry_locator = None
        if outcome.delivery_state in _LOCATOR_REQUIRED_STATES:
            retry_locator = notice.encode_retry_locator(outcome.provider_receipt or "", account.account_id)

        self._store.update_notification_after_attempt(
            notification_id=notification_id,
            delivery_state=outcome.delivery_state,
            provider_receipt=outcome.provider_receipt,
            reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
            retry_locator=retry_locator,
            now=now,
        )
        return self._store.get_notification(notification_id)

    def retry_pending_notifications(self, *, limit: int = MAX_RETRY_BATCH) -> List[models.Notification]:
        limit = min(max(int(limit), 1), MAX_RETRY_BATCH)
        pending = self._store.retryable_notifications(limit=limit)
        results = []
        for notification in pending:
            results.append(self.retry_notification(notification.notification_id))
        return results

1	"""Loopback mail delivery client.
2	
3	Posts a recovery link to the configured mail endpoint and classifies the
4	response into a delivery state plus an opaque provider receipt. The
5	receipt's internal shape is never interpreted here or anywhere else in
6	the service -- it is stored verbatim so a later retry or reconciliation
7	pass can present it back to whatever provider issued it.
8	"""
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import json
12	import urllib.error
13	import urllib.request
14	from dataclasses import dataclass
15	from typing import Optional
16	
17	from . import models
18	
19	MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES = 8192
20	DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5.0
21	
22	
23	@dataclass(frozen=True)
24	class DeliveryOutcome:
25	    delivery_state: str
26	    provider_receipt: Optional[str]
27	
28	
29	class Mailer:
30	    def __init__(self, endpoint: str, *, timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) -> None:
31	        self._endpoint = endpoint
32	        self._timeout = timeout
33	
34	    def send(self, *, recipient: str, recovery_token: str, reconciliation_id: str) -> DeliveryOutcome:
35	        payload = json.dumps(
36	            {"recipient": recipient, "recovery_token": recovery_token, "reconciliation_id": reconciliation_id}
37	        ).encode("utf-8")
38	        request = urllib.request.Request(
39	            self._endpoint,
40	            data=payload,
41	            method="POST",
42	            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
43	        )
44	        try:
45	            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=self._timeout) as response:
46	                body = response.read(MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES)
47	                return _classify_success(body)
48	        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
49	            with exc:
50	                body = exc.read(MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) if exc.fp is not None else b""
51	            return _classify_failure(body or str(exc).encode("utf-8", "replace"))
52	        except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError, TimeoutError) as exc:
53	            return _classify_failure(str(exc).encode("utf-8", "replace"))
54	
55	
56	def _classify_success(body: bytes) -> DeliveryOutcome:
57	    text = body.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES]
58	    state = models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED
59	    receipt: Optional[str] = text or None
60	    try:
61	        parsed = json.loads(text) if text else {}
62	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
63	        parsed = {}
64	    if isinstance(parsed, dict):
65	        provider_state = parsed.get("state")
66	        if provider_state == models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED:
67	            state = models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED
68	        if isinstance(parsed.get("receipt"), str):
69	            receipt = parsed["receipt"]
70	    return DeliveryOutcome(delivery_state=state, provider_receipt=receipt)
71	
72	
73	def _classify_failure(body: bytes) -> DeliveryOutcome:
74	    text = body.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES]
75	    return DeliveryOutcome(delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.FAILED, provider_receipt=text or None)
76

1	"""SQLite-backed durable storage for accountsvc.
2	
3	Every write commits before returning (WAL journal + FULL sync) and all
4	access goes through a single lock so concurrent HTTP handlers never
5	interleave statements on the shared connection. There is no in-memory
6	cache anywhere in this module: every read re-queries SQLite, so a read
7	always observes the latest committed write (durable reads).
8	"""
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import sqlite3
12	import threading
13	from typing import Optional, Sequence
14	
15	from . import models
16	
17	MAX_IDENTIFIER_LENGTH = 128
18	MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH = 320
19	MAX_TEXT_LENGTH = 4096
20	
21	_SCHEMA = """
22	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS organizations (
23	    organization_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
24	    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
25	);
26	
27	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (
28	    account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
29	    organization_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(organization_id),
30	    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
31	    current_email TEXT NOT NULL,
32	    email_status TEXT NOT NULL,
33	    mfa_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
34	    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
35	    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
36	    UNIQUE (organization_id, current_email)
37	);
38	
39	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS email_history (
40	    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
41	    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_id),
42	    organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,
43	    email TEXT NOT NULL,
44	    effective_from TEXT NOT NULL,
45	    effective_to TEXT,
46	    is_current INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
47	);
48	
49	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_email_history_account
50	    ON email_history(account_id);
51	
52	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recovery_requests (
53	    request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
54	    organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,
55	    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_id),
56	    token_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
57	    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
58	    expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
59	    used_at TEXT,
60	    status TEXT NOT NULL
61	);
62	
63	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notifications (
64	    notification_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
65	    request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recovery_requests(request_id),
66	    account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
67	    recipient TEXT NOT NULL,
68	    delivery_state TEXT NOT NULL,
69	    provider_receipt TEXT,
70	    reconciliation_id TEXT,
71	    retry_locator TEXT,
72	    attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
73	    last_attempted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
74	    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
75	);
76	
77	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notifications_request
78	    ON notifications(request_id);
79	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notifications_state
80	    ON notifications(delivery_state);
81	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notifications_reconciliation_id
82	    ON notifications(reconciliation_id);
83	
84	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reconciliation_observations (
85	    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
86	    attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
87	    organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,
88	    account_id TEXT,
89	    provider_state TEXT NOT NULL,
90	    observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
91	    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
92	    reconciliation_class TEXT,
93	    is_stale INTEGER,
94	    matched_notification_id TEXT,
95	    applied INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
96	    reject_reason TEXT,
97	    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
98	    UNIQUE (attempt_id, sequence)
99	);
100	
101	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_reconciliation_observations_attempt
102	    ON reconciliation_observations(attempt_id);
103	
104	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reconciliation_cursors (
105	    feed_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
106	    committed_page INTEGER NOT NULL,
107	    committed_at TEXT NOT NULL
108	);
109	"""
110	
111	
112	class ValidationError(ValueError):
113	    """Raised when caller-supplied data fails bounded-input checks."""
114	
115	
116	class NotFoundError(LookupError):
117	    """Raised when a lookup does not resolve to a stored row."""
118	
119	
120	class ConflictError(RuntimeError):
121	    """Raised when a write would violate a uniqueness/ownership rule."""
122	
123	
124	def require_bounded_text(value: object, *, name: str, max_length: int, allow_empty: bool = False) -> str:
125	    if not isinstance(value, str):
126	        raise ValidationError(f"{name} must be a string")
127	    if not allow_empty and not value:
128	        raise ValidationError(f"{name} must not be empty")
129	    if len(value) > max_length:
130	        raise ValidationError(f"{name} exceeds maximum length of {max_length}")
131	    if any(ch in ("\x00",) for ch in value):
132	        raise ValidationError(f"{name} contains an invalid character")
133	    return value
134	
135	
136	def require_identifier(value: object, *, name: str) -> str:
137	    return require_bounded_text(value, name=name, max_length=MAX_IDENTIFIER_LENGTH)
138	
139	
140	def require_email(value: object, *, name: str = "email") -> str:
141	    text = require_bounded_text(value, name=name, max_length=MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH)
142	    if "@" not in text or text.startswith("@") or text.endswith("@"):
143	        raise ValidationError(f"{name} must be a valid email address")
144	    return text
145	
146	
147	class Storage:
148	    """Owns the sqlite3 connection and enforces the schema-level invariants."""
149	
150	    def __init__(self, database_path: str) -> None:
151	        self._lock = threading.RLock()
152	        self._conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, check_same_thread=False)
153	        self._conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
154	        with self._lock:
155	            self._conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
156	            self._conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
157	            self._conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
158	            self._conn.executescript(_SCHEMA)
159	            self._conn.commit()
160	
161	    def close(self) -> None:
162	        with self._lock:
163	            self._conn.close()
164	
165	    # -- organizations --------------------------------------------------
166	
167	    def ensure_organization(self, organization_id: str, *, now: str) -> None:
168	        organization_id = require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization_id")
169	        with self._lock, self._conn:
170	            self._conn.execute(
171	                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO organizations (organization_id, created_at) VALUES (?, ?)",
172	                (organization_id, now),
173	            )
174	
175	    # -- accounts ---------------------------------------------------------
176	
177	    def create_account(
178	        self,
179	        *,
180	        organization_id: str,
181	        account_id: str,
182	        email: str,
183	        display_name: str = "",
184	        mfa_enabled: bool = False,
185	        email_status: str = models.EmailStatus.UNVERIFIED,
186	        now: str,
187	    ) -> None:
188	        organization_id = require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization_id")
189	        account_id = require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
190	        email = require_email(email)
191	        display_name = require_bounded_text(
192	            display_name or account_id, name="display_name", max_length=MAX_TEXT_LENGTH, allow_empty=True
193	        )
194	        if email_status not in models.EmailStatus.ALL:
195	            raise ValidationError("email_status is not a recognized status")
196	
197	        with self._lock, self._conn:
198	            self._conn.execute(
199	                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO organizations (organization_id, created_at) VALUES (?, ?)",
200	                (organization_id, now),
201	            )
202	            existing = self._conn.execute(
203	                "SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE account_id = ?", (account_id,)
204	            ).fetchone()
205	            if existing is not None:
206	                raise ConflictError(f"account {account_id!r} already exists")
207	
208	            conflict = self._conn.execute(
209	                "SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE organization_id = ? AND current_email = ?",
210	                (organization_id, email),
211	            ).fetchone()
212	            if conflict is not None:
213	                raise ConflictError(
214	                    f"email {email!r} is already owned by another account in organization {organization_id!r}"
215	                )
216	
217	            self._conn.execute(
218	                """
219	                INSERT INTO accounts (
220	                    account_id, organization_id, display_name, current_email,
221	                    email_status, mfa_enabled, created_at, updated_at
222	                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
223	                """,
224	                (
225	                    account_id,
226	                    organization_id,
227	                    display_name,
228	                    email,
229	                    email_status,
230	                    1 if mfa_enabled else 0,
231	                    now,
232	                    now,
233	                ),
234	            )
235	            self._conn.execute(
236	                """
237	                INSERT INTO email_history (
238	                    account_id, organization_id, email, effective_from, effective_to, is_current
239	                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, 1)
240	                """,
241	                (account_id, organization_id, email, now),
242	            )

244	    def get_account(self, account_id: str) -> models.Account:
245	        account_id = require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
246	        with self._lock:
247	            row = self._conn.execute(
248	                "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE account_id = ?", (account_id,)
249	            ).fetchone()

255	        organization_id = require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization_id")
256	        email = require_email(email)

265	        account_id = require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")

501	        states = list(states)
502	        if not states:

504	        placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in states)
505	        with self._lock:
506	            rows = self._conn.execute(
507	                f"SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE delivery_state IN ({placeholders}) ORDER BY created_at ASC",
508	                tuple(states),
509	            ).fetchall()
510	        return [_row_to_notification(r) for r in rows]
511	
512	    def find_notification_by_reconciliation_id(self, reconciliation_id: str) -> Optional[models.Notification]:
513	        """Find the notification the provider is reporting on.
514	
515	        Matching happens on the id we minted and sent to the provider
516	        (`reconciliation_id`), never on caller-supplied account/organization
517	        fields, so a feed row cannot point itself at an arbitrary notification
518	        just by naming an account id.

522	                "SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE reconciliation_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1",
523	                (reconciliation_id,),
524	            ).fetchone()

526	
527	    # -- reconciliation -----------------------------------------------------

536

540	                "SELECT MAX(sequence) AS max_sequence FROM reconciliation_observations WHERE attempt_id = ?",
541	                (attempt_id,),
542	            ).fetchone()

546	    def record_reconciliation_observation(
547	        self,
548	        *,
549	        attempt_id: str,

551	        account_id: Optional[str],
552	        provider_state: str,

561	    ) -> bool:

563	        with self._lock, self._conn:

565	                """
566	                INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reconciliation_observations (
567	                    attempt_id, organization_id, account_id, provider_state,
568	                    observed_at, sequence, reconciliation_class, is_stale,
569	                    matched_notification_id, applied, reject_reason, recorded_at
570	                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
571	                """,

573	                    attempt_id,
574	                    organization_id,
575	                    account_id,

577	                    observed_at,

579	                    reconciliation_class,
580	                    None if is_stale is None else (1 if is_stale else 0),
581	                    matched_notification_id,
582	                    1 if applied else 0,
583	                    reject_reason,
584	                    now,
585	                ),
586	            )
587	        return cur.rowcount > 0
588	
589	    def reconciliation_observations(
590	        self, *, account_id: Optional[str] = None
591	    ) -> Sequence[models.ReconciliationObservation]:
592	        with self._lock:
593	            if account_id is None:
594	                rows = self._conn.execute(
595	                    "SELECT * FROM reconciliation_observations ORDER BY sequence ASC"
596	                ).fetchall()
597	            else:
598	                rows = self._conn.execute(
599	                    "SELECT * FROM reconciliation_observations WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY sequence ASC",
600	                    (account_id,),

606	    def get_reconciliation_cursor(self, feed_id: str) -> Optional[int]:

608	        feed_id = require_identifier(feed_id, name="feed_id")

621	        progress a prior run already recorded.

632	                )

"""SQLite-backed durable storage for accountsvc.

Every write commits before returning (WAL journal + FULL sync) and all
access goes through a single lock so concurrent HTTP handlers never
interleave statements on the shared connection. There is no in-memory
cache anywhere in this module: every read re-queries SQLite, so a read
always observes the latest committed write (durable reads).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import threading
from typing import Optional, Sequence

from . import models

MAX_IDENTIFIER_LENGTH = 128
MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH = 320
MAX_TEXT_LENGTH = 4096

_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS organizations (
    organization_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (
    account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    organization_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(organization_id),
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    current_email TEXT NOT NULL,
    email_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    mfa_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (organization_id, current_email)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS email_history (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_id),
    organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    effective_from TEXT NOT NULL,
    effective_to TEXT,
    is_current INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_email_history_account
    ON email_history(account_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recovery_requests (
    request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_id),
    token_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    used_at TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notifications (
    notification_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recovery_requests(request_id),
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    recipient TEXT NOT NULL,
    delivery_state TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_receipt TEXT,
    reconciliation_id TEXT,
    retry_locator TEXT,
    attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    last_attempted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notifications_request
    ON notifications(request_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notifications_state
    ON notifications(delivery_state);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notifications_reconciliation_id
    ON notifications(reconciliation_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reconciliation_observations (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_id TEXT,
    provider_state TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reconciliation_class TEXT,
    is_stale INTEGER,
    matched_notification_id TEXT,
    applied INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reject_reason TEXT,
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (attempt_id, sequence)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_reconciliation_observations_attempt
    ON reconciliation_observations(attempt_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reconciliation_cursors (
    feed_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    committed_page INTEGER NOT NULL,
    committed_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
"""


class ValidationError(ValueError):
    """Raised when caller-supplied data fails bounded-input checks."""


class NotFoundError(LookupError):
    """Raised when a lookup does not resolve to a stored row."""


class ConflictError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when a write would violate a uniqueness/ownership rule."""


def require_bounded_text(value: object, *, name: str, max_length: int, allow_empty: bool = False) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValidationError(f"{name} must be a string")
    if not allow_empty and not value:
        raise ValidationError(f"{name} must not be empty")
    if len(value) > max_length:
        raise ValidationError(f"{name} exceeds maximum length of {max_length}")
    if any(ch in ("\x00",) for ch in value):
        raise ValidationError(f"{name} contains an invalid character")
    return value


def require_identifier(value: object, *, name: str) -> str:
    return require_bounded_text(value, name=name, max_length=MAX_IDENTIFIER_LENGTH)


def require_email(value: object, *, name: str = "email") -> str:
    text = require_bounded_text(value, name=name, max_length=MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH)
    if "@" not in text or text.startswith("@") or text.endswith("@"):
        raise ValidationError(f"{name} must be a valid email address")
    return text


class Storage:
    """Owns the sqlite3 connection and enforces the schema-level invariants."""

    def __init__(self, database_path: str) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, check_same_thread=False)
        self._conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        with self._lock:
            self._conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
            self._conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
            self._conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
            self._conn.executescript(_SCHEMA)
            self._conn.commit()

    def close(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._conn.close()

    # -- organizations --------------------------------------------------

    def ensure_organization(self, organization_id: str, *, now: str) -> None:
        organization_id = require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization_id")
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO organizations (organization_id, created_at) VALUES (?, ?)",
                (organization_id, now),
            )

    # -- accounts ---------------------------------------------------------

    def create_account(
        self,
        *,
        organization_id: str,
        account_id: str,
        email: str,
        display_name: str = "",
        mfa_enabled: bool = False,
        email_status: str = models.EmailStatus.UNVERIFIED,
        now: str,
    ) -> None:
        organization_id = require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization_id")
        account_id = require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
        email = require_email(email)
        display_name = require_bounded_text(
            display_name or account_id, name="display_name", max_length=MAX_TEXT_LENGTH, allow_empty=True
        )
        if email_status not in models.EmailStatus.ALL:
            raise ValidationError("email_status is not a recognized status")

        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO organizations (organization_id, created_at) VALUES (?, ?)",
                (organization_id, now),
            )
            existing = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE account_id = ?", (account_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if existing is not None:
                raise ConflictError(f"account {account_id!r} already exists")

            conflict = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE organization_id = ? AND current_email = ?",
                (organization_id, email),
            ).fetchone()
            if conflict is not None:
                raise ConflictError(
                    f"email {email!r} is already owned by another account in organization {organization_id!r}"
                )

            self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO accounts (
                    account_id, organization_id, display_name, current_email,
                    email_status, mfa_enabled, created_at, updated_at
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                """,
                (
                    account_id,
                    organization_id,
                    display_name,
                    email,
                    email_status,
                    1 if mfa_enabled else 0,
                    now,
                    now,
                ),
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO email_history (
                    account_id, organization_id, email, effective_from, effective_to, is_current
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, 1)
                """,
                (account_id, organization_id, email, now),
            )

    def get_account(self, account_id: str) -> models.Account:
        account_id = require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE account_id = ?", (account_id,)
            ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"no account {account_id!r}")
        return _row_to_account(row)

    def find_account_by_email(self, organization_id: str, email: str) -> Optional[models.Account]:
        organization_id = require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization_id")
        email = require_email(email)
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE organization_id = ? AND current_email = ?",
                (organization_id, email),
            ).fetchone()
        return _row_to_account(row) if row is not None else None

    def change_email(self, *, account_id: str, new_email: str, now: str) -> models.Account:
        account_id = require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
        new_email = require_email(new_email)
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE account_id = ?", (account_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                raise NotFoundError(f"no account {account_id!r}")
            account = _row_to_account(row)

            if new_email == account.current_email:
                return account

            conflict = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE organization_id = ? AND current_email = ? AND account_id != ?",
                (account.organization_id, new_email, account_id),
            ).fetchone()
            if conflict is not None:
                raise ConflictError(
                    f"email {new_email!r} is already owned by another account in organization "
                    f"{account.organization_id!r}"
                )

            self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE email_history SET effective_to = ?, is_current = 0 "
                "WHERE account_id = ? AND is_current = 1",
                (now, account_id),
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO email_history (
                    account_id, organization_id, email, effective_from, effective_to, is_current
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, 1)
                """,
                (account_id, account.organization_id, new_email, now),
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE accounts SET current_email = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE account_id = ?",
                (new_email, now, account_id),
            )
        return self.get_account(account_id)

    def email_history(self, account_id: str) -> Sequence[models.EmailHistoryEntry]:
        account_id = require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
        with self._lock:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM email_history WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY id ASC",
                (account_id,),
            ).fetchall()
        return [
            models.EmailHistoryEntry(
                account_id=r["account_id"],
                organization_id=r["organization_id"],
                email=r["email"],
                effective_from=r["effective_from"],
                effective_to=r["effective_to"],
                is_current=bool(r["is_current"]),
            )
            for r in rows
        ]

    # -- recovery requests ------------------------------------------------

    def create_recovery_request(
        self,
        *,
        request_id: str,
        organization_id: str,
        account_id: str,
        token_hash: str,
        created_at: str,
        expires_at: str,
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO recovery_requests (
                    request_id, organization_id, account_id, token_hash,
                    created_at, expires_at, used_at, status
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?)
                """,
                (
                    request_id,
                    organization_id,
                    account_id,
                    token_hash,
                    created_at,
                    expires_at,
                    models.RecoveryRequestStatus.PENDING,
                ),
            )

    def get_recovery_request(self, request_id: str) -> models.RecoveryRequest:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM recovery_requests WHERE request_id = ?", (request_id,)
            ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"no recovery request {request_id!r}")
        return _row_to_request(row)

    def find_recovery_request_by_token_hash(self, token_hash: str) -> Optional[models.RecoveryRequest]:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM recovery_requests WHERE token_hash = ?", (token_hash,)
            ).fetchone()
        return _row_to_request(row) if row is not None else None

    def mark_recovery_request_completed(self, request_id: str, *, now: str) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            cur = self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE recovery_requests SET status = ?, used_at = ? "
                "WHERE request_id = ? AND status = ?",
                (models.RecoveryRequestStatus.COMPLETED, now, request_id, models.RecoveryRequestStatus.PENDING),
            )
            if cur.rowcount == 0:
                raise ConflictError(f"recovery request {request_id!r} is not pending")

    def update_recovery_request_token_hash(self, request_id: str, *, token_hash: str) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            cur = self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE recovery_requests SET token_hash = ? WHERE request_id = ? AND status = ?",
                (token_hash, request_id, models.RecoveryRequestStatus.PENDING),
            )
            if cur.rowcount == 0:
                raise ConflictError(f"recovery request {request_id!r} is not pending")

    def mark_recovery_request_expired(self, request_id: str) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE recovery_requests SET status = ? WHERE request_id = ? AND status = ?",
                (models.RecoveryRequestStatus.EXPIRED, request_id, models.RecoveryRequestStatus.PENDING),
            )

    # -- notifications ------------------------------------------------------

    def create_notification(
        self,
        *,
        notification_id: str,
        request_id: str,
        account_id: str,
        recipient: str,
        delivery_state: str,
        provider_receipt: Optional[str],
        reconciliation_id: Optional[str],
        retry_locator: Optional[str],
        now: str,
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO notifications (
                    notification_id, request_id, account_id, recipient, delivery_state,
                    provider_receipt, reconciliation_id, retry_locator, attempt_count,
                    last_attempted_at, created_at
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?)
                """,
                (
                    notification_id,
                    request_id,
                    account_id,
                    recipient,
                    delivery_state,
                    provider_receipt,
                    reconciliation_id,
                    retry_locator,
                    now,
                    now,
                ),
            )

    def get_notification(self, notification_id: str) -> models.Notification:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE notification_id = ?", (notification_id,)
            ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"no notification {notification_id!r}")
        return _row_to_notification(row)

    def retryable_notifications(self, *, limit: int) -> Sequence[models.Notification]:
        with self._lock:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE delivery_state IN (?, ?) "
                "ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT ?",
                (models.DeliveryState.FAILED, models.DeliveryState.RETRYING, limit),
            ).fetchall()
        return [_row_to_notification(r) for r in rows]

    def update_notification_after_attempt(
        self,
        *,
        notification_id: str,
        delivery_state: str,
        provider_receipt: Optional[str],
        reconciliation_id: Optional[str],
        retry_locator: Optional[str],
        now: str,
    ) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                UPDATE notifications
                SET delivery_state = ?, provider_receipt = ?, reconciliation_id = ?, retry_locator = ?,
                    attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_attempted_at = ?
                WHERE notification_id = ?
                """,
                (delivery_state, provider_receipt, reconciliation_id, retry_locator, now, notification_id),
            )

    def set_notification_delivery_state(self, *, notification_id: str, delivery_state: str, now: str) -> None:
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                "UPDATE notifications SET delivery_state = ?, last_attempted_at = ? WHERE notification_id = ?",
                (delivery_state, now, notification_id),
            )

    def notifications_by_account(self, account_id: str) -> Sequence[models.Notification]:
        account_id = require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
        with self._lock:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY created_at ASC",
                (account_id,),
            ).fetchall()
        return [_row_to_notification(r) for r in rows]

    def notifications_for_request(self, request_id: str) -> Sequence[models.Notification]:
        with self._lock:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE request_id = ? ORDER BY created_at ASC",
                (request_id,),
            ).fetchall()
        return [_row_to_notification(r) for r in rows]

    def notifications_in_states(self, states: Sequence[str]) -> Sequence[models.Notification]:
        states = list(states)
        if not states:
            return []
        placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in states)
        with self._lock:
            rows = self._conn.execute(
                f"SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE delivery_state IN ({placeholders}) ORDER BY created_at ASC",
                tuple(states),
            ).fetchall()
        return [_row_to_notification(r) for r in rows]

    def find_notification_by_reconciliation_id(self, reconciliation_id: str) -> Optional[models.Notification]:
        """Find the notification the provider is reporting on.

        Matching happens on the id we minted and sent to the provider
        (`reconciliation_id`), never on caller-supplied account/organization
        fields, so a feed row cannot point itself at an arbitrary notification
        just by naming an account id.
        """
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE reconciliation_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1",
                (reconciliation_id,),
            ).fetchone()
        return _row_to_notification(row) if row is not None else None

    # -- reconciliation -----------------------------------------------------

    def find_observation(self, *, attempt_id: str, sequence: int) -> Optional[models.ReconciliationObservation]:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM reconciliation_observations WHERE attempt_id = ? AND sequence = ?",
                (attempt_id, sequence),
            ).fetchone()
        return _row_to_observation(row) if row is not None else None

    def max_sequence_for_attempt(self, attempt_id: str) -> Optional[int]:
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT MAX(sequence) AS max_sequence FROM reconciliation_observations WHERE attempt_id = ?",
                (attempt_id,),
            ).fetchone()
        value = row["max_sequence"] if row is not None else None
        return int(value) if value is not None else None

    def record_reconciliation_observation(
        self,
        *,
        attempt_id: str,
        organization_id: str,
        account_id: Optional[str],
        provider_state: str,
        observed_at: str,
        sequence: int,
        reconciliation_class: Optional[str],
        is_stale: Optional[bool],
        matched_notification_id: Optional[str],
        applied: bool,
        reject_reason: Optional[str],
        now: str,
    ) -> bool:
        """Persist an observation row. Returns False if it was a duplicate."""
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            cur = self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reconciliation_observations (
                    attempt_id, organization_id, account_id, provider_state,
                    observed_at, sequence, reconciliation_class, is_stale,
                    matched_notification_id, applied, reject_reason, recorded_at
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                """,
                (
                    attempt_id,
                    organization_id,
                    account_id,
                    provider_state,
                    observed_at,
                    sequence,
                    reconciliation_class,
                    None if is_stale is None else (1 if is_stale else 0),
                    matched_notification_id,
                    1 if applied else 0,
                    reject_reason,
                    now,
                ),
            )
        return cur.rowcount > 0

    def reconciliation_observations(
        self, *, account_id: Optional[str] = None
    ) -> Sequence[models.ReconciliationObservation]:
        with self._lock:
            if account_id is None:
                rows = self._conn.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM reconciliation_observations ORDER BY sequence ASC"
                ).fetchall()
            else:
                rows = self._conn.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM reconciliation_observations WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY sequence ASC",
                    (account_id,),
                ).fetchall()
        return [_row_to_observation(r) for r in rows]

    # -- reconciliation cursor ----------------------------------------------

    def get_reconciliation_cursor(self, feed_id: str) -> Optional[int]:
        """Return the last page number durably committed for this feed, if any."""
        feed_id = require_identifier(feed_id, name="feed_id")
        with self._lock:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT committed_page FROM reconciliation_cursors WHERE feed_id = ?", (feed_id,)
            ).fetchone()
        return int(row["committed_page"]) if row is not None else None

    def commit_reconciliation_cursor(self, feed_id: str, *, page: int, now: str) -> None:
        """Advance the durable cursor for this feed to `page`.

        Never moves the cursor backward: a commit for a page at or behind
        the currently committed page is a silent no-op, so replaying an
        already-committed (or stale/out-of-order) page number cannot undo
        progress a prior run already recorded.
        """
        feed_id = require_identifier(feed_id, name="feed_id")
        with self._lock, self._conn:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT committed_page FROM reconciliation_cursors WHERE feed_id = ?", (feed_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                self._conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO reconciliation_cursors (feed_id, committed_page, committed_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                    (feed_id, page, now),
                )
            elif page > row["committed_page"]:
                self._conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE reconciliation_cursors SET committed_page = ?, committed_at = ? WHERE feed_id = ?",
                    (page, now, feed_id),
                )


def _row_to_account(row: sqlite3.Row) -> models.Account:
    return models.Account(
        account_id=row["account_id"],
        organization_id=row["organization_id"],
        display_name=row["display_name"],
        current_email=row["current_email"],
        email_status=row["email_status"],
        mfa_enabled=bool(row["mfa_enabled"]),
        created_at=row["created_at"],
        updated_at=row["updated_at"],
    )


def _row_to_request(row: sqlite3.Row) -> models.RecoveryRequest:
    return models.RecoveryRequest(
        request_id=row["request_id"],
        organization_id=row["organization_id"],
        account_id=row["account_id"],
        token_hash=row["token_hash"],
        created_at=row["created_at"],
        expires_at=row["expires_at"],
        used_at=row["used_at"],
        status=row["status"],
    )


def _row_to_notification(row: sqlite3.Row) -> models.Notification:
    return models.Notification(
        notification_id=row["notification_id"],
        request_id=row["request_id"],
        account_id=row["account_id"],
        recipient=row["recipient"],
        delivery_state=row["delivery_state"],
        provider_receipt=row["provider_receipt"],
        reconciliation_id=row["reconciliation_id"],
        retry_locator=row["retry_locator"],
        attempt_count=row["attempt_count"],
        last_attempted_at=row["last_attempted_at"],
        created_at=row["created_at"],
    )


def _row_to_observation(row: sqlite3.Row) -> models.ReconciliationObservation:
    is_stale = row["is_stale"]
    return models.ReconciliationObservation(
        id=row["id"],
        attempt_id=row["attempt_id"],
        organization_id=row["organization_id"],
        account_id=row["account_id"],
        provider_state=row["provider_state"],
        observed_at=row["observed_at"],
        sequence=row["sequence"],
        reconciliation_class=row["reconciliation_class"],
        is_stale=None if is_stale is None else bool(is_stale),
        matched_notification_id=row["matched_notification_id"],
        applied=bool(row["applied"]),
        reject_reason=row["reject_reason"],
        recorded_at=row["recorded_at"],
    )

115	    def __init__(self, store: Storage, policy: WindowPolicy) -> None:
116	        self._store = store
