120	        self,
121	        *,
122	        attempt_id: str,
123	        organization_id: str,
124	        account_id: Optional[str],
125	        provider_state: str,
126	        observed_at: str,

145	        if window is not None:
146	            age_minutes = (reference_dt - observed_dt).total_seconds() / 60.0
147	            is_stale = age_minutes > window.max_age_minutes

149	        existing = self._store.find_observation(attempt_id=attempt_id, sequence=sequence)
150	        if existing is not None:
151	            # A duplicate feed-page replay: the exact (attempt_id, sequence)
152	            # pair was already recorded, so re-applying it would risk a
153	            # double transition. Echo back what was recorded the first time.
154	            return IngestResult(
155	                attempt_id=attempt_id,
156	                sequence=sequence,
157	                reconciliation_class=existing.reconciliation_class,
158	                is_stale=existing.is_stale,
159	                matched_notification_id=existing.matched_notification_id,
160	                applied=False,
161	                reject_reason=models.ObservationRejectReason.DUPLICATE,

163	
164	        matched_notification_id: Optional[str] = None
165	        applied = False
166	        reject_reason: Optional[str] = None
167	
168	        notification = self._store.find_notification_by_reconciliation_id(attempt_id)
169	        if notification is None:
170	            reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.UNMATCHED_ATTEMPT_ID
171	        else:
172	            matched_notification_id = notification.notification_id
173	            account = self._store.get_account(notification.account_id)
174	            if account.organization_id != organization_id:
175	                reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.ORGANIZATION_MISMATCH
176	            else:
177	                max_seen = self._store.max_sequence_for_attempt(attempt_id)
178	                if max_seen is not None and sequence <= max_seen:
179	                    reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE
180	                elif reconciliation_class == models.ReconciliationClass.CLOSE_CONFIRMED:
181	                    self._store.set_notification_delivery_state(
182	                        notification_id=notification.notification_id,
183	                        delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED,
184	                        now=recorded_at,
185	                    )
186	                    applied = True
187	                elif reconciliation_class == models.ReconciliationClass.RETAIN_UNRESOLVED:

190	                        # confirmed closed out -- a backward, malformed
191	                        # transition. Leave the notification untouched.
192	                        reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.MALFORMED_TRANSITION
193	                    else:
194	                        self._store.set_notification_delivery_state(
195	                            notification_id=notification.notification_id,
196	                            delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED,
197	                            now=recorded_at,
198	                        )
199	                        applied = True

201	                # carries no notification-state action by design.
202	
203	        self._store.record_reconciliation_observation(
204	            attempt_id=attempt_id,
205	            organization_id=organization_id,
206	            account_id=account_id,
207	            provider_state=provider_state,
208	            observed_at=observed_at,
209	            sequence=sequence,
210	            reconciliation_class=reconciliation_class,
211	            is_stale=is_stale,

213	            applied=applied,
214	            reject_reason=reject_reason,

216	        )

218	        return IngestResult(
219	            attempt_id=attempt_id,
220	            sequence=sequence,
221	            reconciliation_class=reconciliation_class,
222	            is_stale=is_stale,
223	            matched_notification_id=matched_notification_id,
224	            applied=applied,

228	    def ingest_feed(self, observations: Sequence[dict], *, now: Optional[str] = None) -> list:
229	        return [
230	            self.ingest_observation(
231	                attempt_id=obs["attempt_id"],
232	                organization_id=obs["organization_id"],
233	                account_id=obs.get("account_id"),
234	                provider_state=obs["provider_state"],
235	                observed_at=obs["observed_at"],
236	                sequence=obs["sequence"],
237	                now=now,
238	            )
239	            for obs in observations
240	        ]
241	
242	    def ingest_page(
243	        self,
244	        *,
245	        feed_id: str,
246	        page_number: int,
247	        observations: Sequence[dict],
248	        now: Optional[str] = None,
249	    ) -> PageIngestResult:
250	        """Ingest one page of a durable, resumable feed import.
251	
252	        The durable cursor commits at page granularity: once page N is
253	        committed for this feed_id, replaying page N (or any earlier page)
254	        is a pure no-op -- the observations are not even re-read -- so a
255	        caller can always resend from its own last-known page without risk.
256	        If a page is interrupted before it commits (process killed mid-way),
257	        the next attempt reruns the whole page; any observation within it
258	        that was already recorded replays as a harmless duplicate (see
259	        ingest_observation's own (attempt_id, sequence) idempotency), so
260	        nothing already applied is ever applied twice.
261	        """
262	        feed_id = storage.require_identifier(feed_id, name="feed_id")
263	        if not isinstance(page_number, int) or isinstance(page_number, bool) or page_number < 0:
264	            raise storage.ValidationError("page_number must be a non-negative integer")
265	
266	        committed = self._store.get_reconciliation_cursor(feed_id)
267	        if committed is not None and page_number <= committed:
268	            return PageIngestResult(
269	                feed_id=feed_id, page_number=page_number, committed_page=committed, skipped=True, results=[]
270	            )
271	
272	        results = self.ingest_feed(observations, now=now)
273	
274	        reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
275	        recorded_at = now or reference_dt.isoformat()
276	        self._store.commit_reconciliation_cursor(feed_id, page=page_number, now=recorded_at)
277	
278	        return PageIngestResult(
279	            feed_id=feed_id, page_number=page_number, committed_page=page_number, skipped=False, results=results
280	        )
281	
282	    def classify_delayed_attempts(self, *, now: Optional[str] = None) -> list:
283	        """Classify every reconciliation-tracked attempt for operator review.
284	
285	        Read-only: this issues no writes, retries nothing, and sends no
286	        mail. An attempt already confirmed DELIVERED is reported as
287	        delivered directly from its stored state; an attempt still
288	        ACCEPTED_DELAYED is still_pending while within its configured
289	        window (measured from the notification's last state change) and
290	        unresolved once that window has elapsed with no confirming
291	        observation.
292	        """
293	        reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
294	        window = self._policy.window_for(models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED)
295	
296	        classifications = []
297	        notifications = self._store.notifications_in_states(
298	            [models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED]
299	        )
300	        for notification in notifications:
301	            if notification.delivery_state == models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED:
302	                classifications.append(
303	                    DelayedAttemptClassification(
304	                        notification_id=notification.notification_id,
305	                        account_id=notification.account_id,
306	                        reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
307	                        delivery_state=notification.delivery_state,
308	                        status=models.DelayedAttemptStatus.DELIVERED,
309	                        age_minutes=None,
310	                    )
311	                )
312	                continue
313	
314	            age_minutes: Optional[float] = None
315	            status = models.DelayedAttemptStatus.STILL_PENDING
316	            if window is not None:
317	                last_attempted_dt = _parse_timestamp(notification.last_attempted_at)
318	                age_minutes = (reference_dt - last_attempted_dt).total_seconds() / 60.0
319	                if age_minutes > window.max_age_minutes:
320	                    status = models.DelayedAttemptStatus.UNRESOLVED
321	
322	            classifications.append(
323	                DelayedAttemptClassification(
324	                    notification_id=notification.notification_id,
325	                    account_id=notification.account_id,
326	                    reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
327	                    delivery_state=notification.delivery_state,
328	                    status=status,
329	                    age_minutes=age_minutes,
330	                )
331	            )
332	        return classifications
333	
334	    def select_unresolved(
335	        self,
336	        *,
337	        feed_id: str,
338	        limit: Optional[int] = None,
339	        now: Optional[str] = None,
340	    ) -> UnresolvedBatch:
341	        """Return the next capped batch of unresolved attempts for operator review.
342	
343	        Wraps classify_delayed_attempts (the existing selector) rather than
344	        reclassifying anything itself: only attempts it already buckets
345	        UNRESOLVED are candidates here, so delivered and still_pending
346	        notifications are never eligible. A notification whose owning
347	        recovery request has since expired is a terminal no-op even though
348	        its delivery state still looks unresolved -- there is no live
349	        recovery flow left to act on, so it is excluded rather than
350	        surfaced for follow-up.
351	
352	        Paging reuses the same durable reconciliation_cursors table and
353	        helpers as ingest_page, keyed by feed_id: the cursor stores how
354	        many eligible rows (in a stable notification_id order) have
355	        already been handed out, so repeated calls resume rather than
356	        re-emit the same batch. The cursor only advances when the batch is
357	        non-empty -- a call that finds nothing eligible leaves it
358	        untouched.
359	        """
360	        feed_id = storage.require_identifier(feed_id, name="feed_id")
361	        if limit is None:
362	            limit = DEFAULT_UNRESOLVED_BATCH
363	        if not isinstance(limit, int) or isinstance(limit, bool) or limit < 1:
364	            raise storage.ValidationError("limit must be a positive integer")
365	        limit = min(limit, MAX_UNRESOLVED_BATCH)
366	
367	        offset = self._store.get_reconciliation_cursor(feed_id) or 0
368	
369	        eligible = []
370	        for classification in self.classify_delayed_attempts(now=now):
371	            if classification.status != models.DelayedAttemptStatus.UNRESOLVED:
372	                continue
373	            notification = self._store.get_notification(classification.notification_id)
374	            request = self._store.get_recovery_request(notification.request_id)
375	            if request.status == models.RecoveryRequestStatus.EXPIRED:
376	                continue
377	            eligible.append(classification)
378	        eligible.sort(key=lambda c: c.notification_id)
379	
380	        batch = eligible[offset : offset + limit]
381	        next_offset = offset + len(batch)
382	
383	        if batch:
384	            reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
385	            recorded_at = now or reference_dt.isoformat()
386	            self._store.commit_reconciliation_cursor(feed_id, page=next_offset, now=recorded_at)
387	
388	        return UnresolvedBatch(feed_id=feed_id, offset=offset, next_offset=next_offset, attempts=batch)

maps each provider_state to a reconciliation_class and a staleness

be tied to a known account, folds the outcome back into that account's
most recent notification.

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Dict, Optional, Sequence

from . import models, storage
from .storage import Storage

MAX_ATTEMPT_ID_LENGTH = 256
DEFAULT_UNRESOLVED_BATCH = 20
MAX_UNRESOLVED_BATCH = 50


def _parse_timestamp(value: str) -> datetime:
    normalized = value[:-1] + "+00:00" if value.endswith("Z") else value
    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(normalized)
    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
        parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return parsed


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Window:
    window_id: str
    window_start: datetime
    window_end: datetime
    provider_state: str
    reconciliation_class: str
    max_age_minutes: int


class WindowPolicy:
    """Maps a provider_state to its reconciliation class and staleness bound."""

    def __init__(self, windows: Sequence[Window]) -> None:
        self._by_provider_state: Dict[str, Window] = {w.provider_state: w for w in windows}

    @classmethod
    def from_rows(cls, rows: Sequence[dict]) -> "WindowPolicy":
        windows = [
            Window(
                window_id=row["window_id"],
                window_start=_parse_timestamp(row["window_start"]),
                window_end=_parse_timestamp(row["window_end"]),
                provider_state=row["provider_state"],
                reconciliation_class=row["reconciliation_class"],
                max_age_minutes=int(row["max_age_minutes"]),
            )
            for row in rows
        ]
        return cls(windows)

    def window_for(self, provider_state: str) -> Optional[Window]:
        return self._by_provider_state.get(provider_state)

class IngestResult:
    attempt_id: str
    sequence: int
    reconciliation_class: Optional[str]

    reject_reason: Optional[str]

    page_number: int
    committed_page: int
    skipped: bool

    account_id: str
    reconciliation_id: Optional[str]

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UnresolvedBatch:

    offset: int
    next_offset: int

class ReconciliationEngine:
    """Applies provider reconciliation feeds against durably stored notifications.

    Observations are matched to a notification strictly by the opaque
    `reconciliation_id` this service minted and sent to the provider
    (surfaced back to us as the feed row's `attempt_id`) -- never by the
    feed's own claimed account/organization, which is treated as untrusted
    input to be validated against the matched notification's true owner.
    """

    def __init__(self, store: Storage, policy: WindowPolicy) -> None:
        self._store = store
        self._policy = policy

    def ingest_observation(
        self,
        *,
        attempt_id: str,
        organization_id: str,
        account_id: Optional[str],
        provider_state: str,
        observed_at: str,
        sequence: int,
        now: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> IngestResult:
        attempt_id = storage.require_bounded_text(attempt_id, name="attempt_id", max_length=MAX_ATTEMPT_ID_LENGTH)
        organization_id = storage.require_identifier(organization_id, name="organization_id")
        provider_state = storage.require_bounded_text(provider_state, name="provider_state", max_length=64)
        if account_id is not None:
            account_id = storage.require_identifier(account_id, name="account_id")
        if not isinstance(sequence, int) or isinstance(sequence, bool):
            raise storage.ValidationError("sequence must be an integer")

        observed_dt = _parse_timestamp(observed_at)
        reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        recorded_at = now or reference_dt.isoformat()

        window = self._policy.window_for(provider_state)
        reconciliation_class = window.reconciliation_class if window is not None else None
        is_stale: Optional[bool] = None
        if window is not None:
            age_minutes = (reference_dt - observed_dt).total_seconds() / 60.0
            is_stale = age_minutes > window.max_age_minutes

        existing = self._store.find_observation(attempt_id=attempt_id, sequence=sequence)
        if existing is not None:
            # A duplicate feed-page replay: the exact (attempt_id, sequence)
            # pair was already recorded, so re-applying it would risk a
            # double transition. Echo back what was recorded the first time.
            return IngestResult(
                attempt_id=attempt_id,
                sequence=sequence,
                reconciliation_class=existing.reconciliation_class,
                is_stale=existing.is_stale,
                matched_notification_id=existing.matched_notification_id,
                applied=False,
                reject_reason=models.ObservationRejectReason.DUPLICATE,
            )

        matched_notification_id: Optional[str] = None
        applied = False
        reject_reason: Optional[str] = None

        notification = self._store.find_notification_by_reconciliation_id(attempt_id)
        if notification is None:
            reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.UNMATCHED_ATTEMPT_ID
        else:
            matched_notification_id = notification.notification_id
            account = self._store.get_account(notification.account_id)
            if account.organization_id != organization_id:
                reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.ORGANIZATION_MISMATCH
            else:
                max_seen = self._store.max_sequence_for_attempt(attempt_id)
                if max_seen is not None and sequence <= max_seen:
                    reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE
                elif reconciliation_class == models.ReconciliationClass.CLOSE_CONFIRMED:
                    self._store.set_notification_delivery_state(
                        notification_id=notification.notification_id,
                        delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED,
                        now=recorded_at,
                    )
                    applied = True
                elif reconciliation_class == models.ReconciliationClass.RETAIN_UNRESOLVED:
                    if notification.delivery_state in models.DeliveryState.TERMINAL:
                        # Provider is trying to reopen a delivery we already
                        # confirmed closed out -- a backward, malformed
                        # transition. Leave the notification untouched.
                        reject_reason = models.ObservationRejectReason.MALFORMED_TRANSITION
                    else:
                        self._store.set_notification_delivery_state(
                            notification_id=notification.notification_id,
                            delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED,
                            now=recorded_at,
                        )
                        applied = True
                # Any other class (REVIEW_UNMATCHED, or no window at all)
                # carries no notification-state action by design.

        self._store.record_reconciliation_observation(
            attempt_id=attempt_id,
            organization_id=organization_id,
            account_id=account_id,
            provider_state=provider_state,
            observed_at=observed_at,
            sequence=sequence,
            reconciliation_class=reconciliation_class,
            is_stale=is_stale,
            matched_notification_id=matched_notification_id,
            applied=applied,
            reject_reason=reject_reason,
            now=recorded_at,
        )

        return IngestResult(
            attempt_id=attempt_id,
            sequence=sequence,
            reconciliation_class=reconciliation_class,
            is_stale=is_stale,
            matched_notification_id=matched_notification_id,
            applied=applied,
            reject_reason=reject_reason,
        )

    def ingest_feed(self, observations: Sequence[dict], *, now: Optional[str] = None) -> list:
        return [
            self.ingest_observation(
                attempt_id=obs["attempt_id"],
                organization_id=obs["organization_id"],
                account_id=obs.get("account_id"),
                provider_state=obs["provider_state"],
                observed_at=obs["observed_at"],
                sequence=obs["sequence"],
                now=now,
            )
            for obs in observations
        ]

    def ingest_page(
        self,
        *,
        feed_id: str,
        page_number: int,
        observations: Sequence[dict],
        now: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> PageIngestResult:
        """Ingest one page of a durable, resumable feed import.

        The durable cursor commits at page granularity: once page N is
        committed for this feed_id, replaying page N (or any earlier page)
        is a pure no-op -- the observations are not even re-read -- so a
        caller can always resend from its own last-known page without risk.
        If a page is interrupted before it commits (process killed mid-way),
        the next attempt reruns the whole page; any observation within it
        that was already recorded replays as a harmless duplicate (see
        ingest_observation's own (attempt_id, sequence) idempotency), so
        nothing already applied is ever applied twice.
        """
        feed_id = storage.require_identifier(feed_id, name="feed_id")
        if not isinstance(page_number, int) or isinstance(page_number, bool) or page_number < 0:
            raise storage.ValidationError("page_number must be a non-negative integer")

        committed = self._store.get_reconciliation_cursor(feed_id)
        if committed is not None and page_number <= committed:
            return PageIngestResult(
                feed_id=feed_id, page_number=page_number, committed_page=committed, skipped=True, results=[]
            )

        results = self.ingest_feed(observations, now=now)

        reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        recorded_at = now or reference_dt.isoformat()
        self._store.commit_reconciliation_cursor(feed_id, page=page_number, now=recorded_at)

        return PageIngestResult(
            feed_id=feed_id, page_number=page_number, committed_page=page_number, skipped=False, results=results
        )

    def classify_delayed_attempts(self, *, now: Optional[str] = None) -> list:
        """Classify every reconciliation-tracked attempt for operator review.

        Read-only: this issues no writes, retries nothing, and sends no
        mail. An attempt already confirmed DELIVERED is reported as
        delivered directly from its stored state; an attempt still
        ACCEPTED_DELAYED is still_pending while within its configured
        window (measured from the notification's last state change) and
        unresolved once that window has elapsed with no confirming
        observation.
        """
        reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        window = self._policy.window_for(models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED)

        classifications = []
        notifications = self._store.notifications_in_states(
            [models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED]
        )
        for notification in notifications:
            if notification.delivery_state == models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED:
                classifications.append(
                    DelayedAttemptClassification(
                        notification_id=notification.notification_id,
                        account_id=notification.account_id,
                        reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
                        delivery_state=notification.delivery_state,
                        status=models.DelayedAttemptStatus.DELIVERED,
                        age_minutes=None,
                    )
                )
                continue

            age_minutes: Optional[float] = None
            status = models.DelayedAttemptStatus.STILL_PENDING
            if window is not None:
                last_attempted_dt = _parse_timestamp(notification.last_attempted_at)
                age_minutes = (reference_dt - last_attempted_dt).total_seconds() / 60.0
                if age_minutes > window.max_age_minutes:
                    status = models.DelayedAttemptStatus.UNRESOLVED

            classifications.append(
                DelayedAttemptClassification(
                    notification_id=notification.notification_id,
                    account_id=notification.account_id,
                    reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
                    delivery_state=notification.delivery_state,
                    status=status,
                    age_minutes=age_minutes,
                )
            )
        return classifications

    def select_unresolved(
        self,
        *,
        feed_id: str,
        limit: Optional[int] = None,
        now: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> UnresolvedBatch:
        """Return the next capped batch of unresolved attempts for operator review.

        Wraps classify_delayed_attempts (the existing selector) rather than
        reclassifying anything itself: only attempts it already buckets
        UNRESOLVED are candidates here, so delivered and still_pending
        notifications are never eligible. A notification whose owning
        recovery request has since expired is a terminal no-op even though
        its delivery state still looks unresolved -- there is no live
        recovery flow left to act on, so it is excluded rather than
        surfaced for follow-up.

        Paging reuses the same durable reconciliation_cursors table and
        helpers as ingest_page, keyed by feed_id: the cursor stores how
        many eligible rows (in a stable notification_id order) have
        already been handed out, so repeated calls resume rather than
        re-emit the same batch. The cursor only advances when the batch is
        non-empty -- a call that finds nothing eligible leaves it
        untouched.
        """
        feed_id = storage.require_identifier(feed_id, name="feed_id")
        if limit is None:
            limit = DEFAULT_UNRESOLVED_BATCH
        if not isinstance(limit, int) or isinstance(limit, bool) or limit < 1:
            raise storage.ValidationError("limit must be a positive integer")
        limit = min(limit, MAX_UNRESOLVED_BATCH)

        offset = self._store.get_reconciliation_cursor(feed_id) or 0

        eligible = []
        for classification in self.classify_delayed_attempts(now=now):
            if classification.status != models.DelayedAttemptStatus.UNRESOLVED:
                continue
            notification = self._store.get_notification(classification.notification_id)
            request = self._store.get_recovery_request(notification.request_id)
            if request.status == models.RecoveryRequestStatus.EXPIRED:
                continue
            eligible.append(classification)
        eligible.sort(key=lambda c: c.notification_id)

        batch = eligible[offset : offset + limit]
        next_offset = offset + len(batch)

        if batch:
            reference_dt = _parse_timestamp(now) if now is not None else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            recorded_at = now or reference_dt.isoformat()
            self._store.commit_reconciliation_cursor(feed_id, page=next_offset, now=recorded_at)

        return UnresolvedBatch(feed_id=feed_id, offset=offset, next_offset=next_offset, attempts=batch)

"""Two-process test: --recovery-ttl-seconds expiry survives a service restart.

Expiry must be enforced from the absolute timestamp persisted in SQLite,
not from any in-memory state of the process that created the token. This
spins up a real `serve` subprocess, creates two tokens under a 2-second
TTL, completes one immediately, waits past expiry, kills that process,
starts a brand new one against the same database file, and confirms the
second token is now refused as expired.
"""
import json
import os
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

from accountsvc.storage import Storage

from .helpers import FakeMailProviderServer

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
BEARER_TOKEN = "restart-test-admin-token"  # noqa: S105 - fixture credential, not a real secret
READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10.0


def _free_port() -> int:
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


def _wait_until_ready(host: str, port: int, timeout: float = READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) -> None:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    last_error = None
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        try:
            with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=0.2):
                return
        except OSError as exc:
            last_error = exc
            time.sleep(0.1)
    raise TimeoutError(f"server on {host}:{port} did not become ready: {last_error}")


def _post(base_url: str, path: str, payload: dict):
    body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    request = urllib.request.Request(base_url + path, data=body, method="POST")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
            return response.status, json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        with exc:
            return exc.code, json.loads(exc.read().decode("utf-8"))


class TtlRestartTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        fd, self.db_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
        os.close(fd)
        os.remove(self.db_path)

        # Create the account up front, through a short-lived direct
        # connection, and close it before any serve subprocess opens the
        # same database file.
        store = Storage(self.db_path)
        store.create_account(
            organization_id="org-riverbend", account_id="acct-delay-a", email="priya@riverbend.example", now="t0"
        )
        store.close()

        self.mail_provider = FakeMailProviderServer()
        self.mail_provider.set_success()

        self.processes = []
        self.addCleanup(self._cleanup)

    def _cleanup(self):
        for process in self.processes:
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.terminate()
                try:
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    process.kill()
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
        self.mail_provider.shutdown()
        for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
            candidate = self.db_path + suffix
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                os.remove(candidate)

    def _start_serve_process(self, *, port: int, recovery_ttl_seconds: int) -> str:
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            [
                sys.executable,
                "-m",
                "accountsvc.cli",
                "serve",
                "--database",
                self.db_path,
                "--bearer-token",
                BEARER_TOKEN,
                "--mail-endpoint",
                self.mail_provider.url,
                "--host",
                "127.0.0.1",
                "--port",
                str(port),
                "--recovery-ttl-seconds",
                str(recovery_ttl_seconds),
            ],
            cwd=str(PROJECT_ROOT),
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        )
        self.processes.append(process)
        _wait_until_ready("127.0.0.1", port)
        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"

    def test_expiry_persists_and_is_enforced_across_a_process_restart(self):
        first_port = _free_port()
        base_url = self._start_serve_process(port=first_port, recovery_ttl_seconds=2)

        # Create two tokens under the 2-second TTL.
        status, _ = _post(
            base_url, "/recovery/start", {"organization": "org-riverbend", "email": "priya@riverbend.example"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 202)
        first_token = self.mail_provider.last_captured()["recovery_token"]

        status, _ = _post(
            base_url, "/recovery/start", {"organization": "org-riverbend", "email": "priya@riverbend.example"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 202)
        second_token = self.mail_provider.last_captured()["recovery_token"]

        self.assertNotEqual(first_token, second_token)

        # Complete the first token immediately, well inside the TTL.
        status, payload = _post(base_url, "/recovery/complete", {"token": first_token})
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(payload["account_id"], "acct-delay-a")

        # Wait past the 2-second expiry.
        time.sleep(3)

        # Kill the first process to simulate a service restart, then start
        # a brand new process against the same database file.
        first_process = self.processes[0]
        first_process.terminate()
        first_process.wait(timeout=5)

        second_port = _free_port()
        restarted_base_url = self._start_serve_process(port=second_port, recovery_ttl_seconds=2)

        status, payload = _post(restarted_base_url, "/recovery/complete", {"token": second_token})
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertIn("expired", payload["error"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        with exc:
            return exc.code, json.loads(exc.read().decode("utf-8"))


class ReconciliationRestartTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        fd, self.db_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
        os.close(fd)
        os.remove(self.db_path)

        # Seed an account, recovery request, and a notification with a known
        # reconciliation id directly -- reconciliation import does not
        # depend on ever having sent mail, only on a notification existing
        # under that attempt id.
        store = Storage(self.db_path)
        store.create_account(
            organization_id="org-riverbend", account_id="acct-delay-a", email="priya@riverbend.example", now="t0"
        )
        store.create_recovery_request(
            request_id="req-restart-1",
            organization_id="org-riverbend",
            account_id="acct-delay-a",
            token_hash="unused",
            created_at="t0",
            expires_at="2099-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
        )
        store.create_notification(
            notification_id="notif-restart-1",
            request_id="req-restart-1",
            account_id="acct-delay-a",
            recipient="priya@riverbend.example",
            delivery_state="accepted_delayed",
            provider_receipt="seed-receipt",
            reconciliation_id="restart-attempt-1",
            retry_locator=None,
            now="t0",
        )
        store.close()

        self.processes = []
        self.addCleanup(self._cleanup)

    def _cleanup(self):
        for process in self.processes:
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.terminate()
                try:
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    process.kill()
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
        for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
            candidate = self.db_path + suffix
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                os.remove(candidate)

    def _start_serve_process(self, *, port: int) -> str:
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            [
                sys.executable,
                "-m",
                "accountsvc.cli",
                "serve",
                "--database",
                self.db_path,
                "--bearer-token",
                BEARER_TOKEN,
                "--mail-endpoint",
                "http://127.0.0.1:1/unused",
                "--host",
                "127.0.0.1",
                "--port",
                str(port),
                "--window-policy",
                str(WINDOW_POLICY_CSV),
            ],
            cwd=str(PROJECT_ROOT),
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        )
        self.processes.append(process)
        _wait_until_ready("127.0.0.1", port)
        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"

    def test_out_of_order_rejection_survives_a_process_restart(self):
        first_port = _free_port()
        base_url = self._start_serve_process(port=first_port)

        status, payload = _post(
            base_url,
            "/reconciliation/import",
            {
                "observations": [
                    {
                        "attempt_id": "restart-attempt-1",
                        "organization_id": "org-riverbend",
                        "account_id": "acct-delay-a",
                        "provider_state": "accepted_delayed",
                        "observed_at": "2026-08-30T01:07:00Z",
                        "sequence": 100,
                    }
                ],
                "now": "2026-08-30T01:17:00Z",
            },
            token=BEARER_TOKEN,
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertTrue(payload["results"][0]["applied"])
        self.assertIsNone(payload["results"][0]["reject_reason"])

        first_process = self.processes[0]
        first_process.terminate()
        first_process.wait(timeout=5)

        second_port = _free_port()
        restarted_base_url = self._start_serve_process(port=second_port)

        # A stale replay carrying a lower sequence than what process 1
        # already recorded must still be rejected as out of order -- this
        # only holds if the max-sequence-per-attempt history was durably
        # persisted, since process 2 never saw sequence 100 in memory.
        status, payload = _post(
            restarted_base_url,
            "/reconciliation/import",
            {
                "observations": [
                    {
                        "attempt_id": "restart-attempt-1",
                        "organization_id": "org-riverbend",
                        "account_id": "acct-delay-a",
                        "provider_state": "accepted_delayed",
                        "observed_at": "2026-08-30T01:06:00Z",
                        "sequence": 50,
                    }
                ],
                "now": "2026-08-30T01:17:00Z",
            },
            token=BEARER_TOKEN,
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertFalse(payload["results"][0]["applied"])
        self.assertEqual(payload["results"][0]["reject_reason"], "out_of_order_sequence")

        # Unauthenticated access to the administrative route is still
        # refused after the restart.
        body = json.dumps({"observations": []}).encode("utf-8")
        request = urllib.request.Request(restarted_base_url + "/reconciliation/import", data=body, method="POST")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
                status = response.status
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            with exc:
                status = exc.code
        self.assertEqual(status, 401)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from accountsvc import models, notice
from accountsvc.recovery import (
    RecoveryService,
    TokenAlreadyUsedError,
    TokenExpiredError,
    TokenInvalidError,
)
from accountsvc.storage import Storage
from accountsvc.tokens import hash_token, new_request_id

from .helpers import FakeMailer, accepted_delayed, delivered, failed


class RecoveryTestCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        fd, self.path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
        os.close(fd)
        os.remove(self.path)
        self.store = Storage(self.path)
        self.addCleanup(self._cleanup)
        self.store.create_account(
            organization_id="org-riverbend", account_id="acct-delay-a", email="priya@riverbend.example", now="t0"
        )

    def _cleanup(self):
        self.store.close()
        for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
            candidate = self.path + suffix
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                os.remove(candidate)


class StartRecoveryTests(RecoveryTestCase):
    def test_successful_delivery_marks_notification_delivered(self):
        mailer = FakeMailer([delivered()])
        service = RecoveryService(self.store, mailer)

        result = service.start_recovery(organization_id="org-riverbend", email="priya@riverbend.example")

        self.assertEqual(result.delivery_status, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED)
        notifications = self.store.notifications_for_request(result.request_id)
        self.assertEqual(len(notifications), 1)
        self.assertIsNone(notifications[0].retry_locator)

    def test_accepted_delayed_delivery_persists_full_durable_record(self):
        mailer = FakeMailer([accepted_delayed(receipt="provider-receipt-delayed")])
        service = RecoveryService(self.store, mailer)

        result = service.start_recovery(organization_id="org-riverbend", email="priya@riverbend.example")

        self.assertEqual(result.delivery_status, models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED)
        notification = self.store.notifications_for_request(result.request_id)[0]

        # Trusted account binding: resolved at start, not decoded from anything opaque.
        self.assertEqual(notification.account_id, "acct-delay-a")
        # Original recipient used for this specific attempt.
        self.assertEqual(notification.recipient, "priya@riverbend.example")
        # Opaque provider receipt, stored verbatim.
        self.assertEqual(notification.provider_receipt, "provider-receipt-delayed")
        # A reconciliation id was minted and persisted for later correlation.
        self.assertTrue(notification.reconciliation_id)
        # encode_retry_locator's output, so a delayed delivery can also be rebuilt later.
        self.assertEqual(
            notification.retry_locator,
            notice.encode_retry_locator("provider-receipt-delayed", "acct-delay-a"),
        )

    def test_failed_delivery_persists_full_durable_record(self):
        mailer = FakeMailer([failed(receipt="provider-down")])
        service = RecoveryService(self.store, mailer)

        result = service.start_recovery(organization_id="org-riverbend", email="priya@riverbend.example")

        self.assertEqual(result.delivery_status, models.DeliveryState.FAILED)
        notification = self.store.notifications_for_request(result.request_id)[0]

        self.assertEqual(notification.account_id, "acct-delay-a")
        self.assertEqual(notification.recipient, "priya@riverbend.example")
        self.assertEqual(notification.provider_receipt, "provider-down")
        self.assertTrue(notification.reconciliation_id)
        self.assertEqual(notification.retry_locator, notice.encode_retry_locator("provider-down", "acct-delay-a"))

    def test_reconciliation_id_is_sent_to_the_mail_endpoint(self):
        mailer = FakeMailer([failed()])
        service = RecoveryService(self.store, mailer)

        result = service.start_recovery(organization_id="org-riverbend", email="priya@riverbend.example")
        notification = self.store.notifications_for_request(result.request_id)[0]

        recipient, recovery_token, reconciliation_id = mailer.calls[0]
        self.assertEqual(recipient, "priya@riverbend.example")
        self.assertEqual(reconciliation_id, notification.reconciliation_id)

    def test_unknown_email_does_not_leak_account_existence(self):
        mailer = FakeMailer([delivered()])
        service = RecoveryService(self.store, mailer)

        result = service.start_recovery(organization_id="org-riverbend", email="nobody@riverbend.example")

        self.assertTrue(result.request_id)
        self.assertEqual(len(mailer.calls), 0)

    def test_organization_scope_prevents_cross_org_email_match(self):
        self.store.create_account(
            organization_id="org-other", account_id="acct-other", email="shared@example.com", now="t0"
        )
        mailer = FakeMailer([delivered()])
        service = RecoveryService(self.store, mailer)

        service.start_recovery(organization_id="org-riverbend", email="shared@example.com")

        self.assertEqual(len(mailer.calls), 0)


class RetryNotificationTests(RecoveryTestCase):
    def test_retry_uses_current_email_even_after_change(self):
        mailer = FakeMailer([failed(), delivered()])
        service = RecoveryService(self.store, mailer)

        result = service.start_recovery(organization_id="org-riverbend", email="priya@riverbend.example")
        notifications = self.store.notifications_for_request(result.request_id)
        notification_id = notifications[0].notification_id
        self.assertEqual(notifications[0].delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.FAILED)

        # The account moves to a new address before the retry fires.
        self.store.change_email(account_id="acct-delay-a", new_email="priya-new@riverbend.example", now="t1")

        updated = service.retry_notification(notification_id)

        self.assertEqual(updated.delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED)
        self.assertEqual(mailer.calls[-1][0], "priya-new@riverbend.example")

    def test_retry_mints_a_new_token_rather_than_reusing_the_original(self):
        mailer = FakeMailer([failed(), delivered()])
        service = RecoveryService(self.store, mailer)

        result = service.start_recovery(organization_id="org-riverbend", email="priya@riverbend.example")
        notification_id = self.store.notifications_for_request(result.request_id)[0].notification_id
        first_token = mailer.calls[0][1]

        service.retry_notification(notification_id)
        second_token = mailer.calls[1][1]

        self.assertNotEqual(first_token, second_token)
        # The original token must no longer complete the request.
        with self.assertRaises(TokenInvalidError):
            service.complete_recovery(token=first_token)
        service.complete_recovery(token=second_token)

    def test_retry_pending_notifications_processes_failed_batch(self):
        mailer = FakeMailer([failed(), delivered()])
        service = RecoveryService(self.store, mailer)
        service.start_recovery(organization_id="org-riverbend", email="priya@riverbend.example")

        updated = service.retry_pending_notifications()

        self.assertEqual(len(updated), 1)
        self.assertEqual(updated[0].delivery_state, models.DeliveryState.DELIVERED)


class CompleteRecoveryTests(RecoveryTestCase):
    def test_complete_recovery_succeeds_with_correct_token(self):
        mailer = FakeMailer([delivered()])
        service = RecoveryService(self.store, mailer)
        service.start_recovery(organization_id="org-riverbend", email="priya@riverbend.example")
        token = mailer.calls[0][1]

        result = service.complete_recovery(token=token)

        self.assertEqual(result.account_id, "acct-delay-a")

    def test_complete_recovery_rejects_reuse(self):
        mailer = FakeMailer([delivered()])
        service = RecoveryService(self.store, mailer)
        service.start_recovery(organization_id="org-riverbend", email="priya@riverbend.example")
        token = mailer.calls[0][1]

        service.complete_recovery(token=token)
        with self.assertRaises(TokenAlreadyUsedError):
            service.complete_recovery(token=token)

    def test_complete_recovery_rejects_unknown_token(self):
        mailer = FakeMailer([delivered()])
        service = RecoveryService(self.store, mailer)
        with self.assertRaises(TokenInvalidError):
            service.complete_recovery(token="not-a-real-token")

    def test_complete_recovery_rejects_expired_token(self):
        mailer = FakeMailer([delivered()])

    def _post(self, path, payload=None, *, headers=None, raw_body=None, content_length=None):

        )
        if content_length is not None:

        try:

        host, port = self.server.server_address
        with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=5) as sock:
            sock.sendall(
                b"POST /recovery/start HTTP/1.1\r\n"
                b"Host: 127.0.0.1\r\n"
                b"Content-Type: application/json\r\n"
                b"Connection: close\r\n"
                b"\r\n"
            )
            response = b""

    def test_unresolved_batch_table(self):
        # Shared feed_id: the "terminal no-op" row proves the cursor left
        # by the "unresolved row" case is not re-emitted, and that a
        # notification excluded as ineligible does not advance it either.
        state = {}

        def setup_auth_refusal():
            return {"feed_id": "ops-feed"}, {}

        def setup_unresolved_row():
            self.mail_provider.set_success(state="accepted_delayed")
            self._post("/recovery/start", {"organization": "org-riverbend", "email": "priya@riverbend.example"})
            notification = self.store.notifications_by_account("acct-delay-a")[-1]
            last_attempted = datetime.fromisoformat(notification.last_attempted_at)
            # The configured window in _WINDOW_ROWS is 30 minutes -- well past it.
            state["now"] = (last_attempted + timedelta(minutes=45)).isoformat()
            state["unresolved_notification_id"] = notification.notification_id
            return {"feed_id": "ops-feed", "now": state["now"]}, {"Authorization": f"Bearer {BEARER_TOKEN}"}

        def setup_terminal_no_op():
            # A second accepted_delayed notification whose owning recovery
            # request has since expired: it would classify as unresolved
            # by delivery state alone, but must remain ineligible.
            self._post("/recovery/start", {"organization": "org-riverbend", "email": "priya@riverbend.example"})
            notification = self.store.notifications_by_account("acct-delay-a")[-1]
            self.store.mark_recovery_request_expired(notification.request_id)
            return {"feed_id": "ops-feed", "now": state["now"]}, {"Authorization": f"Bearer {BEARER_TOKEN}"}

        cases = [
            {
                "name": "auth_refusal",
                "setup": setup_auth_refusal,
                "expected_status": 401,
            },
            {
                "name": "one_unresolved_row",
                "setup": setup_unresolved_row,
                "expected_status": 200,
                "expected_attempt_count": 1,
                "expected_first_status": "unresolved",
                "expected_offset": 0,
                "expected_next_offset": 1,
            },
            {
                "name": "terminal_no_op",
                "setup": setup_terminal_no_op,
                "expected_status": 200,
                "expected_attempt_count": 0,
                "expected_offset": 1,
                "expected_next_offset": 1,
            },
        ]

        captured_before = len(self.mail_provider.behavior.captured)
        for case in cases:
            with self.subTest(case["name"]):
                body, headers = case["setup"]()
                status, payload = self._post("/reconciliation/unresolved", body, headers=headers)
                self.assertEqual(status, case["expected_status"])
                if status != 200:
                    continue
                attempts = payload["attempts"]
                self.assertEqual(len(attempts), case["expected_attempt_count"])
                if case["expected_attempt_count"]:
                    self.assertEqual(attempts[0]["status"], case["expected_first_status"])
                self.assertEqual(payload["offset"], case["expected_offset"])
                self.assertEqual(payload["next_offset"], case["expected_next_offset"])

        # Selecting unresolved attempts for review never sends mail, and the
        # notification left in the expired-request row is untouched.
        self.assertEqual(len(self.mail_provider.behavior.captured), captured_before + 2)
        expired_notification = self.store.notifications_by_account("acct-delay-a")[-1]
        self.assertEqual(expired_notification.delivery_state, "accepted_delayed")

"""Command-line entry point for accountsvc.

Stable CLI shapes (do not change these argument orders/flags):

    python -m accountsvc.cli create-account ORG_ID ACCOUNT_ID EMAIL --database STATE.db
    python -m accountsvc.cli change-email ACCOUNT_ID NEW_EMAIL --database STATE.db
    python -m accountsvc.cli show-account ACCOUNT_ID --database STATE.db
    python -m accountsvc.cli serve --database STATE.db --bearer-token TOKEN --mail-endpoint URL
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import dataclasses
import json
import sys
from typing import Optional, Sequence

from . import fixtures, reconciliation
from .mailer import Mailer
from .recovery import DEFAULT_RECOVERY_TTL_SECONDS, RecoveryService, now_iso
from .storage import ConflictError, NotFoundError, Storage, ValidationError


def _positive_int(value: str) -> int:
    try:
        parsed = int(value)
    except ValueError:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{value!r} is not an integer")
    if parsed <= 0:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{value!r} must be a positive integer")
    return parsed


def _account_to_dict(account) -> dict:
    return {
        "account_id": account.account_id,
        "organization_id": account.organization_id,
        "display_name": account.display_name,
        "current_email": account.current_email,
        "email_status": account.email_status,
        "mfa_enabled": account.mfa_enabled,
        "created_at": account.created_at,
        "updated_at": account.updated_at,
    }


def _cmd_create_account(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    store = Storage(args.database)
    try:
        store.create_account(
            organization_id=args.organization_id,
            account_id=args.account_id,
            email=args.email,
            display_name=args.display_name or args.account_id,
            mfa_enabled=args.mfa_enabled,
            now=now_iso(),
        )
    except (ValidationError, ConflictError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        store.close()
    print(json.dumps({"status": "created", "account_id": args.account_id}))
    return 0


def _cmd_change_email(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    store = Storage(args.database)
    try:
        account = store.change_email(account_id=args.account_id, new_email=args.new_email, now=now_iso())
    except (ValidationError, ConflictError, NotFoundError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        store.close()
    print(json.dumps(_account_to_dict(account)))
    return 0


def _cmd_show_account(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    store = Storage(args.database)
    try:
        account = store.get_account(args.account_id)
    except (ValidationError, NotFoundError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        store.close()
    print(json.dumps(_account_to_dict(account)))
    return 0


def _cmd_serve(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    from .httpapi import make_server

    store = Storage(args.database)
    mailer = Mailer(args.mail_endpoint)
    service = RecoveryService(store, mailer, recovery_ttl_seconds=args.recovery_ttl_seconds)

    reconciliation_engine = None
    if args.window_policy is not None:
        windows = fixtures.load_delivery_windows(args.window_policy)
        policy = reconciliation.WindowPolicy.from_rows(windows)
        reconciliation_engine = reconciliation.ReconciliationEngine(store, policy)

    server = make_server(
        host=args.host,
        port=args.port,
        recovery_service=service,
        bearer_token=args.bearer_token,
        reconciliation_engine=reconciliation_engine,
    )
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
        store.close()
    return 0


def _cmd_reconcile(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    store = Storage(args.database)
    try:
        windows = fixtures.load_delivery_windows(args.window_policy)
        feed = fixtures.load_reconciliation_feed(args.feed)
        policy = reconciliation.WindowPolicy.from_rows(windows)
        engine = reconciliation.ReconciliationEngine(store, policy)
        results = engine.ingest_feed(feed, now=args.now)
    except (ValidationError, ValueError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        store.close()
    print(json.dumps([dataclasses.asdict(r) for r in results]))
    return 0


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m accountsvc.cli")
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    create = subparsers.add_parser("create-account")
    create.add_argument("organization_id")
    create.add_argument("account_id")
    create.add_argument("email")
    create.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    create.add_argument("--display-name", default=None)
    create.add_argument("--mfa-enabled", action="store_true")
    create.set_defaults(func=_cmd_create_account)

    change = subparsers.add_parser("change-email")
    change.add_argument("account_id")
    change.add_argument("new_email")
    change.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    change.set_defaults(func=_cmd_change_email)

    show = subparsers.add_parser("show-account")
    show.add_argument("account_id")
    show.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    show.set_defaults(func=_cmd_show_account)

    serve = subparsers.add_parser("serve")
    serve.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--bearer-token", required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--mail-endpoint", required=True)
    serve.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    serve.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8765)
    serve.add_argument("--recovery-ttl-seconds", type=_positive_int, default=DEFAULT_RECOVERY_TTL_SECONDS)
    serve.add_argument("--window-policy", default=None)
    serve.set_defaults(func=_cmd_serve)

    reconcile = subparsers.add_parser("reconcile")
    reconcile.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    reconcile.add_argument("--window-policy", required=True)
    reconcile.add_argument("--feed", required=True)
    reconcile.add_argument("--now", default=None)
    reconcile.set_defaults(func=_cmd_reconcile)

    return parser


def main(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    return args.func(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

2	
3	accounts-riverbend.yaml uses a narrow, predictable subset of YAML (flat
4	scalar keys plus one list-of-mappings key), so it is parsed here with a
5	small indentation-aware reader instead of pulling in a YAML dependency.
6	"""
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	import csv
10	import json
11	from typing import Any, Dict, List
12	
13	MAX_FIXTURE_BYTES = 1_048_576
14	MAX_LINE_BYTES = 65_536
15

17	def _read_bounded(path: str) -> str:
18	    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
19	        text = handle.read(MAX_FIXTURE_BYTES + 1)
20	    if len(text) > MAX_FIXTURE_BYTES:
21	        raise ValueError(f"fixture {path!r} exceeds maximum size of {MAX_FIXTURE_BYTES} bytes")
22	    return text
23	
24	
25	def _parse_scalar(value: str) -> Any:
26	    if value == "":
27	        return None
28	    if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in ("'", '"'):
29	        return value[1:-1]
30	    lowered = value.lower()
31	    if lowered == "true":
32	        return True
33	    if lowered == "false":
34	        return False
35	    if lowered in ("null", "~"):
36	        return None
37	    try:
38	        return int(value)
39	    except ValueError:
40	        pass
41	    try:
42	        return float(value)
43	    except ValueError:
44	        pass
45	    return value
46	
47	
48	def load_riverbend_accounts(path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
49	    """Parse the narrow YAML subset used by accounts-riverbend.yaml."""
50	
51	    root: Dict[str, Any] = {}
52	    current_list_key = None
53	    current_item: Dict[str, Any] = None
54	
55	    for raw_line in _read_bounded(path).splitlines():
56	        if len(raw_line) > MAX_LINE_BYTES:
57	            raise ValueError("fixture line exceeds maximum length")
58	        line = raw_line.rstrip()
59	        stripped = line.strip()
60	        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
61	            continue
62	        indent = len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" "))
63	
64	        if indent == 0:
65	            current_list_key = None
66	            current_item = None
67	            key, _, value = stripped.partition(":")
68	            key = key.strip()
69	            value = value.strip()
70	            if value:
71	                root[key] = _parse_scalar(value)
72	            else:
73	                root[key] = []
74	                current_list_key = key
75	            continue
76	
77	        if stripped.startswith("- "):
78	            item: Dict[str, Any] = {}
79	            root[current_list_key].append(item)
80	            current_item = item
81	            key, _, value = stripped[2:].partition(":")
82	            current_item[key.strip()] = _parse_scalar(value.strip())
83	            continue
84	
85	        if current_item is not None:
86	            key, _, value = stripped.partition(":")
87	            current_item[key.strip()] = _parse_scalar(value.strip())
88	
89	    return root
90	
91	
92	def load_delivery_windows(path: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
93	    text = _read_bounded(path)
94	    reader = csv.DictReader(text.splitlines())
95	    return [dict(row) for row in reader]
96	
97	
98	def load_reconciliation_feed(path: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
99	    records = []
100	    for line in _read_bounded(path).splitlines():
101	        line = line.strip()
102	        if not line:
103	            continue
104	        if len(line) > MAX_LINE_BYTES:
105	            raise ValueError("feed line exceeds maximum length")
106	        records.append(json.loads(line))
107	    return records

"""Recovery request lifecycle: start, complete, and notification retry.

A recovery token is minted once, hashed for storage, and handed to the
mailer as plaintext exactly once. If delivery fails outright (the
provider never accepted it), nothing was ever exposed to the recipient,
so a retry safely mints a fresh token for the same request rather than
retaining the original secret anywhere durable.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import List

from . import models, notice, storage, tokens
from .mailer import Mailer
from .storage import ConflictError, Storage

DEFAULT_RECOVERY_TTL_SECONDS = 900
MAX_RETRY_BATCH = 50

# States for which a durable retry locator (and reconciliation id) must be
# retained: the delivery has not been confirmed, so a later turn may need
# to rebuild it. DELIVERED is terminal and needs neither.
_LOCATOR_REQUIRED_STATES = frozenset({models.DeliveryState.FAILED, models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED})


def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import List, Sequence

from . import models, notice, storage, tokens
from .mailer import Mailer
from .storage import ConflictError, Storage

DEFAULT_RECOVERY_TTL_SECONDS = 900
MAX_RETRY_BATCH = 50

# States for which a durable retry locator (and reconciliation id) must be
# retained: the delivery has not been confirmed, so a later turn may need
# to rebuild it. DELIVERED is terminal and needs neither.
_LOCATOR_REQUIRED_STATES = frozenset({models.DeliveryState.FAILED, models.DeliveryState.ACCEPTED_DELAYED})

# Notifications eligible for retry_notifications: the ordinary
# provider-rejected compatibility path (FAILED/RETRYING) plus an
# ACCEPTED_DELAYED notice a caller has already determined reconciliation
# left unresolved. This service does not re-derive window staleness
# itself -- that judgement belongs to whatever classified the notice as

        if account is None:

        if request.status == models.RecoveryRequestStatus.EXPIRED or _parse_iso(request.expires_at) <= datetime.now(
            timezone.utc
        ):
            self._store.mark_recovery_request_expired(request.request_id)
            raise TokenExpiredError("token has expired")

        self._store.mark_recovery_request_completed(request.request_id, now=now_iso())
        return CompleteResult(account_id=request.account_id, organization_id=request.organization_id)

    def retry_notification(self, notification_id: str) -> models.Notification:
        notification = self._store.get_notification(notification_id)
        if notification.delivery_state not in _RETRY_ELIGIBLE_STATES:
            raise ConflictError(
                f"notification {notification_id!r} is not retryable in state {notification.delivery_state!r}"
            )

        resolved_account_id = notice.account_id_from_retry_locator(
            notification.retry_locator or "", notification.account_id
        )
        account = self._store.get_account(resolved_account_id)
        recipient = notice.recipient_from_retry_locator(
            notification.retry_locator or "", notification.recipient, account.current_email
        )

        request = self._store.get_recovery_request(notification.request_id)
        now = now_iso()
        if request.status != models.RecoveryRequestStatus.PENDING or _parse_iso(request.expires_at) <= datetime.now(
            timezone.utc
        ):
            self._store.mark_recovery_request_expired(request.request_id)
            self._store.update_notification_after_attempt(
                notification_id=notification_id,
                delivery_state=models.DeliveryState.FAILED,
                provider_receipt=notification.provider_receipt,
                reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
                retry_locator=notification.retry_locator,
                now=now,
            )
            return self._store.get_notification(notification_id)

        # The original secret was never delivered (delivery failed outright),
        # so it is safe to mint a replacement rather than retaining the
        # original plaintext token anywhere durable.
        raw_token = tokens.generate_token()
        self._store.update_recovery_request_token_hash(request.request_id, token_hash=tokens.hash_token(raw_token))

        outcome = self._mailer.send(
            recipient=recipient, recovery_token=raw_token, reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id or ""
        )
        retry_locator = None
        if outcome.delivery_state in _LOCATOR_REQUIRED_STATES:
            retry_locator = notice.encode_retry_locator(outcome.provider_receipt or "", account.account_id)

        self._store.update_notification_after_attempt(
            notification_id=notification_id,
            delivery_state=outcome.delivery_state,
            provider_receipt=outcome.provider_receipt,
            reconciliation_id=notification.reconciliation_id,
            retry_locator=retry_locator,
            now=now,
        )
        return self._store.get_notification(notification_id)

    def retry_pending_notifications(self, *, limit: int = MAX_RETRY_BATCH) -> List[models.Notification]:
        limit = min(max(int(limit), 1), MAX_RETRY_BATCH)
        pending = self._store.retryable_notifications(limit=limit)
        results = []
        for notification in pending:
            results.append(self.retry_notification(notification.notification_id))
        return results

"""Two-process integration tests for POST /recovery/notifications/retry.

Two eligibility paths share this one route, both funneling through the
same RecoveryService.retry_notifications consumer and
notice.recipient_from_retry_locator helper:

- The ordinary compatibility path: a notice the mail endpoint rejected
  outright (HTTP 503) is persisted FAILED and stays retryable with only
  the bearer token -- no reconciliation window policy or other scenario
  metadata required. OrdinaryFailedRetryRestartTests exercises this in
  isolation, starting the second process with no --window-policy at all,
  before the reconciliation-unresolved scenario test below it.
- The reconciliation-unresolved path: a notice the provider accepted for
  delayed delivery (ACCEPTED_DELAYED) that reconciliation's own window
  policy has since classified unresolved. UnresolvedRetryRestartTests
  covers an unchanged address, a duplicate retry, expiry, a completed
  notice, and authentication.

Every notice under test is either created through the real HTTP flow or
seeded directly into SQLite before any `serve` subprocess starts, and is
only ever reloaded by that subprocess from its saved retry_locator,
account, and request rows -- proving retry survives a restart rather than
depending on any in-memory state of the process that first saw it.
"""
import json
import os
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

from accountsvc import notice
from accountsvc.storage import Storage

from .helpers import FakeMailProviderServer

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
WINDOW_POLICY_CSV = PROJECT_ROOT / "fixtures" / "provider-s02" / "delayed-delivery-window.csv"
BEARER_TOKEN = "retry-restart-admin-token"  # noqa: S105 - fixture credential, not a real secret
READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10.0

# Deliberately far in the past: whatever wall-clock "now" the test happens
# to run at, this is already well outside the fixture's 30-minute
# accepted_delayed window, so no real sleep is needed to age a seeded
# notification into "unresolved".
OLD_TIMESTAMP = "2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"
FAR_FUTURE_EXPIRY = "2099-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"
PAST_EXPIRY = "2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"


def _free_port() -> int:
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


def _wait_until_ready(host: str, port: int, timeout: float = READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) -> None:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    last_error = None
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        try:
            with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=0.2):
                return
        except OSError as exc:
            last_error = exc
            time.sleep(0.1)
    raise TimeoutError(f"server on {host}:{port} did not become ready: {last_error}")


def _post(base_url: str, path: str, payload: dict, *, token=None):
    body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"} if token else {}
    request = urllib.request.Request(base_url + path, data=body, method="POST", headers=headers)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
            return response.status, json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        with exc:
            return exc.code, json.loads(exc.read().decode("utf-8"))


class OrdinaryFailedRetryRestartTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """The provider-rejected (503) compatibility path, restart-only."""

    def setUp(self):
        fd, self.db_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
        os.close(fd)
        os.remove(self.db_path)

        store = Storage(self.db_path)
        store.create_account(
            organization_id="org-riverbend", account_id="acct-delay-a", email="priya@riverbend.example", now="t0"
        )
        store.close()

        self.mail_provider = FakeMailProviderServer()
        self.mail_provider.set_failure(status=503, message="mail provider unavailable")

        self.processes = []
        self.addCleanup(self._cleanup)

    def _cleanup(self):
        for process in self.processes:
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.terminate()
                try:
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    process.kill()
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
        self.mail_provider.shutdown()
        for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
            candidate = self.db_path + suffix
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                os.remove(candidate)

    def _start_serve_process(self, *, port: int) -> str:
        # Deliberately no --window-policy: the ordinary compatibility path
        # must remain eligible with no reconciliation engine configured at
        # all -- no scenario metadata, workflow transition, or operator
        # approval is a prerequisite for it.
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            [
                sys.executable,
                "-m",
                "accountsvc.cli",
                "serve",
                "--database",
                self.db_path,
                "--bearer-token",
                BEARER_TOKEN,
                "--mail-endpoint",
                self.mail_provider.url,
                "--host",
                "127.0.0.1",
                "--port",
                str(port),
            ],
            cwd=str(PROJECT_ROOT),
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        )
        self.processes.append(process)
        _wait_until_ready("127.0.0.1", port)
        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"

    def test_provider_rejected_notice_retries_after_restart_with_no_reconciliation_configured(self):
        first_port = _free_port()
        base_url = self._start_serve_process(port=first_port)

        status, payload = _post(
            base_url,
            "/recovery/start",
            {"organization": "org-riverbend", "email": "priya@riverbend.example"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 202)
        self.assertEqual(payload["delivery_status"], "failed")
        request_id = payload["request_id"]

        # The opaque 503 body is stored verbatim as the provider receipt --
        # never interpreted as, and never overwriting, the recipient.
        store = Storage(self.db_path)
        notification = store.notifications_for_request(request_id)[0]
        self.assertIn("mail provider unavailable", notification.provider_receipt)
        self.assertEqual(notification.recipient, "priya@riverbend.example")
        notification_id = notification.notification_id
        store.close()

        first_process = self.processes[0]
        first_process.terminate()
        first_process.wait(timeout=5)

        self.mail_provider.set_success()
        second_port = _free_port()
        restarted_base_url = self._start_serve_process(port=second_port)

        # Unauthenticated retry is refused before any persisted notice is
        # even looked up, restart or not.
        status, _ = _post(restarted_base_url, "/recovery/notifications/retry", {})
        self.assertEqual(status, 401)

        status, payload = _post(
            restarted_base_url,
            "/recovery/notifications/retry",
            {},
            token=BEARER_TOKEN,
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(payload["notifications"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(payload["notifications"][0]["notification_id"], notification_id)
        self.assertEqual(payload["notifications"][0]["delivery_state"], "delivered")

        store = Storage(self.db_path)
        notification = store.get_notification(notification_id)
        self.assertEqual(notification.recipient, "priya@riverbend.example")
        store.close()


class UnresolvedRetryRestartTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """The reconciliation-unresolved path, across a process restart."""

    def setUp(self):

Two eligibility paths share this one route, both funneling through the
same RecoveryService.retry_notifications consumer and
notice.recipient_from_retry_locator helper:

- The ordinary compatibility path: a notice the mail endpoint rejected
  outright (HTTP 503) is persisted FAILED and stays retryable with only
  the bearer token -- no reconciliation window policy or other scenario
  metadata required. OrdinaryFailedRetryRestartTests exercises this in
  isolation, starting the second process with no --window-policy at all,
  before the reconciliation-unresolved scenario test below it.
- The reconciliation-unresolved path: a notice the provider accepted for
  delayed delivery (ACCEPTED_DELAYED) that reconciliation's own window
  policy has since classified unresolved. UnresolvedRetryRestartTests
  covers an unchanged address, a duplicate retry, expiry, a completed
  notice, and authentication.

Every notice under test is either created through the real HTTP flow or
seeded directly into SQLite before any `serve` subprocess starts, and is
only ever reloaded by that subprocess from its saved retry_locator,
account, and request rows -- proving retry survives a restart rather than
depending on any in-memory state of the process that first saw it.

def _free_port() -> int:
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


def _wait_until_ready(host: str, port: int, timeout: float = READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) -> None:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    last_error = None
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        try:
            with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=0.2):
                return
        except OSError as exc:
            last_error = exc
            time.sleep(0.1)
    raise TimeoutError(f"server on {host}:{port} did not become ready: {last_error}")


def _post(base_url: str, path: str, payload: dict, *, token=None):
    body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"} if token else {}
    request = urllib.request.Request(base_url + path, data=body, method="POST", headers=headers)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
            return response.status, json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        with exc:
            return exc.code, json.loads(exc.read().decode("utf-8"))
